words.definition: used to show that you are talking about someone or something that has not been mentioned before, or that your listener does not know about
words.translation: 一(个)；每一(个)

examples.en: We have a problem.
examples.zh: 我们遇到了一个麻烦。

examples.en: There was a hole in the fence.
examples.zh: 篱笆上有一个洞。

examples.en: Suddenly they heard a loud bang.
examples.zh: 他们突然听到砰的一声巨响。

words.definition: to leave someone, especially someone you are responsible for; loose, mania; desert, yield, quit
words.translation: 丢弃；放弃，抛弃；狂热；放任；遗弃；放弃

examples.en: How could she abandon her own child?
examples.zh: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子？

words.definition: the state of being able to do something; capacity, competence, talent, quality, power
words.translation: 能力；能耐，本领；能力，能耐；才能

examples.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
examples.zh: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

words.definition: clever or good at doing something; capable, efficient, competent
words.translation: 有能力的；出色的；能；[经管]有能力的；能干的

examples.en: one of my more able students
examples.zh: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

words.definition: very different from usual in a way that seems strange, worrying, wrong, or dangerous; unnatural, eccentric
words.translation: 不正常的；变态的；反常的，不规则的

examples.en: abnormal behaviour
examples.zh: 反常行为

examples.en: an abnormal level of cholesterol
examples.zh: 胆固醇水平异常

examples.en: My parents thought it was abnormal for a boy to be interested in ballet.
examples.zh: 我父母认为一个男孩子对芭蕾舞感兴趣并不正常。

words.definition: on or onto a ship, plane, or train; onboard, ashipboard
words.translation: 在船(车)上；上船；[航]在飞机上；[军][船][交]在船上；在火车上

examples.en: The plane crashed, killing all 200 people aboard.
examples.zh: 飞机失事，机上200人全部遇难。

examples.en: The boat swayed as he stepped aboard.
examples.zh: 他上船时，船晃了起来。

words.definition: to officially end a law, system etc, especially one that has existed for a long time; recall, suppress
words.translation: 废除，取消；废除，废止；取消，革除

examples.en: Slavery was abolished in the US in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

words.definition: a medical operation to end a  pregnancy  so that the baby is not born alive; miscarriage, misbirth
words.translation: 流产， 堕胎；[妇产]流产，小产；流产的胎儿

examples.en: She decided to have an abortion .
examples.zh: 她决定做人工流产。

examples.en: anti-abortion campaigners
examples.zh: 参与反堕胎运动的人

words.definition: concerning or relating to a particular subject; concerning, as for, with reference to, round, in relation to; close-at-hand; around, approximately, everywhere, throughout, something
words.translation: 关于；在…周围；大约；在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的；周围；到处

examples.en: a book about politics
examples.zh: 一本有关政治的书

examples.en: She said something about leaving town.
examples.zh: 她说了些要离开镇子的话。

examples.en: He lied about his age.
examples.zh: 他谎报年龄。

words.definition: beyond, without, than; hereinabove, thereinbefore
words.translation: 在…上面；高于；超过；在……上面；在……之上；在上面；在上文

examples.en: He lived in a flat above the shop.
examples.zh: 他住在那商店上面的一套房间里。

examples.en: The airliner flew above the clouds.
examples.zh: 大型客机在云层上面飞行。

words.definition: in or to a foreign country; foreign country
words.translation: (在)国外；到处；海外；异国

examples.en: I’ve never lived abroad before.
examples.zh: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

examples.en: She often goes abroad on business.
examples.zh: 她经常出国公干。

examples.en: We never travelled abroad when we were kids.
examples.zh: 我们小时候从来没有去国外旅行过。

words.definition: sudden and unexpected; sudden, short, angular
words.translation: 突然的， 意外的；唐突的， 鲁莽的；生硬的；突然的；唐突的；陡峭的

examples.en: an abrupt change of plan
examples.zh: 计划的突然改变

words.definition: when you are not in the place where people expect you to be, or the time that you are away; shortage, deficiency, need, short of, drought
words.translation: 缺席，不在场；缺乏；没有；[法]缺席；不注意

examples.en: In the absence of any evidence, the police had to let Myers go.
examples.zh: 警察没有证据，只好把迈尔斯放了。

words.definition: not at work, school, a meeting etc, because you are sick or decide not to go; missing, vacant
words.translation: 缺席的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的

examples.en: He has been absent from his desk for two weeks.
examples.zh: 他已经两个星期没来了。

words.definition: used to emphasize your opinion about something or someone; strict, complete, full, positive, total
words.translation: 绝对的；纯粹的；[数]绝对的；完全的；专制的

examples.en: Some of the stuff on TV is absolute rubbish.
examples.zh: 电视上播放的有些东西简直就是垃圾。

examples.en: How did you do that? You’re an absolute genius.
examples.zh: 你是怎么做的？ 你绝对是个天才。

examples.en: That meal last night cost an absolute fortune.
examples.zh: 昨晚那顿饭花了一大笔钱。

words.definition: to take in liquid, gas, or another substance from the surface or space around something; attract, engage, see, read, seize
words.translation: 吸收（液体、气体等）；吸收；吸引；承受；理解；使…全神贯注

examples.en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
examples.zh: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

words.definition: based on general ideas or principles rather than specific examples or real events; brief, summary, resume; deep, nonobjective; extract, brief
words.translation: 抽象的；[图情]摘要；抽象；抽象的概念；深奥的；提取；使……抽象化

examples.en: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
examples.zh: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

examples.en: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
examples.zh: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

words.definition: completely stupid or unreasonable; ridiculous, preposterous
words.translation: 不合理的，荒唐的；荒谬的；可笑的

examples.en: It seems an absurd idea.
examples.zh: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

words.definition: something that is abundant exists or is available in large quantities so that there is more than enough; full, ample, plentiful, luxurious
words.translation: 大量的，丰富的；丰富的；充裕的；盛产

examples.en: an abundant supply of fresh water
examples.zh: 充足的淡水供应

examples.en: abundant opportunities for well qualified staff
examples.zh: 提供给高素质的员工的大量机会

words.definition: to treat someone in a cruel and violent way, often sexually; punishment, vice; strain, maltreat
words.translation: 滥用，虐待；滥用；虐待；辱骂；弊端；恶习，陋习

examples.en: Williams abused his position as Mayor to give jobs to his friends.
examples.zh: 威廉斯滥用市长权力，给不少朋友安排了工作。

words.definition: relating to education, especially at college or university level; theoretical, collegial; undergraduate, don, scholar, college student, university student
words.translation: 学校(院)的，学术的；学术的；理论的；学院的；大学生，大学教师；学者

examples.en: He possessed no academic qualifications.
examples.zh: 他没有学历。

examples.en: a program to raise academic standards
examples.zh: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

words.definition: a college where students are taught a particular subject or skill; college, school
words.translation: 私立中学；专科院校；学院；研究院；学会

examples.en: a military academy
examples.zh: 军事学院

examples.en: the Royal Academy of Music
examples.zh: 皇家音乐学院

words.definition: if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect; improve, increase speed
words.translation: 加速；促进；增加

examples.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
examples.zh: 加快经济增长速度的措施

words.definition: the way someone pronounces the words of a language, showing which country or which part of a country they come from; stress, trait; emphasize, stress, highlight
words.translation: 口音，腔调；重音；口音；[语]重音；强调；特点；重音符号；重读；带…口音讲话

examples.en: He had a strong Irish accent
examples.zh: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

words.definition: to take something that someone offers you, or to agree to do something that someone asks you to do; undertake, adopt, recognize, contain, shoulder; recognize, grant
words.translation: 接受；同意；承认；承担；承兑；容纳

examples.en: Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
examples.zh: 她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。

examples.en: He accepted the invitation to stay with us.
examples.zh: 他接受了邀请来我们家住。

examples.en: His school reports said that he is always ready to accept a challenge (=  agree to do something difficult  ) .
examples.zh: 他的学业报告上说他乐于接受挑战。

words.definition: to find information, especially on a computer; the right to enter a place, use something, see someone etc; make use of, fashion, employ, border, exercise; opening, admittance
words.translation: 获取；接近，入口；使用；[计]存取；接近；进入；使用权；[电]通路

examples.en: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
examples.zh: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

words.definition: a place, building, or object that is accessible is easy to reach or get into; accostable, comprehensible
words.translation: 易接近的；可进入的；可理解的

examples.en: The island is only accessible by boat.
examples.zh: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

examples.en: There is a church which is easily accessible from my home.
examples.zh: 有座教堂离我家很近。

words.definition: a piece of heavy metal that is lowered to the bottom of the sea, a lake etc to prevent a ship or boat moving; to lower the anchor on a ship or boat to hold it in one place; kelleg, backer patron; fix, nail
words.translation: 锚；抛锚，停泊；[船]锚；抛锚停泊；靠山；新闻节目主播；抛锚；[机]使固定；主持节目

examples.en: We dropped anchor a few yards offshore.
examples.zh: 我们在离岸几码远的地方抛锚停航。

examples.en: The next morning, they weighed anchor (=  lifted the anchor  ) and began to move south again.
examples.zh: 第二天早上他们起锚，又开始向南航行。

words.definition: an event in which a car, train, plane etc is damaged and often someone is hurt; occurring, slip
words.translation: 意外的；事故；[安全]事故；意外；[法]意外事件；机遇

examples.en: Over 70,000 people are seriously injured every year in road accidents.
examples.zh: 每年在道路事故中受重伤的有七万多人。

examples.en: The accident happened at the junction of Forest Road and Pine Walk.
examples.zh: 事故发生在森林路与松树路的交叉口。

examples.en: a train accident
examples.zh: 火车事故

words.definition: residence, adjustment, conditioning
words.translation: 招待设备；预定铺位；住处，膳宿；[分子生物]调节；和解；预订铺位

words.definition: to go somewhere with someone; attend, keep company
words.translation: 陪伴；陪伴，伴随；伴奏

examples.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.zh: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

examples.en: Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
examples.zh: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

words.definition: to succeed in doing something, especially after trying very hard; carry out, come true, perform, complete, fulfill
words.translation: 完成；实现；达到

examples.en: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
examples.zh: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

examples.en: (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
examples.zh: 大功告成。

words.definition: an exact record of the money that a company has received and the money it has spent; interpretation, explanation, construction, sake, reason; result in, to interpret; count, find, guess, feel, rate
words.translation: 记述；解释；帐目；[会计]帐户；帐目，帐单；理由；导致；报帐；认为；把…视为

examples.en: The accounts for last year showed a profit of $2 million.
examples.zh: 去年的账目显示利润为200万美元。

words.definition: someone whose job is to keep and check financial accounts, calculate taxes etc
words.translation: 会计人员， 会计师

examples.en: Do you want me to invite your accountant to this meeting?
examples.zh: 你想让我把你的会计师也邀请到会议里么？

words.definition: to gradually get more and more money, possessions, knowledge etc over a period of time; store up; scrape up
words.translation: 积累，增加；累积；积聚；积攒

examples.en: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
examples.zh: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

words.definition: the ability to do something in an exact way without making a mistake
words.translation: 准确(性)；准确度

examples.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
examples.zh: 他传球准确无误。

words.definition: to say that you believe someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something bad; blame, law; law, come in for blame
words.translation: 指责；归咎于；控告，指控；谴责；控告

examples.en: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
examples.zh: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

words.definition: usual; usual, used, particular, common, exclusive
words.translation: 惯常的；习惯的；通常的；独有的

examples.en: The pans were in their accustomed places.
examples.zh: 那些锅在老地方。

words.definition: if part of your body aches, you feel a continuous, but not very sharp pain there; a continuous pain that is not sharp or very strong; rare, aspire; pain, achiness
words.translation: 痛；想念；疼痛；[临床]疼痛；渴望

examples.en: His feet were aching from standing so long.
examples.zh: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

words.definition: to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard; accomplish, carry out, perform, complete, fulfil; gain one's ends, Make it.
words.translation: 完成，实现；达到；完成；达到目的；如愿以偿

examples.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
examples.zh: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

examples.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
examples.zh: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

examples.en: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
examples.zh: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

words.definition: something important that you succeed in doing by your own efforts; effort, completion, success, execution, accomplishment
words.translation: 完成；成就，成绩；成就；达到

examples.en: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
examples.zh: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

words.definition: a chemical substance that has a  pH  of less than 7. Strong acids can burn holes in material or damage your skin; acerbity; sour, vinegary
words.translation: 酸；酸的，酸性的；[化学]酸；<俚>迷幻药；[食品]酸的；讽刺的；刻薄的

examples.en: sulphuric acid
examples.zh: 硫酸

words.definition: to admit or accept that something is true or that a situation exists; accept, agree, recognize, grant, face
words.translation: 承认(…的权威)；承认；答谢；报偿；告知已收到

examples.en: The family acknowledge the need for change.
examples.zh: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

examples.en: Claire acknowledged that she was guilty.
examples.zh: 克莱尔承认有罪。

examples.en: The government must acknowledge what is happening and do something about it.
examples.zh: 对于目前的情况，政府必须承认其存在并对此采取措施。

words.definition: someone you know, but who is not a close friend; knowledge, awareness
words.translation: 认识；了解；熟人；相识；知道

examples.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
examples.zh: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

examples.en: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
examples.zh: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

words.definition: to obtain something by buying it or being given it; earn, buy, score, find, make
words.translation: 获得；取得；学到；捕获

examples.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
examples.zh: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

examples.en: She has acquired an email address and a site on the World Wide Web.
examples.zh: 她获得了一个电子邮件地址和万维网网址。

words.definition: the process by which you gain knowledge or learn a skill; getting, procurement, winning
words.translation: 取得， 获得， 习得；获得物， 增添的人；获得物，获得

examples.en: the acquisition of language
examples.zh: 语言的习得

words.definition: a unit for measuring area, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,047 square metres; soil, domain, ground
words.translation: 英亩(=607亩)；土地，地产；英亩

examples.en: They own 200 acres of farmland.
examples.zh: 他们拥有200英亩农田。

examples.en: a 200-acre wood
examples.zh: 一片200英亩的林地

words.definition: through; opposite
words.translation: 横过；在…对面；穿过；横穿；在对面

words.definition: to do something in a particular way or for a particular reason; one thing that you do; play, take a part of; operate, bear oneself, conduct oneself; behavior, dealing, action, going, bill
words.translation: 行动；见效；行为；扮演；装作，举动像；扮演，充当；表现，举止；假装，演戏；起作用，见效；行为，行动；[法]法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势

examples.en: The company acted correctly in sacking him.
examples.zh: 公司解雇他做得对。

examples.en: The jury decided that Walker had acted in self-defence.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁定沃克的行为属于自卫。

examples.en: Politicians will only act when enough people demand that they do something.
examples.zh: 只有足够多的民众起来要求，政客们才会采取行动。

words.definition: the process of doing something, especially in order to achieve a particular thing; movement, function, doing, campaign, working
words.translation: 行动；作用；功能；活动；战斗；情节

examples.en: The government must take action (=  do something  ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
examples.zh: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

examples.en: She was looking forward to putting her ideas into action (=  doing the things she had planned  ) .
examples.zh: 她盼望着将自己的想法付诸实施。

examples.en: Ambulance crews are ready to spring into action (=  suddenly start doing something  ) if anything goes wrong during the race.
examples.zh: 救护车急救人员随时准备出动，以应对比赛期间发生的意外。

words.definition: always busy doing things, especially physical or mental activities; positive, valid, available, effective, virtual; rustler
words.translation: 活跃的；积极的；[物化]活跃的；主动的；[电子]有效的；现役的；主动语态；积极分子

examples.en: games for active youngsters
examples.zh: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

examples.en: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
examples.zh: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

words.definition: things that people do, especially in order to achieve a particular aim; movement, doing, campaign, working, act
words.translation: 活动；活力；行动；活跃

examples.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
examples.zh: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

examples.en: fund-raising activities
examples.zh: 筹款活动

examples.en: Regular physical activity helps to control your weight.
examples.zh: 定期参加体育活动有助于控制体重。

words.definition: someone who performs in a play or film
words.translation: 男演员；演剧的人

examples.en: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
examples.zh: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

words.definition: a woman who performs in a play or film
words.translation: 女演员

examples.en: She's not only a great dramatic actress but she's also very funny.
examples.zh: 她不仅是一位伟大的女戏剧演员，而且也很幽默。

words.definition: used to emphasize that something is real or exact; practical, sincere, real, effective, true
words.translation: 实际的；现行的；真实的，实际的；现行的，目前的

examples.en: I’m not joking. Those were his actual words.
examples.zh: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

examples.en: I know Germany won, but I can’t tell you the actual score.
examples.zh: 我知道德国队胜了，但我不知道确切的比分。

examples.en: Interest is only charged on the actual amount borrowed.
examples.zh: 利息只按实际借款额收取。

words.definition: acute senses such as hearing, taste, touch etc are very good and sensitive; serious, bad, keen
words.translation: 敏锐的；严重的，[医][植]急性的；[数][生物]敏锐的；激烈的；尖声的

examples.en: Young children have a particularly acute sense of smell.
examples.zh: 幼儿的嗅觉特别灵敏。

words.definition: an advertisement
words.translation: 广告

examples.en: She replied to a lonely hearts ad she spotted in the New York Times.
examples.zh: 她回复了在《纽约时报》上看到的一则求友广告。

words.definition: to gradually change your behaviour and attitudes in order to be successful in a new situation; condition, suit, season; adjust, accomodate to, accommodate to
words.translation: 适应于；使适应；改编；适应

examples.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
examples.zh: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

words.definition: a film or television programme that is based on a book or play; orientation, reorganization
words.translation: 适应；改编；改编本，改写本

examples.en: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
examples.zh: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

words.definition: to put something with something else or with a group of other things; improve, gain, accelerate; enhance, boost, jack, mount, hot; addition
words.translation: 添加，附加，掺加；[数]加；增加；加起来；做加法；增加，添加；补充说；计算…总和；加法，加法运算

examples.en: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
examples.zh: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

words.translation: 沉溺于某种（尤其是不良的）嗜好的；入了迷的，上了瘾的；使…上瘾（addict的过去分词）

words.definition: the act of adding something to something else; add, accretion
words.translation: 加，加法；附加物；添加；[数]加法；增加物

examples.en: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the series.
examples.zh: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。

words.definition: if you address a problem, you start trying to solve it; undertake, pursue, have; speech, lecture, talk
words.translation: 解决；演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；[计]地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧

words.definition: enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose; suitable, competent, appropriate, proper, becoming
words.translation: 足够的；充足的；适当的；胜任的

examples.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
examples.zh: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

examples.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
examples.zh: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

examples.en: The standard of his work is barely adequate .
examples.zh: 他的工作水准勉强合格。

words.definition: to change or move something slightly to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose; regulate, coordinate, frame, restructure; correct, adapt to something
words.translation: 调整，调节；校正；调整，使…适合；校准；调整，校准；适应

examples.en: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
examples.zh: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

examples.en: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning.
examples.zh: 尝尝汤的味道，然后调整佐料用量。

examples.en: If your employment status changes, your tax code will be adjusted accordingly.
examples.zh: 如果就业状况改变，你的免税代码也会作相应调整。

words.definition: a small change made to a machine, system, or calculation; restructuring, conditioning, modulation, setup, accommodation
words.translation: 调整, 调节；调整，调节；调节器

examples.en: a period of adjustment
examples.zh: 一段调整期

words.definition: the activities that are involved in managing the work of a company or organization; governance, management, supervision, regulation, enforcement
words.translation: 管理，政府；[管理]管理；行政；实施；行政机构

examples.en: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
examples.zh: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

examples.en: The health service spends too much on administration.
examples.zh: 医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

words.definition: having many good qualities that you respect and admire; wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great
words.translation: 令人钦佩的,令人赞赏的；令人钦佩的；极好的；值得赞扬的

examples.en: an admirable achievement
examples.zh: 令人钦佩的成就

words.definition: to respect and like someone because they have done something that you think is good; praise, celebrate, bless; speak well of, think the world of
words.translation: 钦佩，称赞；钦佩；赞美；称赞

examples.en: I really admire the way she brings up those kids all on her own.
examples.zh: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

words.definition: a statement in which you admit that something is true or that you have done something wrong; recognition, acknowledgement
words.translation: 准许进(加)入；入场费；承认；进入许可；坦白；录用

examples.en: Reese, by his own admission , lacks the necessary experience.
examples.zh: 里斯自己也承认缺乏必要的经验。

words.definition: to agree unwillingly that something is true or that someone else is right; accept, recognize, agree, acknowledge, grant; accept, recognize
words.translation: 承认，容许；承认；准许进入；可容纳；容许

examples.en: ‘Okay, so maybe I was a little bit scared,’ Jenny admitted.
examples.zh: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

examples.en: I must admit , I didn’t actually do anything to help her.
examples.zh: 我必须承认，实际上我并没有帮她什么忙。

examples.en: Admit it! I’m right, aren’t I?
examples.zh: 承认吧！我对了，是不是？

words.definition: the time, usually between the ages of 12 and 18, when a young person is developing into an adult; puberty, youthhood
words.translation: 青春期；[生理]青春期

examples.en: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
examples.zh: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

words.definition: Adolescent is used to describe young people who are no longer children but who have not yet become adults. It also refers to their behaviour.; a young person, usually between the ages of 12 and 18, who is developing into an adult; pubertal, hebetic; youths, teener
words.translation: 青春期的；青少年的；青少年；未成熟的；[人类]青少年

examples.en: It is important that an adolescent boy should have an adult in whom he can confide.
examples.zh: 一个青春期男孩应该有一个他能倾吐心声的成年人，这是很重要的。

words.definition: to take someone else’s child into your home and legally become its parent; assume, take in sth
words.translation: 收养；采用；采取；接受；正式通过

examples.en: Sally was adopted when she was four.
examples.zh: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

examples.en: The couple are unable to have children of their own, but hope to adopt.
examples.zh: 那对夫妇自己无法生育，但希望领养孩子。

words.definition: to love someone very much and feel very proud of them; enjoy, worship, love; sweetheart
words.translation: 崇拜，爱慕；很喜欢；崇拜；爱慕；喜爱；极喜欢

examples.en: It's obvious that she adores him.
examples.zh: 她显然深深地爱着他。

examples.en: I simply adore chocolate.
examples.zh: 我简直太喜欢巧克力了。

words.definition: a fully-grown person, or one who is considered to be legally responsible for their actions; fully grown or developed; developed, grown, mature; major, grown-up
words.translation: 成年人；成年的；成熟的

examples.en: Some children find it difficult to talk to adults.
examples.zh: 一些孩子觉得与大人很难谈得来。

words.definition: before something happens or is expected to happen; development, growth, making, progress, increase; introduce, present, prefer, file, put in; go ahead, move ahead; up-front, prevenient
words.translation: 前进，提前；发展；前进；增长；[会计]预付款；提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前；进展；上涨；预先的；先行的

examples.en: I should warn you in advance that I’m not a very good dancer.
examples.zh: 我要先提醒你，我跳舞不是很好。

examples.en: Many thanks, in advance, for your help.
examples.zh: 对你的帮助预先表示万分感谢。

examples.en: Could you distribute copies well in advance of the meeting?
examples.zh: 开会前把复印件早早分发下去，好吗？

words.definition: a good or useful feature that something has; behalf, superiority, asset, benefit, edge; gain, make a profit; favor of, be conducive to
words.translation: 优点，优势；好处；优势；[经]利益；有利条件；获利；有利于；使处于优势

examples.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=  have an advantage  ) when applying for jobs.
examples.zh: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

words.definition: willingness to try new things, take risks etc; risk, throw, venture; take a chance, run a risk; take a risk, run a risk, stick one's neck out, take chances
words.translation: 冒险；惊险活动；冒险精神；投机活动；大胆说出

examples.en: Come on – where’s your sense of adventure?
examples.zh: 来吧——你的冒险精神哪里去了？

words.definition: to tell the public about a product or service in order to persuade them to buy it; message, instruct
words.translation: 为…做广告， 宣传；公告；登广告；通知；为…做广告；使突出

examples.en: They no longer advertise alcohol or cigarettes at sporting events.
examples.zh: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

examples.en: Colleges and universities have found that it pays to advertise (=  advertising brings good results  ) .
examples.zh: 大专院校发现做广告效果很好。

words.definition: a picture, set of words, or a short film, which is intended to persuade people to buy a product or use a service, or that gives information about a job that is available, an event that is going to happen etc; publicity, bill, propaganda, dissemination, drumbeating
words.translation: 广告；公告；登广告；[经]广告，宣传

examples.en: They put an advertisement in ‘The Morning News’, offering a high salary for the right person.
examples.zh: 他们在《晨报》上刊登了一则启事，出高薪寻找合适的人选。

examples.en: The organizers of the concert had taken out a full page advertisement in ‘The New York Times’.
examples.zh: 音乐会筹办者在《纽约时报》上刊登了整版广告。

examples.en: Only a handful of people answered the advertisement .
examples.zh: 只有寥寥数人对该广告作出了回应。

words.definition: an opinion you give someone about what they should do; suggestion, proposal, information, instance, notice
words.translation: 建议；忠告；劝告；通知

examples.en: You should have followed my advice.
examples.zh: 你真该听我的建议。

words.definition: to tell someone what you think they should do, especially when you know more than they do about something; alarm, message; agree to sb, make suggestions
words.translation: 劝告；建议；通知；劝告，忠告；警告；与…商量

examples.en: She needed someone to advise her.
examples.zh: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

examples.en: ‘Make sure that you keep the documents in a safe place,’ Otley advised him.
examples.zh: “一定要把文件放在安全的地方。”奥特利向他建议道。

words.definition: If you advocate a particular action or plan, you recommend it publicly; maintain, submit; prophet, supporter
words.translation: 倡导；提倡，主张，拥护；提倡者；支持者；律师

examples.en: Mr. Williams is a conservative who advocates fewer government controls on business.
examples.zh: 威廉斯先生是一位提倡减少政府对商业的控制的保守人士。

words.definition: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine; plane, airplane
words.translation: 飞机；[航]飞机（等于airplane）

examples.en: The aeroplane landed us at the airport in Barcelona.
examples.zh: 飞机把我们降落在巴塞罗那机场。

words.definition: public or political events and activities; thing, transaction, relations, business
words.translation: 事情，事件；事务；事情；私事；（尤指关系不长久的）风流韵事

examples.en: Are you interested in world affairs?
examples.zh: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

examples.en: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
examples.zh: 外交部

examples.en: Women had little role in public affairs.
examples.zh: 女性过去几乎不参与公共事务。

words.definition: to do something that produces an effect or change in something or in someone’s situation; influence, impact of, impact on, catch, contract; tend, prefer; emotion, will, sensibility
words.translation: 影响；感动；感染；假装；倾向；喜欢；情感；引起感情的因素

examples.en: the areas affected by the hurricane
examples.zh: 受飓风影响的地区

examples.en: a disease that affects the central nervous system
examples.zh: 影响中枢神经系统的疾病

examples.en: decisions which affect our lives
examples.zh: 影响我们生活的决定

words.definition: a feeling of liking or love and caring; infection, impression, favor, effect, influence
words.translation: 慈爱，爱；爱慕；喜爱，[心理]感情；影响；感染

examples.en: She looked back on those days with affection .
examples.zh: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

examples.en: Their father never showed them much affection .
examples.zh: 他们的父亲对他们从来没有表现出多少慈爱。

examples.en: The church was held in great affection (=  loved and cared about a lot  ) by the local residents.
examples.zh: 教会深受当地民众爱戴。

words.definition: to have enough money to buy or pay for something; allow, deal, extend, deliver, tender
words.translation: 负担得起；给予，提供；买得起

examples.en: I couldn’t afford the rent on my own.
examples.zh: 我单靠自己付不起房租。

examples.en: How can she afford to eat out every night?
examples.zh: 每天晚上下馆子她怎么能负担得起？

words.definition: frightened because you think that you may get hurt or that something bad may happen; worried, scared
words.translation: 害怕的；担心的；恐怕

examples.en: There’s no need to be afraid.
examples.zh: 没有必要害怕。

words.translation: 非洲

examples.en: The giraffe ranges in Africa.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿生长在非洲。

examples.en: The practice still prevails in some parts of Africa.
examples.zh: 这种做法在非洲某些地区仍然很盛行。

examples.en: He traversed alone the whole continent of Africa from east to west.
examples.zh: 他只身长途跋涉， 从东向西横穿整个非洲大陆。

words.definition: relating to Africa or its people; someone from Africa
words.translation: 非洲的；非洲人

examples.en: ...the African continent.
examples.zh: …非洲大陆。

words.definition: when a particular event or time has happened, or when someone has done something; since, subsequently; in the back of; succeeding
words.translation: 在…以后；次于；后来，以后；在……之后；以后的

examples.en: After the war many soldiers stayed in France.
examples.zh: 战后，许多士兵留在法国。

examples.en: I go swimming every day after work.
examples.zh: 我每天下班后都去游泳。

examples.en: Do you believe in life after death?
examples.zh: 你相信人死后还有来生吗？

words.definition: the part of the day after the morning and before the evening; post meridian, arvo
words.translation: 下午，午后；午后，下午

examples.en: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
examples.zh: 星期四下午有个会议。

examples.en: It was very hot in the afternoon .
examples.zh: 下午很热。

examples.en: See you tomorrow afternoon .
examples.zh: 明天下午见。

words.definition: If you do something or if something happens afterward, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned; since, subsequently
words.translation: 后来，以后；以后，后来

examples.en: Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
examples.zh: 之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。

words.definition: one more time – used when something has happened or been done before; moreover, besides, additionally, then, both
words.translation: 又一次；而且；又，此外；再一次

examples.en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
examples.zh: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

examples.en: I’ll never go there again.
examples.zh: 我再也不会去那儿了。

examples.en: Mr Khan’s busy. Can you try again later?
examples.zh: 卡恩先生正忙着。 你能不能过一会儿再打来？

words.definition: next to and touching an upright surface, especially for support; in opposition to, in contravention of; adverse, contrary, opposite, disadvantageous
words.translation: 倚在；逆，对着；反对，违反；靠；倚；防备；不利的；对立的

examples.en: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
examples.zh: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

examples.en: The younger policeman was leaning against the bureau with his arms folded.
examples.zh: 那位较年轻的警官两臂交叉，倚靠在办公桌旁。

words.definition: the number of years someone has lived or something has existed; to start looking older or to make someone or something look older; era, time, stage, phase, grade; mature, flower; grey, ripen
words.translation: 年龄；时代；变老；寿命，使用年限；阶段；成熟；使成熟；使变老，使上年纪

examples.en: Francis is the same age as me.
examples.zh: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

examples.en: Experts disagree over the age of the drawings.
examples.zh: 专家对这些画作的年代意见不统一。

examples.en: Dad retired at the age of 56.
examples.zh: 爸爸是在56岁时退休的。

words.definition: an organization or department, especially within a government, that does a specific job; procuration, intermediary agent
words.translation: 机构；[贸易]代理，[经]中介；代理处，经销处

examples.en: a UN agency responsible for helping refugees
examples.zh: 负责为难民提供帮助的联合国机构

examples.en: the Environmental Protection Agency
examples.zh: 环保局

words.definition: a list of problems or subjects that a government, organization etc is planning to deal with
words.translation: 议事日程

examples.en: The Republicans have stuck to their conservative agenda.
examples.zh: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

words.definition: a person or company that represents another person or company, especially in business; deputy, factor, secondary, proxy; acting, deputy
words.translation: 代理商；[法][贸易]代理人，代理商；药剂；特工；[法][贸易]代理的

examples.en: Our agent in Rio deals with all our Brazilian business.
examples.zh: 我们在里约热内卢的业务代表处理我们在巴西的全部业务。

words.definition: the act of attacking a country, especially when that country has not attacked first; violence, invasion, infringement
words.translation: 进攻,侵略；侵略；进攻；[心理]侵犯；侵害

examples.en: an unprovoked act of aggression
examples.zh: 无端的侵犯

words.definition: behaving in an angry threatening way, as if you want to fight or attack someone; invasive, enterprising
words.translation: 挑衅的，好斗的；有上进心的；侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的

examples.en: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
examples.zh: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

examples.en: Teachers apparently expect a certain amount of aggressive behaviour from boys.
examples.zh: 老师显然料到男孩子多少会有些好勇斗狠的行为。

words.definition: used to show how far back in the past something happened; previously, formerly, back; previous, past, back
words.translation: 以前；以前，以往；以前的；过去的

examples.en: They moved to a new house some time ago (=  a fairly long time ago  ) .
examples.zh: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

examples.en: We had our bicentenary celebrations not that long ago.
examples.zh: 不久前，我们举行了200周年庆典活动。

words.definition: to have or express the same opinion about something as someone else; undertake, accept, recognize, side, grant; accept, grant
words.translation: 同意；持相同意见；赞成；承认；意见一致

examples.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
examples.zh: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

words.definition: an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc; accordance, protocol, unity, identity, keeping
words.translation: 协定，协议；同意；[法]协议；同意，一致

examples.en: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
examples.zh: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

words.definition: Agricultural means involving or relating to agriculture; geoponic, georgic
words.translation: 农业的；[农]农业的；农艺的

examples.en: Farmers struggling for survival strip the forests for agricultural land.
examples.zh: 为生存而挣扎的农民们把森林伐光来作农业用地。

words.definition: the practice or science of farming; farming, extractive industry
words.translation: 农业，农艺；农学；[农]农业；农艺，[农学]农学

examples.en: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.
examples.zh: 75%以上的土地用于农耕。

words.definition: a short distance in front of someone or something; forth, in advance, previously, to, along; forward, antrorse
words.translation: 在前；向前；提前；领先；预先；领先的；向前的

examples.en: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.
examples.zh: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。

examples.en: We could see the lights of Las Vegas up ahead .
examples.zh: 我们能看到前方拉斯维加斯的灯光。

examples.en: Henry hurried on ahead (=  went in front of the others  ) .
examples.zh: 亨利赶紧跑到前面。

words.definition: help that you need to do a particular thing; assistance, friend, hand, help, boost; facilitate, bolster up; lend a hand, to help
words.translation: 帮助，救护；助手；援助；帮助；帮助者；有助于

examples.en: Foreign aid from many countries poured into the famine area.
examples.zh: 来自许多国家的救援物资纷纷送到饥荒地区。

words.translation: 获得性免疫缺乏综合征；爱滋病（Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome）

words.definition: to choose the place, person etc that you want to hit or reach and point a weapon or another object towards them; be calculated to, boot; propose, to intend; intention, purpose, sake, objective, target
words.translation: 瞄准，针对；致力；目的在于；引导；把…对准；打算；对准目标；目的；目标；对准

examples.en: Denver aimed his gun but did not shoot.
examples.zh: 丹佛举枪瞄准，但是没有射击。

words.definition: the mixture of gases around the Earth, that we breathe; atmosphere, heaven, sky, high, look; sport, ventilate
words.translation: 空气；空中；外观；[气象]空气，[地物]大气；天空；样子；曲调；使通风，晾干；夸耀

examples.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
examples.zh: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

examples.en: You need to put some air in the tyres.
examples.zh: 你得给轮胎充气了。

words.definition: a plane or other vehicle that can fly; plane, airplane, aeroplane
words.translation: 飞机，飞行器；[航]飞机，航空器

examples.en: The return flight of the aircraft was delayed.
examples.zh: 飞机的返回航程被推迟了。

words.definition: a company that takes passengers and goods to different places by plane; vector, lane, airways
words.translation: 航空公司；航线；[航]航线

examples.en: an airline pilot
examples.zh: 航空公司飞行员

words.translation: 航空邮件

words.definition: a vehicle that flies through the air and has one or more engines; plane, aeroplane
words.translation: 飞机；[航]飞机

examples.en: The airplane cracked up in landing.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在着陆时坠毁。

examples.en: The new airplane flies at twice the speed of sound.
examples.zh: 这架新式飞机以两倍于音速的速度飞行。

examples.en: We beamed the airplane down safely.
examples.zh: 我们给飞机导航使它安全降落。

words.definition: a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in; landing field, aeroport
words.translation: 机场，航空站；[航]机场；航空站

examples.en: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
examples.zh: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

examples.en: Her family went to see her off at the airport.
examples.zh: 她的家人去机场送她。

words.translation: 空域；领空；空间

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger; panic, tocsin; exercise, alert, warn
words.translation: 惊恐，忧虑；警报；警报，[安全]警告器；惊慌；警告；使惊恐

examples.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
examples.zh: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

examples.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
examples.zh: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

examples.en: a sophisticated alarm system
examples.zh: 精密的警报系统

words.definition: a book that you put photographs, stamps etc in
words.translation: 粘贴簿，集邮簿，像册

examples.en: a photograph album
examples.zh: 相册

words.definition: drinks such as beer or wine that contain a substance which can make you drunk; ethanol, ethylalcohol
words.translation: 酒精；[有化]酒精，乙醇

examples.en: I don’t drink alcohol anymore.
examples.zh: 我不再喝酒了。

examples.en: {"GLOSS":["when someone drinks too much"],"COLLOINEXA":["alcohol abuse"]}
examples.zh: 酗酒

examples.en: people with alcohol problems
examples.zh: 有酗酒问题的人

words.translation: 酒精的，含酒精的；酒鬼，酗酒者

words.definition: a type of mathematics that uses letters and other signs to represent numbers and values
words.translation: 代数学

examples.en: He was not good at algebra in middle school.
examples.zh: 他中学时不擅长代数。

words.definition: very similar; similar, same, uniform, like, parallel; similarly
words.translation: 同样的，相同的；相似的；相同的；以同样的方式；类似于

examples.en: My mother and I are alike in many ways.
examples.zh: 我和母亲在许多方面很相似。

words.definition: still living and not dead; lively, activated
words.translation: 活着的；活跃的；活泼的；有生气的

examples.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
examples.zh: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

examples.en: My grandparents are still alive .
examples.zh: 我的祖父母和外祖父母都还健在。

examples.en: We stayed alive by eating berries.
examples.zh: 我们靠吃浆果活命。

words.definition: entire, overall, total; utterly, sheerly; full, entirety, allness
words.translation: 全部的；全部；全然地；越发

words.definition: having an allergy
words.translation: 过敏的

examples.en: an allergic reaction to nuts
examples.zh: 对坚果的过敏性反应

words.definition: a narrow street between or behind buildings, not usually used by cars; path, lane
words.translation: 小巷；胡同；小路；[建]小径

examples.en: The alley led to the railway bridge.
examples.zh: 这条小巷通往铁路桥。

examples.en: She found the side alley where the stage door was located.
examples.zh: 她找到了剧场后门所在的小巷。

words.definition: to use something for a particular purpose, give something to a particular person etc, especially after an official decision has been made; portion, part, appropriate; parcel out, to assign
words.translation: 分配， 分派， 把…拨给；分配；拨出；使坐落于；指定

examples.en: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
examples.zh: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

words.definition: to let someone do or have something, or let something happen; afford, let, have, deal, extend; think of, think about
words.translation: 允许，准许；任；允许；给予；认可；容许；考虑

examples.en: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
examples.zh: 泳池内禁止跳水。

words.definition: an amount of money that you are given regularly or for a special purpose; permission, quota, pension, subsidy; ration
words.translation: 津贴， 补贴；零用钱；[劳经]津贴，零用钱；允许；限额；定量供应

examples.en: Sales staff get a generous mileage allowance or a company car.
examples.zh: 销售人员有优厚的里程补贴或者公司提供的专用汽车。

examples.en: If you are entitled to sickness allowance, you must claim it from your employer.
examples.zh: 你如果有资格领取疾病津贴，必须向雇主申请索要。

words.definition: nearly, but not completely or not quite; nearly, most, virtually, practically, feckly
words.translation: 几乎，差不多；差不多，几乎

examples.en: Have you almost finished?
examples.zh: 你差不多完成了吗？

examples.en: Supper’s almost ready.
examples.zh: 晚饭就要做好了。

examples.en: It was almost midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜将至。

words.definition: if you are alone in a place, there is no one with you; Alone is also an adverb; independent, isolated, separate, sole; respectively, solely
words.translation: 单独的；单独地；独自的；孤独的；独自地

examples.en: She lives alone .
examples.zh: 她一个人生活。

examples.en: You shouldn’t leave a child alone in the house.
examples.zh: 你不应该把小孩独自留在家里。

examples.en: My wife and I like to spend time alone together away from the kids.
examples.zh: 我和妻子喜欢没有孩子打扰，过二人世界。

words.definition: from one place on something such as a line, road, or edge towards the other end of it; going forward; forth, together, to, ahead, front; down
words.translation: 沿着；向前；一起；来到；顺着

examples.en: We were driving along Follyfoot Road.
examples.zh: 我们沿着福莱福特路行驶。

examples.en: She glanced anxiously along the line of faces.
examples.zh: 她焦急地扫视着这一排面孔。

examples.en: He slid his hand along her arm.
examples.zh: 他的手顺着她的臂膀滑下。

words.definition: next to the side of something; aside
words.translation: 在旁边，沿着边，并排地；在…旁边， 沿着…的边；和…在一起；在旁边

examples.en: A car drew up alongside .
examples.zh: 一辆车在旁边停了下来。

examples.en: Children’s prices are shown alongside adult prices.
examples.zh: 儿童票价标在成人票价旁边。

words.definition: if you read, laugh, say something etc aloud, you read etc so that people can hear you; out, loudly
words.translation: 出声地，大声地；大声地；出声地

examples.en: When we were children, our father read aloud to us.
examples.zh: 当我们是孩子时，我们的父亲大声地朗读给我们听。

words.definition: a set of letters, arranged in a particular order, and used in writing; ABC, rudiments
words.translation: 字母表，字母系统；[语]字母表，字母系统；入门，初步

examples.en: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
examples.zh: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

words.definition: before now, or before a particular time; yet
words.translation: 早已，已经；已经，早已；先前

examples.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
examples.zh: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

examples.en: The performance had already started when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

words.definition: in addition to something else that you have mentioned; moreover, too, besides, either, likewise
words.translation: 亦，也；而且，还；也；而且；同样

examples.en: Information is also available on women’s health care.
examples.zh: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

examples.en: She sings beautifully and also plays the flute and piano.
examples.zh: 她歌唱得好，而且还会吹长笛和弹钢琴。

examples.en: The system was not only complicated but also ineffective.
examples.zh: 这套系统不仅复杂而且效率低。

words.definition: If one thing is an alternative to another, the first can be found, used, or done instead of the second; selective, vicissitudinary
words.translation: 代替品；供选择的；选择性的；交替的

examples.en: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.
examples.zh: 治疗关节炎的新方法可能会提供一种止痛药的替代品。

words.definition: used to introduce a statement that makes your main statement seem surprising or unlikely; while, though, as, albeit
words.translation: 尽管，虽然；虽然，尽管

examples.en: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
examples.zh: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

examples.en: We decided to take rooms in Longwood House, although we knew we could not really afford the rent.
examples.zh: 虽然我们知道自己其实付不起租金，但还是决定住朗伍德庄园的房间。

examples.en: Although I can’t help admiring the man’s courage, I do not approve of his methods.
examples.zh: 尽管我不得不佩服那个男子的勇气，却并不赞成他的方法。

words.definition: the height of an object or place above the sea; height, raise, elevation, rise
words.translation: 海拔, 高度；高地；高度；[数]顶垂线；（等级和地位等的）高级

examples.en: The aircraft had reached its cruising altitude of about 39,000 feet.
examples.zh: 那架飞机已经达到了大约三万九千英尺的巡航高度。

words.definition: used to emphasize that something has been done completely or has finished completely; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully; birthday suit, entireness
words.translation: 完全；总而言之；完全地；总共；整个；裸体

examples.en: an old custom that has vanished altogether
examples.zh: 一个彻底消亡的古老习俗

examples.en: Congress could ban the procession altogether.
examples.zh: 国会可以完全禁止这次游行。

words.definition: a silver-white metal that is very light and is used to make cans, cooking pans, window frames etc. It is a chemical  element  : symbol Al
words.translation: 铝

examples.en: recycled aluminium cans
examples.zh: 再生铝罐

words.definition: all the time, at all times, or every time; forever and ever, immer
words.translation: 总是，一直；永远；永远，一直；总是；常常

examples.en: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
examples.zh: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

examples.en: She’d always assumed that Gabriel was a girl’s name.
examples.zh: 她一直认为加布里埃尔是个女孩名字。

examples.en: He hadn’t always been a butler.
examples.zh: 他并不是一直当管家。

words.translation: 调频，调谐，调幅（ amplitude modulation）；（用于第一人称单数现在时）；（与v-ing连用构成现在进行时，与v-ed连用构成被动语态）；（柬）安（人名）

words.definition: Amateur sports or activities are done by people as a hobby and not as a job; someone who does an activity just for pleasure, not as their job; lover, fan; strange, leisure, lay
words.translation: 业余爱好的， 业余的；外行的；业余爱好者；外行；爱好者；业余的

examples.en: ...professional athletes and amateur runners.
examples.zh: …专业运动员和业余赛跑运动员。

words.definition: to surprise someone very much; take aback, take by surprise
words.translation: 使吃惊

examples.en: Dave amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
examples.zh: 戴夫突然结婚，令朋友们非常吃惊。

words.translation: 令人惊异的；使吃惊（amaze的ing形式）

words.definition: an important official who represents his or her government in a foreign country; representation, deputy, behalf of
words.translation: 大使， 使节， 派驻国际组织的代表；大使；代表；使节

examples.en: ...the German ambassador to Poland.
examples.zh: …德国驻波兰大使。

words.definition: that can be understood in more than one way; having different meanings; blurred
words.translation: 模棱两可的；分歧的；模糊不清的；[数]引起歧义的

examples.en: The language in the Minister’s statement is highly ambiguous.
examples.zh: 部长的声明措辞很含糊。

examples.en: His role in the affair is ambiguous.
examples.zh: 他在这起事件中的角色并不明确。

words.definition: determination to be successful, rich, powerful etc; careerism, aspiration; pursue / pursuit, go after
words.translation: 雄心，抱负，野心；野心，雄心；抱负，志向；追求；有…野心

examples.en: He was young and full of ambition.
examples.zh: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

words.definition: a special vehicle that is used to take people who are ill or injured to hospital; meat wagon
words.translation: 救护车；野战医院；[车辆][医]救护车；战时流动医院

examples.en: the ambulance service
examples.zh: 救护车服务

examples.en: the ambulance service
examples.zh: 你觉得我们需要叫救护车吗？

words.definition: United States, U.S.A
words.translation: 美洲；美国；美洲（包括北美和南美洲）

examples.en: I may go to America or I may not,it all depends.
examples.zh: 我也许去美国，也许不去，要视情况而定。

examples.en: She scampered in London then went back to America.
examples.zh: 她在伦敦匆忙地游览了一番，然后回到了美国。

examples.en: Some of the mountains in America have not yet been mapped out.
examples.zh: 美洲有些山脉还没有在地图上标出来。

words.definition: relating to the US or its people; someone from the US
words.translation: 美洲的；美国人

examples.en: Her mother is American.
examples.zh: 她妈妈是美国人。

examples.en: a famous American writer
examples.zh: 一位著名的美国作家

words.definition: in or through the middle of a group of people or things; in the middle of, in the midst of
words.translation: 在…之中；在…中间

examples.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
examples.zh: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

examples.en: I could hear voices coming from somewhere among the bushes.
examples.zh: 我能听到灌木丛中某个地方传来说话的声音。

examples.en: We walked among the chestnut woods on the mountain slopes.
examples.zh: 我们走在山坡上的栗树林中。

words.definition: a quantity of something such as time, money, or a substance; foot, gross total; sum, quantity of, gross, total
words.translation: 总数；数量；和；[会计]总计，合计；相当于；[数]共计；产生…结果；总额，[数]总数

examples.en: Please pay the full amount (=  of money  ) by the end of the month.
examples.zh: 请在月底前全额付清。

words.definition: more than enough; abundant, sufficient, competent, full, plenty
words.translation: 足够的；宽敞的；丰富的

examples.en: There'll be ample opportunity to relax, swim and soak up some sun.
examples.zh: 将会有充足的机会来放松、游泳和接受一些阳光。

words.definition: to make time pass in an enjoyable way, so that you do not get bored; to entertain, wile away
words.translation: 逗…乐；给…娱乐；娱乐；消遣；使发笑；使愉快

examples.en: Doing jigsaws would amuse Amy for hours on end.
examples.zh: 拼图能让埃米连续玩上几个小时。

examples.en: The kids amused themselves playing hide-and-seek.
examples.zh: 孩子们玩捉迷藏玩。

words.definition: the feeling you have when you think something is funny; entertainment, fun, occupation, pleasure, joy
words.translation: 乐趣；娱乐，消遣；消遣，娱乐

examples.en: Steve couldn’t hide his amusement.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫忍俊不禁。

examples.en: childhood amusements
examples.zh: 儿时的游戏

words.definition: a process in which a doctor makes someone talk about their past experiences, relationships etc in order to help them with mental or emotional problems; decomposition, dissolution
words.translation: 分析，分解，解析；[化学][数]分析；分解；验定

examples.en: She’s been in analysis for three years.
examples.zh: 她接受精神分析治疗已经三年了。

words.definition: break down
words.translation: 分析；对…进行分析，分解（等于analyse）

examples.en: How do you analyze this change?
examples.zh: 你该如何分析这种变化？

examples.en: You have to hoover anything before you can analyze it.
examples.zh: 在你不具备分析能力之前，你只得胡乱吸收你所能学到的东西。

examples.en: We should learn to discern and analyze the essentials of complicated questions.
examples.zh: 我们应该学会认识和分析复杂问题的本质。

words.definition: a member of your family who lived a long time ago; father, root, grandfather
words.translation: 祖宗，祖先；始祖，[生物]祖先；被继承人

examples.en: My ancestors were French.
examples.zh: 我的祖先是法国人。

words.definition: belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago; old, aged, advanced; elder, old folk
words.translation: 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的；古代人；老人

examples.en: the ancient civilizations of Asia
examples.zh: 亚洲的古代文明

words.definition: used to join two words, phrases etc referring to things that are related in some way; granted, et, but, yet, only
words.translation: 和，又，并，则；和，与；就；而且；但是；然后

examples.en: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
examples.zh: 他去买炸鱼薯条了。

examples.en: The film starred Jack Lemmon and Shirley Maclaine.
examples.zh: 这部电影由杰克·莱蒙和雪莉·麦克莱恩主演。

examples.en: We’ve dealt with items one, two, and eleven.
examples.zh: 我们已经处理了第一项、第二项和第十一项。

words.definition: a short story based on your personal experience; ana
words.translation: 轶事；奇闻；秘史

examples.en: The book is full of amusing anecdotes about his life in Japan.
examples.zh: 这本书里全是他在日本生活的趣闻轶事。

words.definition: a strong feeling of wanting to hurt or criticize someone because they have done something bad to you or been unkind to you; to make someone angry; wrath, bile; provoke, enrage; chafe at, be hot under the collar
words.translation: 怒，愤怒；使发怒；怒，[心理]愤怒；忿怒；使发怒，激怒；恼火；发怒

examples.en: There is growing anger among the people against the government.
examples.zh: 民众对政府越来越不满。

words.definition: the space between two straight lines or surfaces that join each other, measured in degrees; fish, figure for; hao, jiao
words.translation: 角，角度；钓鱼；谋取；角度，[数]角

examples.en: You didn’t measure the angle accurately.
examples.zh: 你没有量准角度。

words.definition: feeling strong emotions which make you want to shout at someone or hurt them because they have behaved in an unfair, cruel, offensive etc way, or because you think that a situation is unfair, unacceptable etc; riley, vexed
words.translation: 愤怒的，生气的；生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的

examples.en: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
examples.zh: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

examples.en: He was beginning to get angry .
examples.zh: 他开始发脾气了。

examples.en: His comments brought an angry response from opposition politicians.
examples.zh: 他的话激起反对派政客愤怒的回应。

words.definition: a living creature such as a dog or cat, that is not an insect, plant, bird, fish, or person; human feelings, desires etc that are connected with sex, food, and other basic needs; creature, zoon
words.translation: 动物，兽；动物的；[动]动物

examples.en: furry little animals
examples.zh: 毛茸茸的小动物

examples.en: The cosmetics have not been tested on animals.
examples.zh: 这些化妆品没有进行过动物试验。

examples.en: Beth is an animal lover (=  someone who likes animals  ) .
examples.zh: 贝丝是个喜欢动物的人。

words.definition: the joint between your foot and your leg; gambrel, malleolus
words.translation: 踝，踝节部；踝关节，[解剖]踝

examples.en: slender ankles
examples.zh: 纤细的脚踝

words.definition: a date on which something special or important happened in a previous year
words.translation: 周年纪念日

examples.en: Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
examples.zh: 1月，杰克和金庆祝了他们的结婚20周年纪念日。

words.definition: to officially tell people about something, especially about a plan or a decision; indicate, bill, forecast, shadow
words.translation: 宣布，声称；宣布；述说；预示；播报

examples.en: They announced their engagement in ‘The Times’.
examples.zh: 他们在《泰晤士报》上宣布了订婚的消息。

examples.en: At the end of their meeting, it was announced that an agreement had been reached.
examples.zh: 会议最后宣布已达成一项协议。

words.translation: 公告；宣告；发表；通告

words.definition: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient; harry, ply with; brown off; worry, trouble
words.translation: 使反感，厌烦；骚扰；惹恼；打搅；令人讨厌；烦恼（等于annoyance）

examples.en: Try making a note of the things that annoy you.
examples.zh: 试着把让你心烦的事记下来。

examples.en: It annoyed me that I didn't have time to do more ironing.
examples.zh: 没有时间熨更多的衣服让我心烦了。

words.definition: happening once a year; yearly, etesian; year book, almanac
words.translation: 每年的；年度的；[统计]每年的；年刊，[图情]年鉴；一年生植物

examples.en: The school trip has become an annual event.
examples.zh: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

words.definition: different, diverse, other, unlike, varying
words.translation: 再一个的；别的；又一，另一；另外的；不同的

examples.en: Can you cite another case like this one?
examples.zh: 你能举出另一个像这样的例子吗?

words.definition: to say something to someone as a reply when they have asked you a question, made a suggestion etc; reply, meet with; reply, accord; response, defence, reply, result
words.translation: 回答；响应；适应；符合；答案；[法]答辩

examples.en: She thought for a moment before answering.
examples.zh: 她想了一会儿才回答。

examples.en: He still hadn’t answered my question .
examples.zh: 他仍然没有回答我的问题。

examples.en: ‘Why don’t you just leave?’ ‘I’d like to,’ she answered, ‘but I have nowhere else to go.’
examples.zh: “你为什么不一走了之？”“我倒是想走，”她回答说，“但是我没有其他地方可去。”

words.definition: a small insect that lives in large groups; emmet, pismire
words.translation: 蚂蚁

examples.en: Ants swarmed up out of the ground and covered her shoes and legs.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁从地里成群地爬出来，爬满了她的鞋和腿。

words.definition: a piece of furniture, jewellery etc that was made a very long time ago and is therefore valuable; ancient, old; curiosity, virtu
words.translation: 古玩，古董；古老的，年代久远的；过时的，[古]古董的；古风的，古式的；[古]古董，古玩；古风，古希腊和古罗马艺术风格

examples.en: The palace is full of priceless antiques.
examples.zh: 宫殿里到处都是价值连城的古董。

examples.en: They bought the clock at an antique shop in Bath.
examples.zh: 他们在巴斯一家古玩店里买了这只钟。

examples.en: an antique dealer
examples.zh: 古玩商

words.definition: the feeling of being very worried about something; solicitude, aspiration
words.translation: 焦虑，忧虑；渴望；[心理]焦虑；挂念；令人焦虑的事

examples.en: his feelings of anxiety
examples.zh: 他焦虑的心情

examples.en: A high level of anxiety was created by the introduction of cameras into the factory.
examples.zh: 工厂安装了摄像头，这引起了工人的高度不安。

examples.en: It can help if you discuss your anxieties with someone.
examples.zh: 与别人谈谈自己的忧虑会有帮助的。

words.definition: worried about something; eager, hungry, desired, sick, keen
words.translation: 忧虑的；渴望的；焦虑的；担忧的；急切的

examples.en: She gave me an anxious look.
examples.zh: 她焦急地看了我一眼。

words.definition: having, possessory; somewhat, in some sort
words.translation: 什么，一些；任何的；所有的；丝毫；稍微；少许

examples.en: We could not reason out which way the robbers escaped, because we were unable to find any trace of them.
examples.zh: 我们推断不出这些强盗是从哪个方向逃走的，因为我们找不到他们的任何踪迹。

words.definition: anyway, however
words.translation: 无论如何；总之；不管怎样

examples.en: You know nothing about her really, or about yourself in relation to her, and anyhow it's only one of those things and therefore it's of no importance.
examples.zh: 你对她一点儿都不了解，也不了解自己和她的关系，无论如何它只是那些事情之一,因此没有任何重要性。

words.definition: used to refer to any person, when it is not important to say exactly who
words.translation: 任何人

examples.en: Anyone could win tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚任何人都可能赢。

examples.en: They offer help and advice to anyone interested in becoming a teacher.
examples.zh: 他们为任何有兴趣当老师的人提供帮助和咨询。

examples.en: If anyone sees Lisa, ask her to call me.
examples.zh: 如果有谁看见莉萨，叫她打电话给我。

words.definition: any thing, event, situation etc, when it is not important to say exactly which
words.translation: 任何事物；一切

examples.en: You can buy anything you want.
examples.zh: 你想要什么都可以买。

examples.en: He was prepared to do anything to make a bit of money.
examples.zh: 只要能赚一点钱，他什么都愿意做。

examples.en: Anything would be better than staying at home!
examples.zh: 做什么都比待在家里好！

words.definition: however, anyhow
words.translation: 无论如何；无论如何，不管怎样；总之

words.definition: You use anywhere in statements with negative meaning to indicate that a place does not exist; whithersoever; nowhere
words.translation: 在什么地方；在任何地方；无论何处；任何地方

examples.en: I haven't got anywhere to live.
examples.zh: 我没有任何地方住。

words.definition: if things are apart, they are not close to each other or touching each other; unusual, different, distinctive, isolated, separating
words.translation: 相隔；分开；除去；分离的；与众不同的

examples.en: They have offices in countries as far apart as India and Peru.
examples.zh: 他们的办事处远至印度、秘鲁等国。

examples.en: The police try to keep rival supporters apart at all matches.
examples.zh: 警方在所有的比赛中都设法将双方的支持者分开。

examples.en: A couple of men started fighting and we had to pull them apart .
examples.zh: 几名男子打起架来，我们不得不将他们拉开。

words.definition: a set of rooms on one floor of a large building, where someone lives; chamber, flat
words.translation: 公寓；[建]公寓；房间

examples.en: She lives in a small apartment.
examples.zh: 她住在一套小公寓里。

words.definition: to tell someone that you are sorry that you have done something wrong; square oneself, make an apology
words.translation: 道歉，谢罪，认错；道歉；辩解；赔不是；谢罪；辩白

examples.en: I’m so sorry, I do apologize.
examples.zh: 非常对不起，我真心道歉。

words.definition: something that you say or write to show that you are sorry for doing something wrong; justification, advocacy
words.translation: 道歉，认错，谢罪；道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物

examples.en: Edward can’t be here today, but he sends his apologies .
examples.zh: 爱德华今天来不了，他向大家表示歉意。

words.definition: easy to notice; transparent, decided, patent
words.translation: 表面上的；明显的；显然的

examples.en: The difference in quality was immediately apparent .
examples.zh: 质量的差异显而易见。

examples.en: He left suddenly, for no apparent reason .
examples.zh: 不知什么原因，他突然离开了。

words.definition: an urgent request for something important; attract, clamour for; asking, request, motion, charm
words.translation: 吸引，呼吁；呼吁，恳求；[法]上诉；诉诸，求助；有吸引力，迎合爱好；（体育比赛中）诉诸裁判；呼吁，请求；吸引力，感染力；诉诸裁判

examples.en: The girl’s family have made a public appeal for help to try and catch her killer.
examples.zh: 那名遇害女孩的家人吁请公众协助捉拿凶手。

words.definition: used to say how something seems, especially from what you know about it or from what you can see; occur, figure, offer, come out
words.translation: 出现；来到；似乎；显得；出庭

examples.en: Police have found what appear to be human remains.
examples.zh: 警方发现了疑似人体遗骸的东西。

examples.en: He tried to make it appear that she had committed suicide.
examples.zh: 他试图制造她自杀的假象。

examples.en: It may be less useful than it appears at first.
examples.zh: 这可能没有一开始显得那么有用。

words.definition: the way someone or something looks to other people; occurrence, aspect, emergence, external, outside
words.translation: 外表, 出现；外貌，外观；出现，露面

examples.en: He was always criticising his wife’s appearance.
examples.zh: 他老是批评妻子的外表。

examples.en: We are often attracted to somebody first by their physical appearance .
examples.zh: 我们经常先被一个人的外貌吸引。

examples.en: Women, in general, tend to be more concerned than men about their personal appearance .
examples.zh: 总的来说，女性比男性更注重自己的仪容。

words.definition: a part at the end of a book containing additional information; supplement, Appendix Appx
words.translation: 附录；阑尾；[图情]附录；附加物

examples.en: See Appendix 2.6.
examples.zh: 见附录2.6。

examples.en: Christine had to go into hospital to have her appendix out (=  have it removed  ) .
examples.zh: 克里丝蒂娜不得不去医院切除阑尾。

words.definition: a desire for food; weakness, habit, hobby
words.translation: 欲望, 胃口；[生理]食欲；嗜好

examples.en: Her husband always had a huge appetite.
examples.zh: 她丈夫向来胃口极大。

examples.en: Symptoms include tiredness and loss of appetite.
examples.zh: 症状包括疲倦和食欲不振。

words.definition: to hit your open hands together, to show that you have enjoyed a play, concert, speaker etc; go along with, be favorable to; cheer for, give it up
words.translation: 鼓掌；喝彩；赞同；称赞；向…喝采；鼓掌欢迎

examples.en: The audience applauded loudly.
examples.zh: 观众掌声雷动。

words.definition: a hard round fruit that has red, light green, or yellow skin and is white inside; customer, fellow, egg, guy, bird
words.translation: 苹果，苹果树；[园艺]苹果；家伙

examples.en: apple pie
examples.zh: 苹果馅饼

examples.en: an apple tree
examples.zh: 苹果树

examples.en: roast pork and apple sauce (=  a thick sauce made from cooked apples  )
examples.zh: 烤猪肉配苹果酱汁

words.definition: someone who has formally asked, usually in writing, for a job, university place etc; postulant, proposer
words.translation: 申请人；[专利]申请人，申请者；请求者

examples.en: We have had lots of applicants for these positions.
examples.zh: 对这些职位我们已有了很多申请人。

words.definition: a formal, usually written, request for something such as a job, place at university, or permission to do something; adhibition, Apps
words.translation: 申请，应用；应用；申请；应用程序；[药]敷用

examples.en: We receive hundreds of job applications each year.
examples.zh: 我们每年收到数百封求职信。

examples.en: I filled in the application form and sent it off.
examples.zh: 我填完申请表后把它寄了出去。

examples.en: You have to submit your application before the end of the month.
examples.zh: 月底之前必须递交申请。

words.definition: to make a formal request, usually written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something; put in for, enter one's name for; demand, put in for
words.translation: 应用, 申请；申请；涂，敷；应用；适用；请求

examples.en: We need to apply for planning permission to build a garage.
examples.zh: 我们建车库需要申请规划许可。

words.definition: to choose someone for a position or a job; install, constitute, name, place, specify; nominate sb to, institute to
words.translation: 任命，委派；约定，确定，指定；任命；指定；约定；委派

examples.en: officials appointed by the government
examples.zh: 政府任命的官员

words.definition: an arrangement for a meeting at an agreed time and place, for a particular purpose; convention, bond, nomination
words.translation: 约会；[管理]任命；约定；任命的职位

examples.en: All consultations are by appointment only .
examples.zh: 就诊必须预约。

words.definition: used to thank someone in a polite way or to say that you are grateful for something they have done; enjoy, see, grasp; value added, rise in price
words.translation: 感激，欣赏；欣赏；感激；领会；鉴别；增值；涨价

examples.en: Thanks ever so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
examples.zh: 多谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

examples.en: I appreciate your concern , but honestly, I’m fine.
examples.zh: 谢谢你关心，不过说真的，我很好。

examples.en: I’d appreciate it if you let me get on with my job.
examples.zh: 如果你能让我继续工作，我会非常感激。

words.definition: a feeling of being grateful for something someone has done; thank, acknowledgement
words.translation: 评价，感激；欣赏，鉴别；[经]增值；感谢

examples.en: He was presented with a watch in appreciation of his long service.
examples.zh: 他获赠一块手表，作为对其长期服务的感谢。

words.definition: to move towards or nearer to someone or something; a method of doing something or dealing with a problem; method, way, system, mechanism, medium; border, go on for; come near to, draw near
words.translation: 靠近；接近，方法；方法；途径；接近；着手处理

examples.en: As I approached the house, I noticed a light on upstairs.
examples.zh: 我走近那幢房子的时候注意到楼上有灯光。

examples.en: She heard footsteps approaching.
examples.zh: 她听到有脚步声走过来。

words.definition: correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose; suitable, proper, adequate, becoming; engage, take up to
words.translation: 适当的，恰当的；适当的；占用；拨出

examples.en: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
examples.zh: 通告发布的时机很合适。

examples.en: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
examples.zh: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

examples.en: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
examples.zh: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

words.definition: to think that someone or something is good, right, or suitable; confirm, agree, uphold, authorize; to ratify, give someone the green light
words.translation: 赞成，同意；批准；赞成；为…提供证据；满意

examples.en: You've never approved of Henry, have you?
examples.zh: 你从未赞赏过亨利，是吧？

words.definition: around, something
words.translation: 大约；大约，近似地；近于

words.definition: the fourth month of the year, between March and May
words.translation: 四月

examples.en: The changes will be introduced in April.
examples.zh: 这些变更将于4月实施。

words.translation: 围裙；[航] 停机坪；舞台口；着围裙于；围绕
阿拉伯的；阿拉伯人的；阿拉伯语

words.definition: decided or arranged without any reason or plan, often unfairly; artificial, random, absolute
words.translation: 随心所欲的；专断的；[数]任意的；武断的；专制的

examples.en: an arbitrary decision
examples.zh: 武断的决定

examples.en: the arbitrary arrests of political opponents
examples.zh: 对政敌的任意逮捕

words.definition: a structure with a curved top that is supported by straight sides, sometimes forming an entrance or built as a monument; to form or make something form a curved shape; lune; primary, major, central, main, leading; hog
words.translation: 拱门；（使）拱起；弓形，拱形；主要的；拱起；成为弓形

examples.en: Go through the arch and follow the path.
examples.zh: 穿过拱门沿小径往前走。

examples.en: Two rows of trees arched over the driveway.
examples.zh: 车道两旁树木交错，形成一个拱顶。

words.definition: someone whose job is to design buildings
words.translation: 建筑师

examples.en: But I am an architect.
examples.zh: 但是我是一名建筑师。

examples.en: They commissioned an architect to design the new library.
examples.zh: 他们委托一位建筑师设计这座新图书馆。

examples.en: The building was constructed from the design of that architect.
examples.zh: 这幢大楼是按那位建筑师的设计建造的。

words.definition: the style and design of a building or buildings; architectural style
words.translation: 建筑学；建筑式样；[建]建筑学；建筑风格

examples.en: He studied architecture at university.
examples.zh: 他在大学里读的是建筑学。

words.definition: relating to the most northern part of the world; the regions of the world around the North Pole; hyperboloidal, gelid; the Arctic Circle
words.translation: 北极的；北极；极寒的；北极圈；御寒防水套鞋

examples.en: the Arctic island of Novaya Zemlya
examples.zh: 北极的新地岛

examples.en: winter in the Arctic
examples.zh: 北极的冬天。

words.translation: 是（be的第二人称单复数现在式）；公亩

words.definition: a particular part of a country, town etc; district, region, extent, boundary, spectrum, territory
words.translation: 面积；地区；领域；区域，[地理]地区；范围

examples.en: Only cheeses made in this area may be labelled ‘Roquefort.’
examples.zh: 只有这个地区出产的干酪才能被称作“罗克福尔干酪”。

examples.en: Crime rates are much higher in urban areas.
examples.zh: 城镇地区的犯罪率要高很多。

words.definition: to disagree with someone in words, often in an angry way; debate, dispute about; debate, discuss, demonstrate, prove, satisfy
words.translation: 争论，争辩，辩论；争论，辩论；提出理由；辩论，争论；证明；说服

examples.en: We could hear the neighbours arguing.
examples.zh: 我们听到邻居在争吵。

words.definition: a situation in which two or more people disagree, often angrily; brush, reasoning, dispute
words.translation: 争论，辩论；理由；论证；论据；争吵；内容提要

examples.en: We need to provide a convincing argument as to why the system should be changed.
examples.zh: 我们得提出有说服力的论据，证明为何要改变体制。

words.definition: if a problem or difficult situation arises, it begins to happen; occur, raise, figure, offer, come out
words.translation: 出现；由…引起；上升；起立

examples.en: A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
examples.zh: 外交部出现了危机。

examples.en: More problems like those at the nuclear power plant are certain to arise.
examples.zh: 核电厂肯定还会出现那样的问题。

words.definition: the science of numbers involving adding, multiplying etc; algorithm, number
words.translation: 算术，四则运算；[数]算术，算法

examples.en: ...teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
examples.zh: …教授读、写、算的基本知识。

words.definition: one of the two long parts of your body between your shoulders and your hands; weapon, equipment, setup; war preparation
words.translation: 臂；臂状物；武器；手臂；袖子；[军]装备；武装；备战

examples.en: Dave has a broken arm .
examples.zh: 戴夫手臂断了。

examples.en: Tim’s mother put her arms around him.
examples.zh: 蒂姆的母亲伸出双臂搂着他。

examples.en: Pat was carrying a box under his arm .
examples.zh: 帕特腋下挟着一个盒子。

words.translation: 扶手椅，单人沙发；不切实际的

words.definition: the part of a country’s military force that is trained to fight on land in a war; battalion, heer
words.translation: 军队；陆军；陆军，[军]军队

examples.en: The army are helping to clear up after the floods.
examples.zh: 陆军部队正协助洪灾后的清理工作。

examples.en: an army officer
examples.zh: 陆军军官

examples.en: Army units launched attacks on bases near Jounieh port.
examples.zh: 陆军部队对朱尼耶港附近的基地发动了进攻。

words.definition: approximately, everywhere, throughout, something; round
words.translation: 在…周围；大约；到处；在附近；四处

examples.en: What an inspiration she was to all around her!
examples.zh: 她对于她周围所有的人是一种多么大的鼓舞!

examples.en: All those around him looked at him with amazement.
examples.zh: 周围的人都对他投射出惊异的眼光。

words.definition: schedule, budget, place in, settle, form; place in, treat, form
words.translation: 把…（系统地）分类；安排；排列；整理；协商

words.definition: plans and preparations that you must make so that something can happen; preparation, positioning, preliminary, setting, provision
words.translation: 整理，排列；安排；布置；整理；准备

examples.en: Have you made all your travel arrangements?
examples.zh: 你的旅行都安排好了吗？

words.definition: if the police arrest someone, the person is taken to a  police station  because the police think they have done something illegal; absorb, attract, engage, dispute, draw; prison, imprisonment
words.translation: 逮捕；[法]逮捕；阻止；吸引；监禁

examples.en: He was arrested and charged with murder.
examples.zh: 他遭到逮捕并被指控谋杀。

examples.en: I got arrested for careless driving.
examples.zh: 我因鲁莽驾驶被捕。

words.definition: when someone or something arrives somewhere; coming, advent
words.translation: 到达；到来；到达者

examples.en: Only the timely arrival of the police prevented the situation from becoming worse.
examples.zh: 警方及时赶到才阻止了事态恶化。

examples.en: Traffic problems account for one third of late arrivals.
examples.zh: 迟到的人有三分之一是因为交通问题。

words.definition: to get to the place you are going to; land, win, make good
words.translation: 到达；来临；达到；成功；达成；出生

examples.en: Give me a call to let me know you’ve arrived safely.
examples.zh: 打个电话给我，告诉我你已平安到达。

examples.en: By the time the police arrived on the scene, the burglars had fled.
examples.zh: 警方赶到现场时，窃贼已经逃跑了。

words.definition: a weapon usually made from a thin straight piece of wood with a sharp point at one end, that you shoot with a  bow
words.translation: 箭；箭状物

examples.en: Follow the arrows to the X-ray department.
examples.zh: 顺着箭头指示的方向去X光科。

words.definition: the use of painting, drawing,  sculpture  etc to represent things or express ideas; beaux-arts, artwork; artistic; are, am
words.translation: 艺术，美术；技术；艺术；美术；艺术品；艺术的；艺术品的；是（be的变体）

examples.en: the Museum of Modern Art in New York
examples.zh: 纽约现代艺术博物馆

examples.en: an example of early Indian art
examples.zh: 印度早期艺术的范例

words.definition: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine; item, provision, clause
words.translation: 文章；条款；物品；[法]条款；[语]冠词

examples.en: The paper’s leading article (=  the main article  ) described the government as weak.
examples.zh: 该报社论称政府软弱。

examples.en: newspaper articles
examples.zh: 报纸上的文章

words.definition: not real or not made of natural things but made to be like something that is real or natural; synthetic, false, simulated, arbitrary
words.translation: 人工的；娇揉造作的；人造的；[自]仿造的；虚伪的；非原产地的；武断的

examples.en: artificial flowers
examples.zh: 假花

examples.en: artificial light
examples.zh: 人造光

examples.en: artificial fertilizers
examples.zh: 化肥

words.definition: someone who produces art, especially paintings or drawings; pope, maestro
words.translation: 艺术家，美术家；艺术家；美术家（尤指画家）；大师

examples.en: an exhibition of paintings by local artists
examples.zh: 当地画家的画展

words.definition: while or when; because, although, since, for, seeing; in the light of, like; equally, similarly, same, likewise
words.translation: 当…的时候；因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时；如同；当作；以…的身份；同样地；和…一样的

examples.en: I saw Peter as I was getting off the bus.
examples.zh: 我下公共汽车的时候看见了彼得。

examples.en: As time passed, things seemed to get worse.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，情况似乎变得更加糟糕了。

examples.en: Just as the two men were leaving, a message arrived.
examples.zh: 那两个男子刚要离开，消息就传来了。

words.definition: the soft grey powder that remains after something has been burned; ember
words.translation: 灰，灰末；骨灰；[化学][矿物]灰；灰烬

examples.en: cigarette ash
examples.zh: 香烟灰

examples.en: The house burnt to ashes.
examples.zh: 那房子烧成了灰烬。

words.definition: feeling very sorry and embarrassed because of something you have done; compunctious
words.translation: 害羞的；惭愧的，感到难为情的；耻于……的

examples.en: Everyone cries sometimes – it’s nothing to be ashamed of.
examples.zh: 每个人都会有哭的时候——没什么好难为情的。

words.translation: 亚洲

examples.en: The European powers extended their authority in Asia.
examples.zh: 欧洲列强在亚洲扩大他们的管辖权。

examples.en: The teacher chalked out a map of Asia on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老师用粉笔在黑板上画了一张亚洲地图。

examples.en: His extensive experience in other parts of Asia helped him to overcome cultural barriers.
examples.zh: 在亚洲其他地区的广泛经历帮助他克服了文化障碍。

words.definition: from or relating to Asia, especially India or Pakistan; someone from Asia, or whose family originally came from Asia, especially India or Pakistan
words.translation: 亚洲的；亚洲人

examples.en: The financial crisis devitalized the economy of the Asian countries.
examples.zh: 这次金融危机使亚洲国家的经济大伤元气。

examples.en: The government predicates that the market collapse was caused by Asian financial crisis.
examples.zh: 政府宣布市场不景气是由于亚洲金融危机而引起的。

words.definition: moved to one side or away from you; away from, alongside; voice-over, whisper; at the side of
words.translation: 在旁边，到旁边；离开，撇开；在旁边；旁白；私语，悄悄话；离题的话；在…旁边

examples.en: He pushed his half-eaten salad aside and left.
examples.zh: 他推开吃了一半的色拉走了。

examples.en: He stepped aside to let Katherine go in first.
examples.zh: 他站到一边让凯瑟琳先进去。

examples.en: Mark drew me aside and explained the problem.
examples.zh: 马克把我拉到一边给我解释这个问题。

words.definition: to speak or write to someone in order to get an answer, information, or a solution; invite, lack, question, desire, exact; question, query
words.translation: 问；要求；邀请；问，询问；需要；讨价

examples.en: ‘What’s your name?’ she asked.
examples.zh: “你叫什么名字？”她问道 。

examples.en: Don’t ask him – he won’t know.
examples.zh: 别问他，他不知道。

examples.en: That kid’s always asking awkward questions .
examples.zh: 那孩子总是问一些尴尬的问题。

words.definition: sleeping; sleeping, stupid
words.translation: 睡着的，睡熟的；睡着的；麻木的；长眠的

examples.en: Quiet! The baby’s asleep.
examples.zh: 安静！ 宝宝在睡觉。

words.definition: one part of a situation, idea, plan etc that has many parts; direction, orientation, situation, side, respect
words.translation: 方面；样子，外表；[建]方向；形势；外貌

examples.en: a south-facing aspect
examples.zh: 朝南方向

words.definition: to make a judgment about a person or situation after thinking carefully about it; evaluate, rate, value, prize
words.translation: 评价；评定；估价；对…征税

examples.en: The test was to assess aptitude rather than academic achievement.
examples.zh: 该测试将评估能力而不是学业成绩。

words.definition: a process in which you make a judgment about a person or situation, or the judgment you make; appraisal, evaluation, valuation, estimate
words.translation: 评估，评价；评定；[税收]估价

examples.en: a reading assessment test
examples.zh: 阅读评估测试

words.definition: to help someone to do something
words.translation: 援助，帮助；搀扶

examples.en: The family decided to assist me with my chores.
examples.zh: 家人决定分担我的琐事。

words.definition: help or support; aid, hand, help, boost
words.translation: 协助， 援助；援助，帮助；辅助设备

examples.en: We offer financial assistance to students.
examples.zh: 我们向学生提供经济援助。

examples.en: Can I be of any assistance (=  can I help you  ) ?
examples.zh: 我能帮什么忙吗？

words.definition: someone who helps someone else in their work, especially by doing the less important jobs; friend, aid, mate, helper; helpful, useful, subsidiary, auxiliary, aided
words.translation: 助手，助理；助教；助手，[管理]助理，助教；[纺]辅助的，[管理]助理的；有帮助的

examples.en: a clerical assistant
examples.zh: 文书助理

words.definition: to make a connection in your mind between one thing or person and another; company, travel, sort, mix; brother, partner, fellow, comrade, colleague; combine; deputy, linked, vice, joint, auxiliary
words.translation: 交往；把……联系起来；结交；[管理]同事，伙伴；关联的事物；联想；使联合；使发生联系；副的；联合的

examples.en: Through science we've got the idea of associating progress with the future.
examples.zh: 通过科学我们已有了将进步与未来联系起来的观念。

words.definition: an organization that consists of a group of people who have the same aims, do the same kind of work etc; union, alliance, society, corporation, unity, combination
words.translation: 协会，团体；联合；协会，联盟，社团；[心理]联想

examples.en: the Association of Master Builders
examples.zh: 建筑师协会

words.definition: to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof; undertake, adopt, accept, shoulder, sustain; attitudinize, put on the dog
words.translation: 假定，认为；承担；假定；采取；呈现；装腔作势；多管闲事

examples.en: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
examples.zh: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

examples.en: When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
examples.zh: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

words.definition: something that you think is true although you have no definite proof; conception, perhaps, if
words.translation: 假定，假设；假定；设想；担任；采取

examples.en: You would be making an assumption that's not based on any fact that you could report.
examples.zh: 你会做出不以你能报道的任何事实为依据的一种假设。

words.definition: to surprise someone very much; emmarvel, gast
words.translation: 使惊讶，使大为吃惊；使惊讶

examples.en: Her reply astonished me.
examples.zh: 她的回答让我大吃一惊。
