examples.zh: 他很早醒来，这是他的习惯。

words.definition: someone who buys goods or services from a shop, company etc; client, apple, consumer, fellow, egg
words.translation: 顾客，主顾；[贸易]顾客；家伙

examples.en: We aim to offer good value and service to all our customers.
examples.zh: 我们力求为所有的客户提供物有所值的商品和服务。

examples.en: We’ve had several letters from satisfied customers.
examples.zh: 我们收到了几封顾客表示满意的来信。

examples.en: He’s one of our regular customers .
examples.zh: 他是我们的一个老主顾。

words.definition: Customs is the official organization responsible for collecting taxes on goods coming into a country and preventing illegal goods from being brought in; habits, duties
words.translation: 关税， 进口税；海关；风俗（custom的复数）；习惯；关税

examples.en: What right does Customs have to search my car?
examples.zh: 海关有什么权力搜查我的车？

words.definition: to reduce the amount of something; shorten, bite; intersect; wound, incision; reduced, scrimpy
words.translation: 切，割，剪；减少；削减；[机]切割；缩短；刺痛；相交；切牌；停拍；不出席；伤口；切口；（服装等的）式样；削球；缩减的；割下的；雕过的

examples.en: They’re introducing CCTV cameras in an attempt to cut street crime in the area.
examples.zh: 为了减少该地区的街头犯罪，他们安装了闭路电视摄像机。

examples.en: You need to cut the amount of fat and sugar in your diet.
examples.zh: 你需要减少饮食中脂肪和糖的摄入量。

examples.en: Scientists are warning that unless carbon emissions are cut, we could be heading for an environmental catastrophe.
examples.zh: 科学家警告说如果不减少碳排放量，我们可能会面临环境灾难。

words.definition: a number of related events that happen again and again in the same order; circle, revolution, rotation, round, bike; circulate; circumrotate, ride a bike
words.translation: n自行车，循环；循环；周期；[车辆]自行车；整套；一段时间；使循环；使轮转；[车辆]骑自行车；轮转

examples.en: a woman’s menstrual cycle
examples.zh: 女性的月经周期

words.translation: 骑自行车的人
爸爸；爹爹

words.definition: happening or done every day; a newspaper that is printed and sold every day, or every day except Sunday; everyday, household, routine; journal; habitually, diurnally
words.translation: 每日的；日报；日常的；朝来夜去的女佣；日常地；每日；天天

examples.en: daily flights to Miami
examples.zh: 每日飞往迈阿密的航班

words.definition: a special wall built across a river or stream to stop the water from flowing, especially in order to make a lake or produce electricity; control over, take control of; bar, obstacle, let, stop
words.translation: 水坝，水堤；障碍物；控制；筑坝；[水利]水坝；障碍

examples.en: Before the dam was built, Campbell River used to flood in the spring.
examples.zh: 大坝建好之前，坎贝尔河常在春季发大水。

words.definition: to cause physical harm to something or to part of someone’s body; physical harm that is done to something or to a part of someone’s body, so that it is broken or injured; do harm to, let in for; injury, harm, lesion; destroy, hurt, blast
words.translation: 损害，毁坏；损害；损毁；赔偿金

examples.en: insects that damage crops
examples.zh: 破坏庄稼的昆虫

words.definition: slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way; control, stay, restrain; moisturize; moisture, humidity, wet; wet, humid, moisty
words.translation: 潮湿的，有湿气的；[气象][物]使潮湿；使阻尼；使沮丧，抑制；减幅，阻尼；[气象][物]变潮湿；[气象][物]潮湿，湿气；[气象][物]潮湿的

examples.en: Wipe the leather with a damp cloth.
examples.zh: 用湿布擦拭皮面。

examples.en: a cold, damp day
examples.zh: 寒冷潮湿的一天

words.definition: to move your feet and body in a way that matches the style and speed of music; a special set of movements performed to a particular type of music; ball, nautch; flow, foot, jump, stream; jump, bound; orchestic, terpsichorean
words.translation: 跳舞；摇晃；舞；舞蹈；舞会；舞曲；跳跃；飘扬；使跳跃；舞蹈的；用于跳舞的

examples.en: Come on, let’s dance.
examples.zh: 来吧，我们跳舞吧。

words.definition: the possibility that someone or something will be harmed, destroyed, or killed; threat, risk, hazard
words.translation: 危险；危险事物；[安全]危险；危险物，威胁

examples.en: Danger! No boats beyond this point.
examples.zh: 危险！船只不可越过此处。

examples.en: The refugees believe that their lives are in danger .
examples.zh: 难民认为他们有生命危险。

words.definition: able or likely to harm or kill you; critical, risky, threatening, precarious, perilous
words.translation: 危险的，不安全的；危险的

examples.en: laws about dangerous dogs
examples.zh: 有关危险犬类的法律

examples.en: Some of these prisoners are extremely dangerous.
examples.zh: 这些囚犯中有些极为危险。

examples.en: The powdered milk was not as good as breast milk, and was downright dangerous (= actually dangerous ) when it was mixed with unclean water.
examples.zh: 奶粉没有母乳好，用不洁净的水冲调更会造成危险。

words.definition: to be brave enough to do something that is risky or that you are afraid to do – used especially in questions or negative sentences; challenge, defi; make bold to
words.translation: v敢；竟敢；挑战；挑动；敢；胆敢

examples.en: He wanted to ask her, but he didn’t dare.
examples.zh: 他想问她，但又不敢。

examples.en: ‘I’ll tell Dad.’ ‘You wouldn’t dare!’
examples.zh: “我要告诉爸爸。” “谅你也不敢！”

words.definition: if it is dark, there is little or no light; fuzzy, blue, empty, gloomy; night, gloominess
words.translation: 暗的；黑色的；黑暗的，深色的；模糊的；无知的；忧郁的；黑暗；夜；黄昏；模糊

examples.en: The church was dark and quiet.
examples.zh: 教堂里黑魆魆的，寂静无声。

examples.en: the dark winter days
examples.zh: 阴暗的冬日

examples.en: Suddenly, the room went dark (= became dark ) .
examples.zh: 房间突然变暗了。

words.definition: when there is no light; night, ignorance
words.translation: 黑暗,漆黑；黑暗；模糊；无知；阴郁

examples.en: the long hours of darkness during winter
examples.zh: 冬季漫长的黑夜

examples.en: We lit our campfire as darkness fell (= it became night ) .
examples.zh: 夜幕降临，我们点起了篝火。

examples.en: He stared out the window at the gathering darkness (= the night slowly coming ) .
examples.zh: 他凝视着窗外渐浓的夜色。

words.definition: If you dash somewhere, you run or go there quickly and suddenly; an occasion when someone runs somewhere very quickly in order to get away from something or someone, or in order to reach them; jerking motion; discomfit; knock against, impinge on
words.translation: 使猛撞；溅；猛冲；破折号；冲撞；使…破灭；猛撞；泼溅；撞击

examples.en: Suddenly she dashed down to the cellar.
examples.zh: 她猛地朝地窖冲过去。

words.definition: information or facts
words.translation: 数据;；资料

examples.en: The research involves collecting data from two random samples.
examples.zh: 该项研究需要从两个随机样本里收集资料。

words.definition: a large amount of data stored in a computer system so that you can find and use it easily; dbase, informix
words.translation: 数据库；[计]数据库，资料库

examples.en: customer details held on a database
examples.zh: 存储在数据库内的客户详细信息

words.definition: a particular day of the month or year, especially shown by a number; to write or print the date on something; era, years, engagement; get out of fashion, out of season
words.translation: 日期；注…日期；约会；年代；枣椰子；过时；注明日期；始于（某一历史时期）

examples.en: The date on the letter was 30th August 1962.
examples.zh: 信上的日期是1962年8月30日。

examples.en: What’s today’s date?
examples.zh: 今天几号？

words.definition: someone’s female child; girl, dau.
words.translation: 女儿；[遗][农学]子代

examples.en: She’s got two daughters and one son.
examples.zh: 她有两个女儿和一个儿子。

examples.en: our eldest daughter
examples.zh: 我们的长女

words.definition: the time at the beginning of the day when light first appears; if day or morning dawns, it begins; morning, origin; come out, break of day
words.translation: 黎明；开端；破晓；[天]黎明；出现；被领悟

examples.en: When dawn broke (= the first light of the day appeared ) , we were still 50 miles from Calcutta.
examples.zh: 破晓的时候，我们离加尔各答还有50英里。

examples.en: I was up at the crack of dawn (= very early in the morning ) to get the plane.
examples.zh: 我一大早就起来赶飞机。

examples.en: We worked from dawn to dusk (= through the whole day while it is light ) .
examples.zh: 我们从早干到晚。

words.definition: the period of time between when it gets light in the morning and when it gets dark; period, season, page; day-to-day
words.translation: (一)天，白昼，白天；一天；时期；白昼；日间的；逐日的

examples.en: She only leaves her house during the day.
examples.zh: 她只在白天出门。

examples.en: It was a cold blustery day.
examples.zh: 那是个寒风呼啸的冷天。

examples.en: Kept in that dark cell, I could no longer tell whether it was day or night.
examples.zh: 我被关在那个漆黑的牢房里，不知是白天还是黑夜。

words.definition: the light produced by the sun during the day; morning, sunlight, publicity, open
words.translation: 白昼，日光；黎明；白天；[天]日光；公开

examples.en: The park is open to the public during daylight hours .
examples.zh: 公园白天对公众开放。

examples.en: If possible, it’s better to work in natural daylight.
examples.zh: 如果条件允许的话，最好在自然日光下工作。

words.definition: no longer alive; mechanical, wooden; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully; decedent, departed
words.translation: 死的，无生命的；无生命的；呆板的；废弃了的；完全地；死者

examples.en: Her mother had been dead for ten years.
examples.zh: 她母亲去世十年了。

examples.en: Police are trying to contact the family of the dead man.
examples.zh: 警方在设法与死者的家属联系。

examples.en: a pile of dead leaves
examples.zh: 一堆枯叶

words.definition: a date or time by which you have to do or complete something
words.translation: 最后期限

examples.en: I’m always working under pressure to meet deadlines (= finish something on time ) .
examples.zh: 我总是在赶工期的压力下工作。

words.definition: physically unable to hear anything or unable to hear well; dunny
words.translation: 聋的；不愿听的

examples.en: communication between deaf and hearing people
examples.zh: 失聪者和听力正常者之间的交流

examples.en: I think Mum’s going a bit deaf .
examples.zh: 我觉得妈妈有点耳聋了。

examples.en: She’s deaf and dumb (= unable to hear or speak ) and communicates using sign language.
examples.zh: 她又聋又哑，用手语交流。

words.definition: treatment of a particular type that is given or received; afford, allow, extend, deliver, part; manage, debate, cope with; policy, business, trade, truck
words.translation: 买卖；待遇；给予；处理；分配；发牌；讨论；对待；做生意；[贸易]交易；（美）政策；份量

examples.en: The prime minister promised farmers a new deal (= a new and fairer system ) .
examples.zh: 首相向农民保证推行一项新政策。

words.definition: used before someone’s name or title to begin a letter; used to show that you are surprised, upset, or annoyed because something bad has happened; loving, expensive, rich, costly; oh, my, ohone; machree
words.translation: 亲爱的；啊；尊敬的；昂贵的；哎呀；亲爱的人

examples.en: Dear Sir or Madam, ...
examples.zh: 尊敬的先生或女士，…

examples.en: Dear Mrs. Wilson, ...
examples.zh: 尊敬的威尔逊夫人，…

examples.en: Dear Meg, ...
examples.zh: 亲爱的梅格，…

words.definition: a creature that looks like a human  skeleton  , used in paintings, stories etc to represent the fact that people die; destruction, dying
words.translation: 死，死亡；灭亡；死；[医]死亡；死神；毁灭

examples.en: 1.5 million people are in immediate danger of death from starvation.
examples.zh: 150万人正因饥饿而即将面临死亡的危险。

words.definition: discussion of a particular subject that often continues for a long time and in which people express different opinions; reason, dispute about; deal, pro-and-con; dispute, controversy
words.translation: 争论，辩论；[法]辩论，争论，讨论；[法]辩论；辩论会

examples.en: the gun-control debate in the US
examples.zh: 美国有关控制枪支的争论

examples.en: The new drug has become the subject of heated debate within the medical profession.
examples.zh: 这种新药成了医学界激烈争论的话题。

examples.en: There was much lively debate about whether women should spend more time in the home.
examples.zh: 就妇女是否应该花更多时间待在家里这个话题有许多热烈的争论。

words.definition: a sum of money that a person or organization owes; liability, loan, borrowing
words.translation: 债务；借款；罪过

examples.en: He had enough money to pay off his outstanding debts.
examples.zh: 他有足够的钱偿还亏欠的债务。

examples.en: students who run up huge debts
examples.zh: 欠下巨额债务的学生

words.definition: a period of 10 years; decennium, dix
words.translation: 十年，十年期；十

examples.en: ...the last decade of the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: …19世纪的最后10年。

words.definition: the 12th month of the year, between November and January
words.translation: 十二月

examples.en: In the dark of December.
examples.zh: 在十二月的黑夜里。

examples.en: Our summers are short and our winters long.In December, when it is darkest, we only have a few hours of very weak sunlight per day.
examples.zh: 我们的夏天很短但是冬天很长，在十二月，也就是最黑的时候，我们的一天中只有很短的时间可以看到微弱的阳光。

examples.en: I send out Valentine’s cards with the girls’ photo, instead of trying to mail cards in December.
examples.zh: ——我寄出有女孩子照片的情人节贺卡，以代替试图在十二月寄出的贺卡。

words.definition: to make a choice or judgment about something, especially after considering all the possibilities or arguments; settle, condition, conclude; will, determine to
words.translation: 决定，决心；解决；决定；判决；决定，下决心

examples.en: Has anything been decided yet?
examples.zh: 已经作出什么决定了吗？

examples.en: The trainees decide among themselves what programs to take.
examples.zh: 受训者自行选择课程。

examples.en: After a long discussion, they decided in favour of (= chose ) the older applicant.
examples.zh: 经过长时间的讨论，他们决定选那位较年长的求职者。

words.definition: a choice or judgment that you make after a period of discussion or thought; determination, resolution, push, backbone
words.translation: 决定，决心；果断；决议

examples.en: Do you ever wonder if you made the right decision?
examples.zh: 你怀疑过自己所作的决定是否正确吗？

examples.en: The judges’ decision is final (= it will not be changed ) .
examples.zh: 法官的裁决是最终判决。

words.definition: to state officially and publicly that a particular situation exists or that something is true; bill, state; to announce, hand down
words.translation: 断言；声明；表明；宣布，声明；断言，宣称；声明，宣布

examples.en: A state of emergency has been declared.
examples.zh: 已宣布进入紧急状态。

examples.en: Mr Steel has been declared bankrupt
examples.zh: 斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。

examples.en: We celebrate September 16, the day when Mexico declared independence from Spain (= officially stated that it was no longer ruled by Spain ) .
examples.zh: 我们在9月16日举行庆祝活动，这一天是墨西哥摆脱西班牙统治宣布独立的日子。

words.definition: to decrease in quantity or importance; reduction, recession, fall; go down, slump; excuse oneself from
words.translation: 下降，减少；拒绝；下降；衰退；斜面；衰落；谢绝；婉拒

examples.en: Spending on information technology has declined.
examples.zh: 用于信息技术的支出减少了。

examples.en: Car sales have declined by a quarter.
examples.zh: 汽车销量下滑了四分之一。

examples.en: After the war, the city declined in importance.
examples.zh: 战后这座城市的重要性下降了。

words.definition: to paint the inside of a room, put special paper on the walls etc; paint, hang, make, post; set sth out, trick out
words.translation: 装饰；布置；授勋给

examples.en: The bathroom is decorated in green and yellow.
examples.zh: 浴室里是用绿色和黄色装潢的。

examples.en: We plan to spend the weekend decorating.
examples.zh: 我们计划用这个周末来装修。

words.definition: something pretty that you put in a place or on top of something to make it look attractive; medal, adornment
words.translation: 装饰(品)；[建][服装]装饰，装潢；装饰品；[劳经]奖章

examples.en: Christmas decorations
examples.zh: 圣诞节装饰物

examples.en: cake decorations
examples.zh: 蛋糕上的裱花

words.definition: to become less or go down to a lower level, or to make something do this; reduction, loss; to cut down, fall off; shorten, weaken
words.translation: 减少，减少；减少，减小；减少量

examples.en: The number of people who have the disease has decreased significantly in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，这种病的患者人数明显下降。

examples.en: They want to decrease their reliance on oil.
examples.zh: 他们想减少对石油的依赖。

words.definition: something someone does, especially something that is very good or very bad; action, letter, certificate, act
words.translation: 行为；功绩；契约；行动；证书；[法]契据

examples.en: After the morning’s good deeds he deserved a rest.
examples.zh: 上午做了好事之后，他理应休息一下。

examples.en: She tried to strangle her baby and her lover helped her finish the evil deed .
examples.zh: 她试图掐死自己的宝宝，她的情人帮着完成了这个罪恶的勾当。

words.definition: going far in from the outside or from the front edge of something; depths, gulf; abstract, recondite; late, home
words.translation: 深的；纵深的；深处；深渊；[地质]深的；低沉的；深奥的；深入地；深深地；迟

examples.en: a deep wound
examples.zh: 很深的伤口

examples.en: She was sitting in a deep leather chair.
examples.zh: 她坐在一张很深的皮椅子里。

words.translation: 深刻地；浓浓地；在深处

words.definition: a large wild animal that can run very fast, eats grass, and has horns
words.translation: 鹿

examples.en: The hunter wounded the deer.
examples.zh: 猎人打伤了鹿。

examples.en: The hound found the place where the deer lodged.
examples.zh: 猎狗找到了那头鹿躲藏过的地方。

examples.en: The lions in this area prey on deer and other wild animals.
examples.zh: 这个地方的狮子捕食鹿和其他野生动物。

words.definition: to win a victory over someone in a war, competition, game etc; down, get the best of; failure, loss, losing, reverse, collapse
words.translation: 战胜，击败；挫败；击败，战胜；使…失败；失败；战胜

examples.en: They hoped to defeat the enemy at sea.
examples.zh: 他们希望在海上击败敌人。

words.definition: to do something in order to protect someone or something from being attacked; to claim, forefend; hold position
words.translation: 保卫，防守；[法]辩护；防护；保卫；防守

examples.en: a struggle to defend our homeland
examples.zh: 保卫我们祖国的斗争

words.translation: 国防部,防卫

words.definition: to wait until a later time to do something; wait, hold over; hold over, stand over; raincheck, postponement
words.translation: 推迟，延期；延期；耽搁；被耽搁或推迟的时间

examples.en: Don’t delay – send off for the information now.
examples.zh: 别犹豫——即刻去函索取信息。

examples.en: He delayed his decision on whether to call an election.
examples.zh: 在是否宣布举行选举一事上，他推迟作出决定。

words.definition: to remove something that has been written down or stored in a computer; expurgate, prune away
words.translation: 删除；擦掉；[计]删除

examples.en: His name was deleted from the list.
examples.zh: 他的名字从名单上删掉了。

examples.en: I deleted the file by mistake.
examples.zh: 我误删了这个文件。

words.definition: done in a way that is intended or planned; intentionally, purposely
words.translation: 故意地；审慎地；谨慎地；慎重地

examples.en: He deliberately upset her.
examples.zh: 他故意惹她不开心。

examples.en: He shook his head slowly and deliberately.
examples.zh: 他缓缓而慎重地摇摇头。

words.definition: easily damaged or broken; subtle, female, refined, fine, fragile
words.translation: 纤细的；易碎的；微妙的；精美的，雅致的；柔和的；纤弱的；清淡可口的

examples.en: delicate hand-cut glass
examples.zh: 易碎的手工刻花玻璃

examples.en: The sun can easily damage a child’s delicate skin .
examples.zh: 阳光很容易晒伤小孩娇嫩的皮肤。

words.definition: very pleasant to taste or smell; palatable, delectable
words.translation: 美味的，怡人的；[食品]美味的；可口的

examples.en: ‘The meal was absolutely delicious,’ she said politely.
examples.zh: “这顿饭味道好极了。” 她礼貌地说道。

examples.en: the delicious smell of new-mown grass
examples.zh: 新修剪的草坪的芳香

words.definition: a feeling of great pleasure and satisfaction; joy, cheerfulness; pleasure, be pleased; glad, pleasure, satisfy
words.translation: 高兴；使高兴

examples.en: Throughout the house, the views are a constant source of surprise and delight.
examples.zh: 整个房子，目之所及不停带来惊奇和欣喜。

words.translation: 高兴的；欣喜的；使…兴高采烈；感到快乐（delight的过去分词）

words.definition: to make a speech etc to a lot of people; afford, allow, extend, deal, free; come true, come to pass
words.translation: 发表；交付；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生；实现；传送；履行；投递

examples.en: The king delivered a televised speech to the nation on November 5.
examples.zh: 国王在11月5日向全国发表了电视讲话。

words.definition: the need or desire that people have for particular goods and services; exact, lack, desire, call for; wish, have need of; necessity, need, do, desire, want
words.translation: 需求，要求；要求；需要；查询；[计]请求；查问；[经]需求

examples.en: Production is still increasing faster than demand.
examples.zh: 生产仍比需求增长快。

words.definition: someone whose job is to treat people’s teeth; dental surgeon
words.translation: 牙科医生

examples.en: Visit your dentist twice a year for a checkup.
examples.zh: 每年看两次牙医做检查。

words.definition: one of the groups of people who work together in a particular part of a large organization such as a hospital, university, company, or government; ministry, division, bureau, sector
words.translation: 部门；部；[管理]部门；系；科；局

examples.en: the personnel department
examples.zh: 人事部

examples.en: the English department
examples.zh: 英语系

words.definition: an act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey; leaving, starting, violation, breach, quit
words.translation: 离开，出发，起程；离开；出发；违背

examples.en: There are several departures for New York every day.
examples.zh: 每天有好几个班次去纽约。

words.definition: If you depend on someone or something, you need them in order to be able to survive physically, financially, or emotionally; hope, tie to
words.translation: 依靠，依赖；相信；依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖

examples.en: He depended on his writing for his income.
examples.zh: 他靠写作谋生。

words.definition: to put something down in a particular place; fund, saving, covers, sludge, precipitation; trust in, trust with; settle, to precipitate
words.translation: 使沉淀；存放；存款；[金融]保证金；[地质][电]沉淀物；[地质]使沉积；[电]沉淀

examples.en: The female deposits her eggs directly into the water.
examples.zh: 雌性把卵直接产在水中。

words.definition: the part that is furthest away from people, and most difficult to reach; profoundity, deepness
words.translation: 深度；深厚；深处；[海洋]深度；深奥

examples.en: Astronomers may one day travel to the depths of space.
examples.zh: 天文学家也许有一天可以到太空深处去。

words.definition: to say what something or someone is like by giving details about them; represent, trace, figure, depict
words.translation: 形容；描写，描绘；描述，形容；描绘

examples.en: The police asked her to describe the man.
examples.zh: 警察叫她描述一下那名男子。

examples.en: Another approach to the problem is described in Chapter 3.
examples.zh: 这个问题的另一种解决方法在第三章有所阐述。

words.definition: a piece of writing or speech that gives details about what someone or something is like; presentation, type, style, characterization
words.translation: 描写，形容；种类；描述，描写；类型；说明书

examples.en: The booklet gives a brief description of each place.
examples.zh: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

examples.en: Berlin sounds fascinating from your description.
examples.zh: 从你的描述来看，柏林是个迷人的城市。

words.definition: to leave someone or something and no longer help or support them; yield, quit; run out on, walk out on; sands, wold; wild, hungry
words.translation: 抛弃；遗弃；放弃；逃跑；开小差；逃掉；[地理]沙漠；[农]荒原；应得的赏罚；[地理]沙漠的；荒凉的；不毛的

examples.en: Helen was deserted by her husband.
examples.zh: 海伦被丈夫遗弃了。

examples.en: Many of the party’s traditional voters deserted it at the last election.
examples.zh: 许多长期支持该党的选民在上一次选举中抛弃了它。

examples.en: The price rise caused many readers to desert the magazine.
examples.zh: 价格上涨导致许多读者放弃了这本杂志。

words.definition: to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour; be deserving of
words.translation: 值得；应受，应得

examples.en: What have I done to deserve this?
examples.zh: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

examples.en: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
examples.zh: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

examples.en: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
examples.zh: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

words.definition: to make a drawing or plan of something that will be made or built; the art or process of making a drawing of something to show how you will make it or what it will look like; project, engineer, style, schedule, frame; programming, device, pattern; project, engineer
words.translation: 设计；图样；计划；构思；图案

examples.en: The tower was designed by Gilbert Scott.
examples.zh: 这座塔楼是吉尔伯特·斯科特设计的。

words.definition: a strong hope or wish; requirement, wants, do, need, wish; feel like, wanna, require, mean, exact; rare, aspire, long for, yearn for, die for
words.translation: 渴望，欲望；欲望；要求，心愿；性欲；想要；要求；希望得到…；渴望

examples.en: female sexual desire
examples.zh: 女性的性欲

words.definition: willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger; venturous, devil-may-care
words.translation: 拼死的；绝望的；不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的

examples.en: I had no money left and was desperate.
examples.zh: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

examples.en: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
examples.zh: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

examples.en: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
examples.zh: 失踪少年绝望的父母

words.definition: sweet food served after the main part of a meal
words.translation: 甜点

examples.en: She had homemade ice cream for dessert.
examples.zh: 她吃了些自制冰淇淋当餐后甜点。

words.definition: the place that someone or something is going to; goal, end-point
words.translation: 目的地，终点；目标；[计]目的地，终点

examples.en: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
examples.zh: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

words.definition: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists or cannot be used or repaired; undermine, founder
words.translation: 破坏；消灭；打破；毁坏

examples.en: companies that are polluting and destroying the environment
examples.zh: 污染和破坏环境的公司

words.definition: a police officer whose job is to discover information about crimes and catch criminals; tec, hawkshaw
words.translation: 侦探

examples.en: She hired a detective to find out if her husband was having an affair.
examples.zh: 她雇了一个私人侦探调查她丈夫是否有外遇。

words.definition: decision, resolution, push, backbone
words.translation: 意志；决心；果断

words.definition: if something determines something else, it directly influences or decides it; condition, conclude; identify, drop, finish, judge
words.translation: 决定；下决心；判决；使…下定决心；确定；判决，终止

examples.en: The amount of available water determines the number of houses that can be built.
examples.zh: 可用的水量决定可以建造多少房子。

examples.en: The age of a wine is a determining factor as to how it tastes.
examples.zh: 酒的年份对于酒的味道是个决定性因素。

words.definition: to grow or change into something bigger, stronger, or more advanced, or to make someone or something do this; exploit, open up; grow, flower
words.translation: 发展；形成；开发；进步；使成长；使显影；发育；生长；进化；显露

examples.en: Knowledge in the field of genetics has been developing very rapidly.
examples.zh: 遗传学领域的知识发展非常迅速。

examples.en: Corsica has developed its economy around the tourist industry.
examples.zh: 科西嘉岛的经济是围绕旅游业发展起来的。

examples.en: exercises to develop muscle strength
examples.zh: 锻炼肌肉力量的运动

words.definition: the process of gradually becoming bigger, better, stronger, or more advanced; exploitation, growth, making, advance, progress
words.translation: 发展；开发；生长；[生物]发育；[建]住宅小区（专指由同一开发商开发的）；[摄]显影

examples.en: child development
examples.zh: 儿童发育

words.definition: to use all or most of your time, effort etc in order to do something or help someone; commit oneself to, bend oneself to
words.translation: 奉献，致力于；致力于；奉献

examples.en: He decided to devote the rest of his life to scientific investigation.
examples.zh: 他决定把余生奉献给科学研究。

words.definition: the loyalty that you show towards a person, job etc, especially by working hard; commitment, dedication, loyalty
words.translation: 献身， 奉献；忠实；热爱；虔诚；献身，奉献；忠诚

examples.en: At first she was flattered by his devotion.
examples.zh: 最初他的挚爱使她感到受宠若惊。

words.definition: a simple drawing or plan that shows exactly where something is, what something looks like, or how something works; chart, graph
words.translation: 图解，图表，简图；图表；[数]图解

words.definition: the round part of a clock, watch, machine etc that has numbers that show you the time or a measurement; to press the buttons or turn the dial on a telephone in order to make a telephone call; rotating disc, turntable
words.translation: 钟面；拨号盘；拨；转盘；[仪]刻度盘

examples.en: The lighted dial of her watch said 1.20.
examples.zh: 她手表上的夜光表面显示时间为1点20分。

examples.en: She looked at the dial to check her speed.
examples.zh: 她看了看仪表盘，以确认自己的速度。

words.definition: a conversation in a book, play, or film; sesion, interlocution
words.translation: 对话；意见交换

examples.en: a boring movie full of bad dialog
examples.zh: 充满差劲对白的乏味电影

examples.en: Students were asked to read simple dialogues out loud.
examples.zh: 学生被要求大声朗读简单的对话。

words.definition: a clear, very hard valuable stone, used in jewellery and in industry; sparkler, adamas; rhombic
words.translation: 金钢石，钻石；菱形；[宝]钻石，[矿物]金刚石；[数]菱形；方块牌；[数]菱形的；金刚钻的

examples.en: a diamond engagement ring
examples.zh: 订婚钻戒

words.definition: a book in which you write down the things that happen to you each day; journal, day book
words.translation: 日记，日记簿；日志，日记；日记簿

examples.en: Inge kept a diary (= wrote in a diary ) during the war years.
examples.zh: 英奇在战争年代里一直写日记。

words.definition: when you say words for someone to write down; instruction, bidding, order, word, charge
words.translation: 口授笔录，听写；听写；口述；命令

examples.en: There were no secretaries available to take dictation (= write down what someone is saying ) .
examples.zh: 身边没有秘书记录口授内容。

words.definition: a book that gives a list of words in alphabetical order and explains their meanings in the same language, or another language; lexicon, wordbook
words.translation: 词典，字典；字典；[语][计]词典

examples.en: a German-English dictionary
examples.zh: 一本德英词典

words.definition: to stop living and become dead; go out, angel of death; join the majority, end one's days; former block, cutting block
words.translation: 死，死亡；灭亡；死亡；凋零；熄灭；死，死于…；[机]冲模，钢模；骰子

examples.en: He died in 1985 at the age of 76.
examples.zh: 他1985年去世，终年76岁。

examples.en: Her father died suddenly in an accident when she was only ten.
examples.zh: 她年仅10岁时父亲突然死于一场意外事故。

examples.en: She died peacefully in her sleep at the age of 98.
examples.zh: 她在睡眠中安然辞世，享年98岁。

words.definition: the kind of food that a person or animal eats each day; eating, food and drink
words.translation: 日常饮食，日常食物；[食品]饮食；食物；[医]规定饮食

examples.en: She doesn’t eat a very healthy diet.
examples.zh: 她的饮食不是很健康。

examples.en: It is important to have a balanced diet.
examples.zh: 饮食均衡很重要。

examples.en: Rice is the staple diet (= the main food that a group of people usually eat ) .
examples.zh: 大米是主食。

words.definition: to be different from something in some way; divide
words.translation: 不同，相异；相异；意见分歧

examples.en: The two systems differ in many respects.
examples.zh: 这两个系统在许多方面不同。

examples.en: Experts have differing views on the subject.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上专家们意见不同。

words.definition: a way in which two or more people or things are not like each other; diversity, conflict, disparity, deviations
words.translation: 差别；差；分歧；差异；不同；争执

examples.en: (= there’s a very big difference ) between us.
examples.zh: 我们之间有着天壤之别。

words.definition: not like something or someone else, or not like before; diverse, unlike, unusual, individual, varying
words.translation: 差异的；各种的；不同的；个别的，与众不同的

examples.en: The place looks completely different now.
examples.zh: 这地方现在完全变了。

examples.en: They decided to try a radically different approach.
examples.zh: 他们决定尝试一种全然不同的办法。

examples.en: We found women had significantly different political views from men.
examples.zh: 我们发现女性的政治观点与男性大不相同。

words.definition: hard to do, understand, or deal with; hard, tough
words.translation: 困难的；难对付的；不随和的；执拗的

examples.en: a difficult question
examples.zh: 难解的问题

examples.en: an immensely difficult task
examples.zh: 极为艰巨的任务

examples.en: Was the exam very difficult?
examples.zh: 这次考试很难吗？

words.definition: poverty, corner, hardness, dilemma, fix
words.translation: 困难；难事；困境；困难，困境

words.definition: to move earth, snow etc, or to make a hole in the ground, using a  spade  or your hands; tunnel, pick; tap into; spine, thrust
words.translation: 掘，挖；采掘；挖，掘；探究；挖掘；戳，刺；挖苦

examples.en: freshly dug carrots
examples.zh: 刚挖出来的胡萝卜

words.definition: to change food that you have just eaten into substances that your body can use; a short piece of writing that gives the most important facts from a book, report etc; absorb, drink in; abstract, brief, summary, resume
words.translation: 消化；领会；文摘；吸收；融会贯通；摘要

examples.en: Most babies can digest a wide range of food easily.
examples.zh: 大多数婴儿能轻易地消化很多种食物。

words.definition: using a system in which information is recorded or sent out electronically in the form of numbers, usually ones and zeros; numerical; figure, key, number
words.translation: 数字的，计数的；数字的；手指的；数字；键

examples.en: digital TV
examples.zh: 数字电视

examples.en: a digital signal
examples.zh: 数字信号

examples.en: a digital camera
examples.zh: 数码照相机

words.definition: the ability to behave in a calm controlled way even in a difficult situation; sanctity, nobility
words.translation: 庄重；尊严；体面；高贵

examples.en: We do this because we believe in the dignity and value of every person.
examples.zh: 我们这样做是因为我们相信每个人的尊严和价值。

examples.en: They have to be treated well, with dignity.
examples.zh: 必须善待申请人，让人有尊严。

examples.en: This award must be shared with everyone who strives for justice and dignity.
examples.zh: 我一定要与所有为正义和尊严奋斗的人分享此奖。

words.definition: a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what to do, because all the choices seem equally good or equally bad; difficulty, corner, fix, predicament
words.translation: 困境；进退两难；两刀论法

examples.en: a moral dilemma
examples.zh: 道德上进退两难的窘境

examples.en: This placed Robert Kennedy in a dilemma.
examples.zh: 这让罗伯特·肯尼迪陷入了两难的境地。

examples.en: Many women are faced with the dilemma of choosing between work and family commitments.
examples.zh: 许多女性面临着出去工作还是照顾家庭的两难境地。

words.definition: the length, height, width, depth, or  diameter  of something; measurement, size
words.translation: 尺寸，尺度；面积；[数]维；尺寸；次元；容积

examples.en: a rectangle with the dimensions 5cm × 2cm
examples.zh: 长五厘米、宽两厘米的长方形

words.definition: to eat dinner; have a dinner, have meals; banquet, feast
words.translation: 吃饭；进餐，用餐；宴请

examples.en: He was dining with friends at the Ritz.
examples.zh: 他和朋友在里茨饭店一起进餐。

words.definition: the main meal of the day, eaten in the middle of the day or the evening; supper, evening meal
words.translation: 正餐，主餐；宴会；晚餐，晚宴；正餐

examples.en: What time do you usually have dinner?
examples.zh: 你通常什么时候吃饭？

examples.en: We’re having fish for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我们今天晚饭吃鱼。

examples.en: What’s for dinner?
examples.zh: 晚饭吃什么？

words.definition: one of a group of  reptile s  that lived millions of years ago
words.translation: 恐龙；过时的人或事物

examples.en: lengthy speeches by some of the party’s dinosaurs
examples.zh: 该政党那些老古董冗长的发言

words.definition: a chemical compound that contains two atoms of oxygen and one atom of another chemical element
words.translation: 二氧化物

examples.en: carbon/sulphur dioxide
examples.zh: 二氧化碳／硫

words.definition: to put something into a liquid and lift it out again; steep, dunk; decline, pitch, slope, swim; reduction, decline, slope, fall, subsidence
words.translation: 浸，蘸；浸一浸；浸，泡，蘸；舀取；把伸入；浸；下降，下沉；倾斜；舀，掏；下沉，下降；浸渍，蘸湿

examples.en: Dip each apple in the syrup until thickly coated.
examples.zh: 把每个苹果在糖浆里蘸一下，直到被厚厚地裹上糖浆。

words.definition: a document showing that a student has successfully completed their  high school  or university education; graduation certificate, leaving certificate
words.translation: 文凭；毕业证书，学位证书；公文，文书；奖状

examples.en: ...a new two-year course leading to a diploma in social work.
examples.zh: ...一门可以获得社会工作文凭的2年制的新课程。

words.definition: done without any other people, actions, processes etc coming between; immediate, right; manage, conduct, run, officer, control; supervise, to command; immediately, straight, just, fair
words.translation: 直接的；直率的；直系的；亲身的；恰好的；管理；指挥；导演；指向；指导；直接地；正好；按直系关系

examples.en: Experienced users have direct access to the main data files.
examples.zh: 高级用户可直接浏览主数据文档。

examples.en: I’m not in direct contact with them.
examples.zh: 我和他们没有直接的联系。

examples.en: Few policy-makers have had direct experience of business.
examples.zh: 决策者几乎都没有直接的从商经历。

words.definition: someone who controls or manages a company; co-director, boss-man
words.translation: 指导者；理事；导演；主任，[管理]主管；[电影]导演；人事助理

examples.en: The company is run by a board of directors (= a group of directors ) .
examples.zh: 这家公司由董事会管理。

words.definition: a book or list of names, facts etc, usually arranged in alphabetical order; content, list, catalogue; consulting, advisory
words.translation: 姓名地址录；[计]目录；工商名录；指导的；咨询的

examples.en: I couldn’t find your number in the telephone directory.
examples.zh: 我在电话簿上找不到你的电话号码。

examples.en: a new business directory
examples.zh: 新的商业名录

words.definition: any substance that makes things dirty, such as mud or dust; earth, dust, clay, powder
words.translation: 尘，土；污物，污垢；污垢，泥土；灰尘，尘土；下流话

examples.en: You should have seen the dirt on that car!
examples.zh: 你没看见那车上沾了多少泥！

examples.en: His face and hands were black with dirt.
examples.zh: 他的脸和手黑乎乎的，全是泥。

examples.en: a patch of grass, covered in dog dirt
examples.zh: 满是狗屎的一小片草地

words.definition: covered in or marked by an unwanted substance; poor, mean, blue, base, gross; soil; soil, mud, spot
words.translation: 脏的；下流的；下流的，卑鄙的；污秽的；恶劣的；暗淡的；变脏；弄脏

examples.en: a stack of dirty dishes in the sink
examples.zh: 洗涤槽里的一堆脏碟子

examples.en: How did you get so dirty?
examples.zh: 你怎么会弄得这么脏？

words.definition: A disability is a permanent injury, illness, or physical or mental condition that tends to restrict the way that someone can live their life; physical disabilities, drawback
words.translation: 无力, 残疾；残疾；无能；无资格；不利条件

examples.en: Facilities for people with disabilities are still insufficient.
examples.zh: 供残疾人使用的设施仍然不足。

words.translation: 残废的，有缺陷的；使…失去能力（disable的过去分词）

words.definition: something that causes problems, or that makes someone or something less likely to be successful or effective; defect, deficiency, vice, losing, expense
words.translation: 不利情况，缺点；缺点；不利条件；损失

examples.en: Criminal behaviour can be linked to economic disadvantage.
examples.zh: 犯罪行为可能会与经济困难有关。

words.definition: to have or express a different opinion from someone else; conflict, to disapprove of
words.translation: 有分歧；不一致；不同意；争执；不适宜

examples.en: Barr strongly disagreed with Kronfeld’s statement.
examples.zh: 巴尔强烈反对克龙费尔德的说法。

words.definition: a situation in which people express different opinions about something and sometimes argue; controversy, combat, variance, disparity
words.translation: 争论；不一致；意见不同

examples.en: We’ve had a few disagreements , but we’re still good friends.
examples.zh: 虽然有过一些分歧，但我们仍是好朋友。

examples.en: There is disagreement between these two estimates.
examples.zh: 这两种估算不符。

words.definition: to become impossible to see any longer; blank, vanish away; plough under
words.translation: 不见，消失；消失；失踪；不复存在；使…不存在；使…消失

examples.en: At this point the path seemed to disappear altogether (= disappear completely ) .
examples.zh: 小路到这里好像完全消失了。

words.definition: to make someone feel unhappy because something they hoped for did not happen or was not as good as they expected; fail, let down
words.translation: 使失望，使受挫折；使失望

examples.en: I hated to disappoint her.
examples.zh: 我不愿意让她失望。

examples.en: Great things were expected of this band, and they didn’t disappoint.
examples.zh: 大家对这支乐队的期望很高，而他们也不负众望。

words.definition: a feeling of unhappiness because something is not as good as you expected, or has not happened in the way you hoped; depression, sell
words.translation: 失望；沮丧

examples.en: He could see the disappointment in her eyes.
examples.zh: 他看到了她眼中的失望。

examples.en: Several people expressed disappointment at the delay.
examples.zh: 有好几个人对这次延误表示失望。

examples.en: She hid her bitter disappointment .
examples.zh: 她把深深的沮丧掩饰起来。

words.definition: a sudden event such as a flood, storm, or accident which causes great damage or suffering; tragedy, evil, calamity, grief
words.translation: 灾难，灾祸；天灾；不幸

examples.en: One hundred and twenty people died in China’s worst air disaster .
examples.zh: 有120人在中国这起最惨烈的空难事故中丧生。

examples.en: the economic consequences of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster
examples.zh: 切尔诺贝利核灾难给经济带来的后果

examples.en: The 1987 hurricane was the worst natural disaster to hit England for decades.
examples.zh: 1987年的飓风是英格兰数十年来遭遇的最为严重的自然灾害。

words.definition: a reduction in the usual price of something; agio, rabato; water sth. down, preach down
words.translation: 折扣；[贸易]折扣；[金融]贴现率；[贸易]打折扣；将…贴现；贬损

examples.en: They are often available at a discount.
examples.zh: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

words.definition: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions; stem, block, dispute, prohibit
words.translation: 使气馁, 阻碍；阻止；使气馁

examples.en: It may be difficult to do at first. Don't let this discourage you.
examples.zh: 开始时做起来也许比较困难。不要让这个泄你的气。

words.definition: to find someone or something, either by accident or because you were looking for them; detect, sniff out; sniff out, to find
words.translation: 发现；发觉

examples.en: The body was discovered in a field.
examples.zh: 尸体是在一块田地里找到的。

examples.en: Forest Service crews often discover campfires that have not been put out completely.
examples.zh: 林务局工作人员常常发现未完全熄灭的营火。

words.definition: a fact or thing that someone finds out about, when it was not known about before; detection, occurrence, find
words.translation: 发现；被发现的事物；发现，发觉

examples.en: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
examples.zh: 我感到自己有了一个惊人的发现。

words.definition: the practice of treating one person or group differently from another in an unfair way; distinction, differentiation
words.translation: 歧视；区别，辨别；识别力

examples.en: laws to prevent discrimination
examples.zh: 防止歧视的法律

words.definition: to talk about something with another person or a group in order to exchange ideas or decide something; debate, reason, argue
words.translation: 讨论，谈论；论述；讨论；论述，辩论

examples.en: Littman refused to discuss the case publicly.
examples.zh: 利特曼拒绝公开讨论此案。

examples.en: If you would like to discuss the matter further, please call me.
examples.zh: 如果你想进一步讨论此事，请打电话给我。

words.definition: when you discuss something; argumentum, counsel
words.translation: 讨论，谈论；论述；讨论，议论

examples.en: class discussions
examples.zh: 课堂讨论

examples.en: the topics suggested for discussion
examples.zh: 建议讨论的话题

examples.en: We have had discussions about her legal situation.
examples.zh: 我们就她的法律状况已进行了讨论。

words.definition: an illness which affects a person, animal, or plant; illness, ill, sickness, complaint; to infect
words.translation: 病，疾病；病害；[医]病，疾病；弊病；传染；使…有病

examples.en: His father died of heart disease.
examples.zh: 他父亲死于心脏病。

examples.en: She contracted the disease while she was abroad on holiday.
examples.zh: 她在国外度假时染上了这种疾病。

words.translation: 令人厌恶的

words.definition: a flat container with low sides, for serving food from or cooking food in; plate, course; visit, chin music
words.translation: 碟，盘子；菜肴；[轻]碟，盘；一道菜；成碟状；闲谈

examples.en: a serving dish
examples.zh: 上菜用的盘子

examples.en: an ovenproof dish
examples.zh: 耐热盘

words.definition: a small flat piece of plastic or metal which is used for storing computer or electronic information; magneticdisc, circular disc
words.translation: 圆盘，唱片；磁盘；[计]磁盘，磁碟片；圆盘，盘状物；[电子]唱片

examples.en: The program takes up 2.5 megabytes of disk space and can be run on a standard personal computer.
examples.zh: 这个程序占用2.5 兆字节的磁盘空间，可以在标准个人电脑上运行。

words.definition: to think someone or something is unpleasant and not like them; hate, have no relish for; hate, detestation
words.translation: 不喜爱，厌恶；不喜欢，厌恶；嫌恶，反感，不喜爱

examples.en: Why do you dislike her so much?
examples.zh: 你为什么那么讨厌她？

words.definition: to remove someone from their job; remove, fire out; disband, break up
words.translation: 不再考虑；解雇；解散；开除；让...离开

examples.en: The government has dismissed criticisms that the country’s health policy is a mess.
examples.zh: 有人认为国家医疗政策一塌糊涂，政府对这种批评持否认态度。

words.definition: to refuse to do what someone with authority tells you to do, or refuse to obey a rule or law; be in breach of, run counter to
words.translation: 不服从， 违抗；违反；不服从

examples.en: You disobeyed my orders.
examples.zh: 你违抗我的命令。

words.definition: the amount of space between two places or things; separation, space, interval, remove; stand off, cold-shoulder
words.translation: 距离；[数]距离；远方；疏远；间隔；把…远远甩在后面

examples.en: Measure the distance between the two points.
examples.zh: 量出两点之间的距离。

examples.en: The cottage is some distance (= quite a long distance ) from the road.
examples.zh: 小屋离开大路有些距离。

words.definition: far away in space or time; remote, faraway
words.translation: 遥远的；冷漠的；远隔的

examples.en: the sound of distant gunfire
examples.zh: 远处的炮火声

examples.en: Her honeymoon seemed a distant memory .
examples.zh: 她的蜜月似乎成了遥远的记忆。

examples.en: That affair was in the dim and distant past (= a long time ago ) .
examples.zh: 那件事已成为遥远的过去了。

words.definition: a clear difference or separation between two similar things; quality, identity, character, tang, discrimination
words.translation: 差别，不同，区分；区别；差别；特性；荣誉、勋章

examples.en: Eliot’s distinction as a poet
examples.zh: 艾略特作为诗人的杰出才能

words.definition: to recognize and understand the difference between two or more things or people; tell apart, differentiate; differentiate, tell from
words.translation: 区别，区分；区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出

examples.en: Could he distinguish right from wrong?
examples.zh: 他能辨别是非吗？

words.definition: to share things among a group of people, especially in a planned way; portion, part, spread
words.translation: 分发；分配；散布；分开；把…分类

examples.en: a man distributing leaflets to passers-by
examples.zh: 一个向路人派发传单的男子

words.definition: an area of a town or the countryside, especially one with particular features; area, place
words.translation: 区；[地理]区域；地方；行政区

examples.en: a postal district
examples.zh: 邮政区

words.definition: to interrupt someone so that they cannot continue what they are doing; let, violate; intrude upon, hinder from
words.translation: 打扰，扰乱；弄乱；打扰；妨碍；使不安；使恼怒

examples.en: Sorry to disturb you, but I have an urgent message.
examples.zh: 对不起打扰一下，我有个紧急消息。

examples.en: The thieves fled when they were disturbed by a neighbour.
examples.zh: 窃贼们被一名邻居惊动后逃跑了。

examples.en: (= a sign you put on a door so that people will not interrupt you ) .
examples.zh: 请勿打扰。

words.translation: 令人不安的；烦扰的；干扰；打断（disturb的ing形式）

words.definition: to jump into deep water with your head and arms going in first; pitch down; phreatic water, underground water
words.translation: 跳水；潜水；俯冲；[水运]潜水；[航]俯冲；急剧下降；扑

examples.en: Diving off the cliffs is dangerous.
examples.zh: 从悬崖上跳水是很危险的。

words.definition: very different from each other; different, unlike, varying, another, dissimilar
words.translation: 各种各样的；不同的；多种多样的；变化多的

examples.en: subjects as diverse as pop music and archaeology
examples.zh: 像流行音乐和考古学这样各不相同的学科

words.definition: if something divides, or if you divide it, it separates into two or more parts; distribute, part; differ, come between; shed, watershed
words.translation: 分开；划分；除；使产生分歧；意见分歧；[地理]分水岭，分水线

examples.en: The Wall used to divide East and West Berlin.
examples.zh: 过去这堵墙把东、西柏林隔开。

words.definition: the process of finding out how many times one number is contained in another; ministry, department, sector, segmentation, dom
words.translation: 除法；部门；师（军队）；[管理]部门；分割；[数]除法

examples.en: the Computer Services Division
examples.zh: 电脑维修部

words.definition: feeling unable to stand steadily, for example because you are looking down from a high place or because you are ill; swimming, foolish, stupid; cloud, confuse
words.translation: 头晕眼花的，眩晕的；晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的；使头晕眼花；使混乱；使茫然

examples.en: The heat and the champagne made him feel dizzy .
examples.zh: 高温和香槟酒使他感到眩晕。

examples.en: She started to suffer from dizzy spells (= a short period when you feel dizzy ) .
examples.zh: 她开始感到一阵阵的眩晕。

words.definition: someone who is trained to treat people who are ill; medical, hakeem; repair, perform maintenance; practice medicine
words.translation: 医生，医师；博士；[医]医生；修理；窜改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位；就医；行医

examples.en: She was treated by her local doctor.
examples.zh: 她由她的本区医生治疗。

examples.en: I’d like to make an appointment to see Dr Pugh.
examples.zh: 我想预约看皮尤医生。

words.definition: a piece of paper that has official information on it; file, paper
words.translation: 文件；文件，公文；[计]文档；[管理]证件

examples.en: She produces legal documents for a downtown Seattle law firm.
examples.zh: 她为西雅图市区的一家法律事务所撰写法律文件。

words.definition: a common animal with four legs, fur, and a tail. Dogs are kept as pets or trained to guard places, find drugs etc.; insect, chien; shadow, tail after; jack, dogly; extremely, badly, thoroughly, highly, entirely, greatly, completely
words.translation: 狗，犬，犬科动物；狗；丑女人；卑鄙的人；雄兽；坏蛋；跟踪；尾随；狗的；雄的；劣等的；非常；彻底地

examples.en: I could hear a dog barking .
examples.zh: 我听到了狗吠声。

examples.en: He’s taken the dog for a walk .
examples.zh: 他去遛狗了。

examples.en: We used to have a dog when I was young.
examples.zh: 我小时候我们养过狗。

words.definition: a child’s toy that looks like a small person or baby; babydoll, Living Doll
words.translation: 洋娃娃, 玩偶；洋娃娃；玩偶；无头脑的美丽女人

examples.en: a small wooden doll
examples.zh: 一个小木玩偶

words.definition: the standard unit of money in the US, Canada, Australia, and some other countries, divided into 100  cent s  : symbol $; peso
words.translation: 元(货币单位)；美元

examples.en: It cost three dollars.
examples.zh: 它要三美元。

examples.en: a ten-dollar bill
examples.zh: 一张十元钞票

examples.en: You can pay in dollars or euros at the airport.
examples.zh: 在机场你可以使用美元或欧元。

words.definition: the large flat piece of wood, glass etc that you move when you go into or out of a building, room, vehicle etc, or when you open a cupboard; home, exit, gateway, channel, route
words.translation: 门，通道；一家；[建]门；家，户；门口；通道

examples.en: Could you open the door for me?
examples.zh: 请你帮我开门好吗？

examples.en: The door flew open and Ruth stormed in.
examples.zh: 门一下子打开了，露丝气冲冲地跑了进来。

examples.en: Don’t forget to lock the garage door.
examples.zh: 别忘了把车库的门锁上。

words.definition: a large building at a college or university where students live; lodging house, student hostel; uptown
words.translation: 宿舍；宿舍，学生宿舍；住宅区的

examples.en: She lived in a college dormitory.
examples.zh: 她住在一幢大学宿舍楼里。

words.definition: a small round mark or spot; dowry, tocher
words.translation: 点，圆点；打点于；[数]点，圆点；嫁妆

examples.en: a pattern of dots
examples.zh: 圆点图案

words.definition: consisting of two parts that are similar or exactly the same; dual, two-fold; redouble; duplicate; twifold, twofold
words.translation: 两倍的；双的；双重的；加倍，加倍努力；快步走；使加倍；双重地；两倍地；弓身地

examples.en: a double sink
examples.zh: 双水槽

examples.en: a double wardrobe
examples.zh: 双门衣柜

examples.en: the great double doors of the cathedral
examples.zh: 大教堂宏伟的双开大门

words.definition: a feeling of being not sure whether something is true or right; to think that something may not be true or that it is unlikely; challenge, question, query, suspicion; suspect of, be suspicious of
words.translation: 怀疑；疑虑；[法]怀疑；疑问；疑惑；不信；恐怕；拿不准

examples.en: There was still one little nagging doubt at the back of his mind.
examples.zh: 他的心头仍有一丝挥之不去的疑虑。

words.definition: to or towards a lower place or position; below, under; descensive; pubescence, fur; along with; defeat, floor, fell; decline, descend
words.translation: 向下，在下面；向下，下去；在下面；向下的；软毛，[植]绒毛；[地质]开阔的高地；沿着，往下；打倒，击败；下降；下去

examples.en: David bent down to tie his shoelace.
examples.zh: 戴维弯腰系鞋带。

examples.en: Get down off the table.
examples.zh: 从桌子上下来。

examples.en: Tears were streaming down my face.
examples.zh: 我泪流满面。

words.definition: to move information or programs from a computer network to a small computer
words.translation: 下载

examples.en: games that can be downloaded free from the Internet
examples.zh: 可以从因特网上免费下载的游戏

words.definition: towards or on a lower floor of a building, especially a house; Downstairs means situated on the ground floor of a building or on a lower floor than you are; belowstairs
words.translation: 在楼下；楼下的

examples.en: Rosie ran downstairs to answer the door.
examples.zh: 罗茜跑下楼去开门。

examples.en: Charles was downstairs in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 查尔斯在楼下厨房里。

examples.en: She repainted the downstairs rooms and closed off the second floor.
examples.zh: 她重新粉刷了楼下的房间，并把二楼封上了。

words.definition: Downtown is also an adverb; Downtown places are in or toward the centre of a large town or city, where the stores and places of business are; Downtown is also a noun; intown, inner-city; urban center, inner city
words.translation: 往闹市区；在市区；市中心的；市中心区；三分线以外

examples.en: By day he worked downtown for American Standard.
examples.zh: 白天，他在市中心为美国标准公司工作。

examples.en: ...an office in downtown Chicago.
examples.zh: …芝加哥市中心的一间办公室。

examples.en: ...in a large vacant area of the downtown.
examples.zh: …在市中心的一大块空地上。

words.definition: moving or pointing towards a lower position; If you move or look downward, you move or look toward the ground or a lower level; falling, descensive; alow, netherward
words.translation: 向下的；向下地；[数]向下的，下降的；[数]向下

examples.en: a gentle downward slope
examples.zh: 缓坡

examples.en: Benedict pointed downward again with his stick.
examples.zh: 贝内迪克特又用他的拐杖向下指了指。

words.definition: twelve
words.translation: 一打，十二个；[计量]十二个，一打

examples.en: a dozen eggs
examples.zh: 一打鸡蛋

examples.en: Chris, Helen, and half a dozen others went on holiday together.
examples.zh: 克里斯、海伦和其他六个人一起去度假了。

examples.en: (= about 12 ) cars were parked near the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口附近停了大约十二辆汽车。

words.translation: 速度三角形定位法（dead reckoning）；数据记录器（Data Recorder）

words.definition: a piece of writing or a plan that is not yet in its finished form; to write a plan, letter, report etc that will need to be changed before it is in its finished form
words.translation: 草稿；汇票；起草

examples.en: the rough draft of his new novel
examples.zh: 他的新小说的草稿

examples.en: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
examples.zh: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

examples.en: All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
examples.zh: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

words.definition: to pull something along the ground, often because it is too heavy to carry; cumber with, ball and chain; daggle; pull, tow
words.translation: 拖，拉；拖曳；拖累；拖拉；缓慢而吃力地行进；拖

examples.en: He grabbed her arm and dragged her into the room.
examples.zh: 他抓住她的手臂把她拖进房间。

words.definition: to produce a picture of something using a pencil, pen etc; picture, absorb, pull, attract, engage; pull; lot, tie
words.translation: 画，划；拖；拨出；画；拉；吸引；平局；抽签

examples.en: Katie had drawn a cottage with a little stream running next to it.
examples.zh: 凯蒂画了一间小茅舍，旁边流淌着一条小溪。

examples.en: She asked the little girl to draw a picture of the man she’d spoken to.
examples.zh: 她让小女孩把刚才和她说话的那个男人画出来。

examples.en: Keith was drawing a complicated-looking graph.
examples.zh: 基思在画一张看上去很复杂的图表。

words.definition: a disadvantage of a situation, plan, product etc; defect, deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault
words.translation: 妨碍；弊端；缺点，不利条件；退税

examples.en: It’s a great city – the only drawback is the weather.
examples.zh: 这是座很不错的城市，唯一的不足就是天气。

words.definition: part of a piece of furniture, such as a desk, that you pull out and push in and use to keep things in
words.translation: 抽屉

examples.en: She took a file from her desk drawer .
examples.zh: 她从书桌的抽屉里拿出了一个文件夹。

examples.en: The scissors are in the kitchen drawer (= drawer in a piece of kitchen furniture ) .
examples.zh: 剪刀在厨房的抽屉里。

words.definition: a picture that you draw with a pencil, pen etc; picture, traction; painting, gaining
words.translation: 图画，素描；绘图；图画；牵引；素描术；绘画；吸引（draw的ing形式）；拖曳

examples.en: I’ve never been very good at drawing.
examples.zh: 我向来不擅长画图。

words.definition: a series of thoughts, images, and feelings that you experience when you are asleep; to think about something that you would like to happen or have; come to mind, bethink of; voice, aspirations; ideal, unreasonable
words.translation: 梦；梦想；做梦；做梦，梦见；想到；梦想，愿望；[心理]梦；梦的；理想的；不切实际的

examples.en: I had lots of dreams last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我做了很多梦。

words.definition: clothes for men or women of a particular type or for a particular occasion; apparel, clothe; frock, suit-dress
words.translation: 女服，童装；服装；给…穿衣；[服装]连衣裙；女装

examples.en: a gentleman in evening dress
examples.zh: 穿晚礼服的绅士

examples.en: The play was performed in modern dress (= clothes from the present time ) .
examples.zh: 这出戏里演员是现代装束。

words.translation: 干燥机；干燥剂；吹风机

words.definition: military training in which soldiers practise marching, using weapons etc; to make a hole in something using a drill; training, discipline; bore a hole, counter sunk; discipline, coach
words.translation: 钻头；操练；钻孔；训练；[矿业]钻孔机；钻子；[农机]播种机；[农机]条播
