examples.en: What are you doing tomorrow evening?
examples.zh: 明天晚上你打算做什么？

words.definition: something that happens, especially something important, interesting or unusual; incident, occurrence, circumstance, outcome, item, scene, product
words.translation: 事件，大事；事变；[计][物][数]事件，大事；项目；结果

examples.en: one of the most important events in the history of mankind
examples.zh: 人类历史上最重大的事件之一

words.definition: after a long time, or after a lot of things have happened; finally, ultimately, lastly
words.translation: 终于；最后；最后，终于

examples.en: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
examples.zh: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

examples.en: Eventually, she got a job and moved to London.
examples.zh: 最终，她找到了工作并移居伦敦。

words.definition: a word meaning at any time; used mostly in questions, negatives, comparisons, or sentences with ‘if’; forever, always, once
words.translation: 在任何时候；曾经；永远；究竟

examples.en: Nothing ever seems to upset him.
examples.zh: 似乎从来没有什么事情会使他烦恼。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?
examples.zh: 你去过巴黎吗？

examples.en: I don’t think I’ve ever been here before.
examples.zh: 我觉得我以前从未到过这里。

words.definition: Every is also an adjective
words.translation: 每一的；每隔…的

examples.en: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
examples.zh: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

words.definition: everyone
words.translation: 每人，人人

words.definition: ordinary, usual, or happening every day; daily, household, routine; peacetime
words.translation: 每天的，日常的；平时；寻常日子

examples.en: the problems of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活中的问题

examples.en: wearing everyday clothes
examples.zh: 穿平常衣服

examples.en: a simple, everyday object
examples.zh: 简单的日常物品

words.definition: every person; each one, everybody (a term of address), Every Body
words.translation: 每人，人人；每个人

examples.en: If everyone is ready, I’ll begin.
examples.zh: 如果大家都准备好了，我就开始。

examples.en: Send my best wishes to everyone in the family.
examples.zh: 请向全家人致以最美好的祝愿。

examples.en: Of course everyone else thought it was hilarious!
examples.zh: 当然其他所有人都觉得好笑极了！

words.definition: each thing or all things
words.translation: 每件事，事事

examples.en: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
examples.zh: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

examples.en: I decided to tell her everything.
examples.zh: 我决定把一切都告诉她。

examples.en: Apart from the bus arriving late, everything else seemed to be going according to plan.
examples.zh: 除了公共汽车晚点之外，其他一切似乎都在按计划进行。

words.definition: in or to every place; around, throughout, about
words.translation: 到处，处处；到处

examples.en: I’ve looked everywhere but I can’t find the map.
examples.zh: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

examples.en: He’s travelled everywhere in Europe.
examples.zh: 他走遍了欧洲各地。

examples.en: The south should remain dry, but everywhere else will have heavy rain.
examples.zh: 南部持续干旱，但其他地区会下暴雨。

words.definition: facts or signs that show clearly that something exists or is true; authentication, certification, demonstration, proof, breath; demonstrate, prove, argue, bear witness to
words.translation: 根据，证据，迹象；[法]证据，证明；迹象；明显；证明

examples.en: Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
examples.zh: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

words.definition: easy to see, notice, or understand; obvious, distinct, visible
words.translation: 明显的；明白的

examples.en: Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
examples.zh: 显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

words.definition: the scientific idea that plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time; unfolding, Monkey to Man
words.translation: 演变，进化；演变；[进化]进化论；进展

examples.en: the theory of evolution
examples.zh: 进化论

words.definition: completely correct in every detail; nice, accurate, precise, mathematical, strict; require, desire, call for
words.translation: 确切的；精确的；准确的，精密的；要求；强求；急需

examples.en: Police are still investigating the exact cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 警方还在调查这起事故的确切原因。

examples.en: What were his exact words?
examples.zh: 他的原话是什么？

examples.en: The timing had to be exact.
examples.zh: 对时机的把握必须精确。

words.definition: used when emphasizing that something is no more and no less than a number or amount, or is completely correct in every detail; accurately, correctly, properly, precisely, right
words.translation: 确切地；恰恰正是；恰好地；正是；精确地；正确地

examples.en: It’s exactly half past five.
examples.zh: 一分不差，正好5点半。

examples.en: The figures may not be exactly right, but they’re close enough.
examples.zh: 那些数字可能不是非常精确，但也相当接近。

words.definition: a spoken or written test of knowledge, especially an important one
words.translation: 考试；检查，细查

examples.en: At the end of each level, there’s an exam.
examples.zh: 在每一级别结束时都有一次考试。

examples.en: How did you do in your exams?
examples.zh: 你考试考得怎么样？

words.definition: to look at something carefully and thoroughly because you want to find out more about it; inspect, review, survey; probe, check for
words.translation: 检查，仔细观察；检查；调查；检测；考试

examples.en: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
examples.zh: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

examples.en: Hegel’s philosophy will be examined in detail in Chapter 4.
examples.zh: 黑格尔的哲学将在第4章作详细探讨。

words.definition: a specific fact, idea, person, or thing that is used to explain or support a general idea, or to show what is typical of a larger group; mirror, lead, sample; illustrate
words.translation: 例子，实例；模范；例子；榜样；举例

examples.en: Many countries, for example Mexico and Japan, have a lot of earthquakes.
examples.zh: 许多国家，例如墨西哥和日本，经常发生地震。

words.definition: extremely good or of very high quality; remarkable, wonderful, famous, prominent, brilliant
words.translation: 卓越的，杰出的，极好的；卓越的；极好的；杰出的

examples.en: an excellent suggestion
examples.zh: 极好的建议

examples.en: His car is in excellent condition.
examples.zh: 他的汽车状况极佳。

examples.en: Second-hand computers can be excellent value.
examples.zh: 二手计算机买得好会非常合算。

words.definition: object, sit down on, to oppose; unless, besides, in addition to; but for
words.translation: 除…之外；反对；除了；要不是

examples.en: They were all there except me.
examples.zh: 除了我以外他们都在那里。

examples.en: We all went except him.
examples.zh: 除他以外， 我们都去了。

examples.en: They all howled with laughter except me.
examples.zh: 除了我以外，他们全都哈哈大笑起来。

words.definition: the act of giving someone something and receiving something else from them; communication, conversion; turn, truck; trade, traffic
words.translation: 交换，交流；[通信][计]交换；交流；交易所；[金融]兑换；交易

examples.en: Four of my cassettes for your Madonna CD is a fair exchange.
examples.zh: 我用四盒磁带换你的麦当娜激光唱片很公平。

words.definition: to make someone feel happy, interested, or eager; warm, stir up; warm, fire, to agitate
words.translation: 使激动；引起；激起；刺激…，使…兴奋；激动

examples.en: His playing is technically brilliant, but it doesn’t excite me.
examples.zh: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

words.definition: to forgive someone for doing something that is not seriously wrong, such as being rude or careless; a reason that you invent to explain an action and to hide your real intentions; reason, sake, account, blind, occasion; forgive, pardon for; beg for mercy
words.translation: 原谅；免除；借口；理由；为…申辩；给…免去；作为借口；请求宽恕；表示宽恕

examples.en: I’ll excuse you this time, but don’t be late again.
examples.zh: 这次我原谅你，但别再迟到了。

examples.en: Please excuse my bad handwriting.
examples.zh: 请原谅，我的字写得不好。

words.definition: physical activities that you do in order to stay healthy and become stronger; movement, sport, ceremony, campaign, practice; make use of, fashion, occupy, alarm, employ; motion, do sport
words.translation: 锻炼，训练；练习；运动；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼；锻炼；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐

examples.en: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
examples.zh: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

examples.en: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
examples.zh: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

words.definition: a show of paintings, photographs, or other objects that people can go to see; expo, display, show, fair, manifestation
words.translation: 展览；展览，显示；展览会；展览品

examples.en: ...an exhibition of expressionist art.
examples.zh: …一场印象主义艺术展览会。

words.definition: to happen or be present in a particular situation or place; occur, live, harbor
words.translation: 存在；生存，生活；生存；生活；继续存在

examples.en: The custom of arranged marriages still exists in many countries.
examples.zh: 许多国家仍存在包办婚姻的习俗。

examples.en: Opportunities exist for students to gain sponsorship.
examples.zh: 学生有机会获得资助。

examples.en: Stop pretending that the problem doesn’t exist.
examples.zh: 别再假装这个问题不存在了。

words.definition: the state of existing; presence, being, entity, life, is
words.translation: 存在，实在；生存；[计]存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物

examples.en: Scientists have many theories about how the universe first came into existence (= started to exist ).
examples.zh: 关于宇宙的起源，科学家有多种理论。

words.definition: a door or space through which you can leave a public room, building etc; to stop using a computer program; door, channel, route, way out; to quit, back out
words.translation: 出口；退场；退出；出口，通道；[计]退出；离去

examples.en: We made for the nearest exit.
examples.zh: 我们走向最近的出口。

examples.en: an exit door
examples.zh: 出口门

examples.en: Two men were blocking her exit.
examples.zh: 两个男人挡住了她出去的路。

words.definition: to become larger in size, number, or amount, or to make something become larger; dwell on, enlarge on; grow, go way
words.translation: 扩大；扩张；使膨胀；详述；发展；张开，展开

examples.en: Water expands as it freezes.
examples.zh: 水结冰时会膨胀。

examples.en: Sydney’s population expanded rapidly in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 20世纪60年代，悉尼的人口迅速增加。

examples.en: exercises that expand the chest muscles
examples.zh: 扩展胸肌的运动

words.definition: to think that something will happen because it seems likely or has been planned; promise oneself, guess, find, feel, make; look foward to, to look forward to
words.translation: 预料，预期；等待；期望；指望；认为；预料；期待；预期

examples.en: He will be hard to beat. I fully expect (= am completely sure about ) that and I’m ready.
examples.zh: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

examples.en: ‘Who are you?’ he murmured, only half expecting (= thinking it was possible, but not likely ) her to answer.
examples.zh: “你是谁？”他低声问道，预计她可能不会回答。

examples.en: He didn’t get his expected pay rise.
examples.zh: 他没有得到他预想的加薪。

words.definition: what you think or hope will happen; Prospects, looking forward to, be
words.translation: 期望；期待；预期；指望

examples.en: Having raised expectations (= made people more hopeful ), he went on to help only a few people.
examples.zh: 他唤起了大家的希望，但接着只是帮助了几个人。

examples.en: The show exceeded all expectations (= was much better than expected ).
examples.zh: 这场演出比人们预期的要好得多。

examples.en: The number of people who attended fell short of expectations (= was lower than expected ).
examples.zh: 出席的人数比预期的要少。

words.definition: the amount of money that you spend on something; consumption, losing, price, cost, disadvantage
words.translation: 花费，消费；费用；损失，代价；消费；开支

examples.en: He borrowed £150,000 and used the money for legal expenses.
examples.zh: 他借了15万英镑用于支付律师费。

examples.en: Conference rooms were equipped at great expense.
examples.zh: 装备会议室花费巨大。

words.definition: costing a lot of money; rich, dear, costly
words.translation: 昂贵的，花钱多的；昂贵的；花钱的

examples.en: the most expensive restaurant in town
examples.zh: 城里最贵的餐馆

examples.en: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.
examples.zh: 汽油越来越贵了。

examples.en: Photography is an expensive hobby.
examples.zh: 摄影是一项很花钱的业余爱好。

words.definition: knowledge or skill that you gain from doing a job or activity, or the process of doing this; areer; suffer, live, undergo
words.translation: 经验，感受；经历；经验；体验

examples.en: The advice in the booklet reflects the practical experience we have gained (= experience gained by actually doing something, rather than knowledge from books etc ).
examples.zh: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

examples.en: I had some experience in fashion design.
examples.zh: 我有一些时装设计方面的经验。

examples.en: She was turned down on the grounds of lack of experience.
examples.zh: 她因缺乏经验而被拒绝。

words.definition: a scientific test done to find out how something reacts under certain conditions, or to find out if a particular idea is true; have a try, try one's hand; stroke, proof, try, go
words.translation: 实验；试验；尝试；进行实验；[试验]实验，试验

examples.en: The astronauts are conducting a series of experiments to learn more about how the body adapts to weightlessness.
examples.zh: 那些宇航员正在进行一系列实验，以便更多地了解人体如何适应失重状态。

words.definition: having a special skill or special knowledge of a subject; skilled, accomplished, clever, diplomatic, practiced; operator, specialist
words.translation: 熟练的，内行的；熟练的；内行的；老练的；专家；行家；能手

examples.en: He cast his expert eye on the gardener’s work.
examples.zh: 他用内行的眼光看了看园丁干的活。

words.definition: to tell someone about something in a way that is clear or easy to understand; bring sb to do sth, go to show
words.translation: 解释；为…辩解；说明

examples.en: He carefully explained the procedure.
examples.zh: 他仔细解释了程序。

words.definition: the reasons you give for why something happened or why you did something; notes, interpretation, construction, legend, account
words.translation: 解释，说明；辩解；说明，解释

examples.en: She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday.
examples.zh: 她告诉法庭她将在星期一就控方的决定做出详尽的解释。

words.definition: expressed in a way that is very clear and direct; precise, decided, distinct, specific, express
words.translation: 明晰的；直率的；明确的；清楚的；详述的

examples.en: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
examples.zh: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

examples.en: explicit knowledge of grammar
examples.zh: 清楚易懂的语法知识

examples.en: The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
examples.zh: 绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。

words.definition: to burst, or to make something burst, into small pieces, usually with a loud noise and in a way that causes damage; blow apart, burst up; shoot, spring, blast
words.translation: 使爆炸；爆炸；爆炸，爆发；激增；推翻

examples.en: The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
examples.zh: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

examples.en: Far sooner than anyone thought possible, the Russians exploded an atomic bomb.
examples.zh: 苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

words.definition: to develop and use minerals, forests, oil etc for business or industry; develop, mine; merit, feat
words.translation: 开采；开发，开拓；剥削；勋绩；功绩

examples.en: the urgent need to exploit the resources of the Irish Sea
examples.zh: 开发爱尔兰海资源的迫切需要

words.definition: to discuss or think about something carefully; detect, probe into; probe into, search after
words.translation: 探索；探测；探险

examples.en: Management need to explore ways of improving office security.
examples.zh: 管理层需要探讨如何加强办事处的安全措施。

examples.en: I’m going to explore the possibility of a part-time job.
examples.zh: 我要好好想想兼职工作的可能性。

words.definition: someone who travels through an unknown area to find out about it; finder, prober
words.translation: 探险者；探险家；探测者，探测器

examples.en: ...the travels of Columbus, Magellan, and many other explorers.
examples.zh: …哥伦布、麦哲伦和许多其他探险家的旅行。

words.definition: to sell goods to another country; output, exit; output, bulk out
words.translation: 输出，出口；运走；输出，[贸易]出口；出口商品

examples.en: Italian food has been exported all over the world.
examples.zh: 意大利食品已传遍世界。

words.definition: to show something that is usually covered or hidden; reveal, prove, make clear, disclose
words.translation: 暴露；揭露，揭发；使曝光；显示

examples.en: He lifted his T-shirt to expose a jagged scar across his chest.
examples.zh: 他撩起T恤衫，露出横贯胸部的锯齿状伤疤。

words.definition: to tell or show what you are feeling or thinking by using words, looks, or actions; a train or bus that does not stop in many places and therefore travels quickly; voice, put; precise, decided, technical, rapid, specific; rapido, flier
words.translation: 表示；快车，快递；表达；快递；明确的；迅速的；专门的；[交]快车，快递，专使；捷运公司

examples.en: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
examples.zh: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

examples.en: She expressed an interest in seeing York.
examples.zh: 她表示有兴趣见见约克。

examples.en: Many people have expressed their opposition to the proposals.
examples.zh: 许多人反对这些提议。

words.definition: something you say, write, or do that shows what you think or feel; utterance, representative of
words.translation: 词句；表达；表情；[数]表达，表示；[遗]表现力；措辞

examples.en: Student leaders are demanding greater freedom of expression (= the right to say what you think without being punished ).
examples.zh: 学生领袖要求得到更多的言论自由。

words.definition: one of many telephone lines connected to a central system in a large building, which all have different numbers; delay, spread
words.translation: 分机；延长；[经]延期；扩大；伸展；电话分机

examples.en: a loft extension
examples.zh: 增建的阁楼

words.definition: more of something, in addition to the usual or standard amount or number; used to emphasize an adjective or adverb; specifically, particularly, badly, highly, greatly, too; walker-on, special edition; additional, added, excess
words.translation: 额外的；特别地；特别地，非常；另外；临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品；额外的，[经]另外收费的；特大的

examples.en: Could you get an extra loaf of bread?
examples.zh: 你能多拿一条面包吗？

examples.en: Allow extra time for your journey.
examples.zh: 要给你的旅程多留出点时间。

examples.en: Drivers are advised to take extra care.
examples.zh: 建议司机开车要格外小心。

words.definition: very much greater or more impressive than usual; remarkable, particular, temporary, special, wonder
words.translation: 非凡的；特别的；离奇的；临时的；特派的

examples.en: a woman of extraordinary beauty
examples.zh: 容貌出众的女子

examples.en: an extraordinary talent
examples.zh: 非凡的才华

words.definition: very great in degree; ultra, excessive; terminal, bottom
words.translation: 极度的；尽头的；极端的；偏激的；极端；末端；最大程度；极端的事物

examples.en: Extreme poverty still exists in many rural areas.
examples.zh: 许多农村地区仍处于赤贫状态。

examples.en: extreme cold
examples.zh: 严寒

examples.en: He had extreme difficulty getting hold of the ingredients.
examples.zh: 他费了极大的劲找配料。

words.definition: to a very great degree; badly, highly, greatly, too, rare
words.translation: 极端，极其，非常；非常，极其；极端地

examples.en: Earthquakes are extremely difficult to predict.
examples.zh: 地震非常难以预测。

examples.en: I’m extremely sorry to have troubled you.
examples.zh: 给你添了麻烦，我十分抱歉。

words.definition: one of the two parts of the body that you use to see with; viewpoint, vision, sight, perspective, outlook; watch, look, behold
words.translation: 眼睛；眼力；鉴赏力；[解剖]眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点；注视，看

examples.en: He’s got beautiful eyes.
examples.zh: 他有一双漂亮的眼睛。

examples.en: There were tears in her eyes as she listened to the story.
examples.zh: 她听故事时眼里噙着泪水。

examples.en: Ow! I’ve got something in my eye!
examples.zh: 哎呀！我眼睛里进了什么东西！

words.definition: your ability to see; vision, sight, eye, seeing
words.translation: 视力，目力；视力；目力

examples.en: He had a problem with his eyesight.
examples.zh: 他的视力有问题。

words.definition: someone who has seen something such as a crime happen, and is able to describe it afterwards; witness
words.translation: 目击者；[法]见证人

examples.en: One eyewitness said he saw her talking to a man in a blue car.
examples.zh: 一名目击者说他看见她在跟一个坐在蓝色汽车里的男子说话。

words.definition: the front part of your head, where your eyes, nose, and mouth are; surface, outside, garment, look; open to; accept, agree, recognize, look, grant
words.translation: 脸；表面；外表；面子；面容；外观；威信；向；朝；面对；面向；承认；抹盖

examples.en: She had a beautiful face.
examples.zh: 她面容秀美。

examples.en: Her face was white with fear.
examples.zh: 她吓得脸煞白。

examples.en: A big smile spread across his face.
examples.zh: 他的脸上绽开了灿烂笑容。

words.definition: on your face or relating to your face; external, surface; hairdressing, beauty treatment
words.translation: 脸部的,面部的；面部的，表面的；脸的，面部用的；美容，美颜；脸部按摩

examples.en: Victor’s facial expression didn’t change.
examples.zh: 维克托脸上的表情没有变化。

examples.en: facial hair
examples.zh: 脸部的汗毛

words.definition: a piece of information that is known to be true; truth, reality, actuality
words.translation: 事实；实际，实情；实际；真相

examples.en: Our decision to build the museum in Hartlepool was influenced by the fact that there were no national museums in the North East.
examples.zh: 我们之所以决定在哈特尔浦建造博物馆，是因为东北地区没有国家级的博物馆。

words.definition: a building or group of buildings in which goods are produced in large quantities, using machines; plant, mill, work, manufactory
words.translation: 工厂，制造厂；[工经]工厂；制造厂；代理店

examples.en: a car factory
examples.zh: 汽车制造厂

examples.en: factory workers
examples.zh: 工厂工人

words.definition: to gradually disappear; peter, color fading; discolor; stupid, literal-minded
words.translation: 逐渐消失；褪色；凋谢；使褪色；平淡的；乏味的

examples.en: Hopes of a peace settlement are beginning to fade.
examples.zh: 达成和平协议的希望日渐渺茫。

examples.en: Over the years her beauty had faded a little.
examples.zh: 岁月流逝，她的美貌已略逊当年。

words.definition: to not succeed in achieving something; flag, founder, tube; disappoint, let down; flunk
words.translation: 失败；失灵；不能；失败，不及格；破产；缺乏；衰退；不及格；使失望；忘记；舍弃

examples.en: It looks likely that the peace talks will fail.
examples.zh: 看来和平谈判可能会失败。

examples.en: Millions of people have tried to quit smoking and failed miserably (= been completely unsuccessful ).
examples.zh: 数百万人戒过烟，都以惨败告终。

examples.en: his efforts to save his failing marriage
examples.zh: 他挽救自己濒危婚姻的努力

words.definition: a lack of success in achieving or doing something; loss, defeat, losing, fault, trouble
words.translation: 失败；失败的人；故障；失败者；[经]破产

examples.en: Successful people often aren’t very good at dealing with failure.
examples.zh: 一帆风顺的人往往不太擅长应对失败。

words.definition: an outdoor event, at which there are large machines to ride on, games to play, and sometimes farm animals being judged and sold; beautiful, fine, clear, just, impartial; definitely, directly, equally, immediately, straight; expo, exhibition, beauty
words.translation: 集市；公平的；美丽的，白皙的；[气象]晴朗的；公平地；直接地；清楚地；[经]展览会；市集；美人

examples.en: a horse fair
examples.zh: 马市

words.definition: more than a little, but much less than very; relatively, simply, comparatively, equally, reasonably
words.translation: 相当；公平地；相当地；简直

examples.en: The house had a fairly large garden.
examples.zh: 那幢房子有个不小的花园。

examples.en: She speaks English fairly well.
examples.zh: 她英语讲得还不错。

examples.en: The instructions seem fairly straightforward.
examples.zh: 操作指南似乎很简明。

words.translation: 公平；美好；清晰；顺利性

words.definition: a strong feeling of trust or confidence in someone or something; belief, confidence, trust, credit, loyalty
words.translation: 信任；信仰；信念；忠实

examples.en: People have lost faith in the government.
examples.zh: 人们已失去了对政府的信心。

words.definition: to move or drop down from a higher position to a lower position; become, come, lower; reduction, decline, autumn; floor, cut sth down; autumn
words.translation: 落下；跌倒；陷落；变成；来临；减弱；[气象]下降；秋天；瀑布；砍倒；击倒；秋天的

examples.en: The tree was about to fall.
examples.zh: 那棵树快要倒下了。

examples.en: The book fell from his hands.
examples.zh: 书从他手上跌落。

examples.en: Enough rain had fallen to flood the grounds.
examples.zh: 雨量很大，淹没了地面。

words.definition: You use false to describe objects which are artificial but which are intended to look like the real thing or to be used instead of the real thing; artificial, wrong, incorrect, improper, inaccurate; trickily
words.translation: 不真实的；伪造的；错误的；虚伪的；欺诈地

examples.en: ...a set of false teeth.
examples.zh: …一副假牙。

words.definition: someone or something that is familiar is well-known to you and easy to recognize; conventional, near, close; frequenter, regular customer
words.translation: 熟悉的；常见的；亲近的；常客；密友

examples.en: a familiar tune
examples.zh: 熟悉的曲调

examples.en: It was a relief to be back in familiar surroundings .
examples.zh: 回到熟悉的环境里让人松了一口气。

examples.en: Beggars on the street are becoming a familiar sight .
examples.zh: 街上出现乞丐的情况逐渐变得屡见不鲜。

words.definition: a group of people who are related to each other, especially a mother, a father, and their children; household, folk, race; household, domestic, home
words.translation: 家，家庭；家族；家庭；家属；子女；亲属；僚属；家庭的，家族的

examples.en: Do you know the family next door?
examples.zh: 你认识隔壁那家人吗？

examples.en: The Webb family still has its farm over there.
examples.zh: 韦伯家依然保留着那里的农场。

examples.en: The family now live in London.
examples.zh: 那家人现居伦敦。

words.definition: known about by many people in many places; noted, wonderful, excellent, super, great
words.translation: 著名的，出名的；著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的

examples.en: a famous actor
examples.zh: 著名演员

examples.en: Many famous people have stayed in the hotel.
examples.zh: 许多名人都曾下榻这家酒店。

examples.en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark (= a famous place or building that is easy to recognize ) .
examples.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是著名的地标。

words.definition: someone who likes a particular sport or performing art very much, or who admires a famous person; stimulate, egg; float, flutter; lover, aficionado
words.translation: (运动等)狂热爱好者；煽动；刺激；吹拂；成扇形散开；飘动；迷；[电]风扇；爱好者

examples.en: Groups of football fans began heading towards the ground.
examples.zh: 成群结队的球迷开始向球场走去。

words.definition: fancy hotels, restaurants, cars etc are expensive and fashionable; interest, like, fantasy; expensive, rich, ideal, picked, dear; enjoy, vision, image; have vision of, to imagine
words.translation: 华丽的，别致的；幻想；想像力；爱好；想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的；想象；喜爱；设想；自负

examples.en: Harry took me to a fancy restaurant for our anniversary.
examples.zh: 哈里带我去了一家豪华餐厅，庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

words.definition: extremely good, attractive, enjoyable etc; wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great; weirdo, geezer
words.translation: 极好的， 极出色的， 了不起的；极大的；难以相信的；异想天开的， 不实际的；奇异的， 古怪的；奇异的；空想的；极好的；不可思议的；古怪的人

examples.en: You look fantastic!
examples.zh: 你看上去棒极了！

examples.en: It’s a fantastic place, really beautiful!
examples.zh: 这真是个好地方，漂亮极了！

words.definition: an exciting and unusual experience or situation you imagine happening to you, but which will probably never happen; fancy, illusion; visional; imagine, picture, think of; stargaze
words.translation: 想象， 幻想；想象的产物；[心理]幻想；白日梦；幻觉；虚幻的；空想；想像；耽于幻想；奏幻想曲（等于phantasy）

examples.en: I used to have fantasies about living in Paris with an artist.
examples.zh: 我过去常幻想着在巴黎与一位艺术家同住。

examples.en: sexual fantasies
examples.zh: 性幻想

examples.en: Young children sometimes can’t distinguish between fantasy and reality.
examples.zh: 小孩子有时不能区分幻想与现实。

words.definition: a long distance away; used to talk about how much progress someone makes, or how much effect something has; greatly, quite, badly, too, powerful; hoary, agelong; distance, distant place
words.translation: 远的；远，遥远；很；遥远地；久远地；到很远的距离；到很深的程度；久远的；远方

examples.en: We can walk to my house from here. It isn’t far.
examples.zh: 我们可以从这里步行去我家，不远。

examples.en: You could see the mountains in the far distance.
examples.zh: 你可以看到远处的群山。

words.definition: the price you pay to travel somewhere by bus, train, plane etc; round, advance; passenger, food, fee, charge, diet
words.translation: 车费，船费，票价；经营；进展；遭遇；过活；票价；费用；旅客；食物

examples.en: He could barely afford the fare.
examples.zh: 他几乎付不起车费。

words.definition: an area of land used for growing crops or keeping animals; follow the plough; grange, steading; till, plant crops
words.translation: 农场，农庄；饲养场；种田，务农；经营农场；[农经]农场；农家；[畜牧]畜牧场；养殖；耕种；佃出（土地）

examples.en: a 300-hectare farm
examples.zh: 一座300公顷的农场

examples.en: farm workers
examples.zh: 农场工人

examples.en: farm animals
examples.zh: 农场牲畜

words.definition: someone who owns or manages a farm; peasant, sodbuster
words.translation: 农民，农夫；农场主；农夫，[农]农民

words.definition: moving or able to move quickly; moving quickly; rapid, sudden, tight, forward, ready; quickly, rapidly, thoroughly, entirely, completely, fully; apastia, starvation
words.translation: 快的；偏快的；快；[摄]快速的，迅速的；紧的，稳固的；迅速地；紧紧地；彻底地；斋戒；绝食

examples.en: a fast car
examples.zh: 速度很快的汽车

examples.en: He’s one of the fastest runners in the world.
examples.zh: 他是世界上跑得最快的人之一。

words.definition: to firmly close a window, gate etc so that it will not open, or to become firmly closed; focus on, fix; pay attention, take hold
words.translation: 扎牢，扣住；使固定；集中于；扎牢；强加于；扣紧；抓住；集中注意力

examples.en: Make sure all the windows are securely fastened before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前要确保所有的窗子都已关严。

words.definition: weighing too much because you have too much flesh on your body; a substance that is stored under the skin of people and animals, that helps to keep them warm; full, fatter; lipo, fattiness; fatten; flesh up
words.translation: 肥的，胖的；油腻的；丰满的；脂肪，肥肉；养肥；在…中加入脂肪；[生化]脂肪，肥肉；长肥

examples.en: Are you suggesting I’m too fat?
examples.zh: 你是不是在说我太胖了？

examples.en: a short fat man in his early fifties
examples.zh: 一个五十岁出头的矮胖男人

examples.en: You’ll get fat if you eat all that chocolate.
examples.zh: 如果你把那些巧克力都吃了，就会变胖的。

words.definition: a male parent; dad, root, da, daddy, priest; found, construct, institute
words.translation: 父亲；神父；创始人；父亲，爸爸；祖先；前辈；发明，创立；当…的父亲

examples.en: Ask your father to help you.
examples.zh: 叫你父亲帮你。

examples.en: Andrew was very excited about becoming a father.
examples.zh: 安德鲁初为人父，非常激动。

examples.en: He’s been like a father to me.
examples.zh: 对我来说，他就像父亲一样。

words.definition: a bad or weak part of someone’s character; error, deficiency, defect, mistake, trouble; mistake, err in; carp at, trip up
words.translation: 缺点；过失；故障；[地质]断层；错误；毛病；（网球等）发球失误；弄错；产生断层；（通常用于疑问句或否定句）挑剔

examples.en: His worst fault is his arrogance.
examples.zh: 他最大的缺点是傲慢。

examples.en: I may have my faults , but ingratitude is not one of them.
examples.zh: 我可能有我的缺点，但我决不会忘恩负义。

examples.en: For all his faults (= in spite of his faults ) he was a good father.
examples.zh: 尽管他有缺点，但还是个好父亲。

words.definition: something that you do for someone in order to help them or be kind to them; acceptance, preference, good, mercy; enjoy, agree, aid, uphold
words.translation: 好感；赞同；恩惠；偏爱；善行；赞成；喜爱；有助于

examples.en: Could you do me a favour and tell Kelly I can’t make it?
examples.zh: 你帮个忙告诉凯莉说我来不了好吗？

examples.en: He hired John as a favour to his father.
examples.zh: 他雇约翰是给他父亲一个面子。

examples.en: Paul, can I ask you a favor ?
examples.zh: 保罗，能帮我一下吗？

words.definition: your favourite person or thing is the one that you like the most
words.translation: 特别受喜爱的

examples.en: a child’s favourite toy
examples.zh: 孩子最喜欢的玩具

examples.en: What’s your favourite colour?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢什么颜色？

examples.en: a favorite spot for picnickers
examples.zh: 野餐者最喜欢的地方

words.definition: to send someone a letter or message using a fax machine; a letter or message that is sent in electronic form down a telephone line and then printed using a special machine; facsimile; electrical transmission, telecopying
words.translation: 传真；[通信]传真

examples.en: I faxed a copy of the agreement to each of the investors.
examples.zh: 我给每位投资者都传真了一份协议副本。

words.definition: the feeling you get when you are afraid or worried that something bad is going to happen; to feel afraid or worried that something bad may happen; worry, afraid of; be nervous of, be afraid of
words.translation: 害怕；担心；[心理]恐惧；敬畏；为…担心

examples.en: I was sitting on the floor shivering with fear because a bullet had been fired through a window.
examples.zh: 我坐在地板上吓得浑身发抖，因为有一颗子弹射穿窗户打了进来。

words.definition: a large meal where a lot of people celebrate a special occasion; enjoy, guest; festival, holiday; banquet
words.translation: 盛宴，筵席；节日；享受；款待，宴请；筵席，宴会；参加宴会

examples.en: a wedding feast
examples.zh: 婚筵

examples.en: The king promised to hold a great feast for all his people.
examples.zh: 国王允诺为全体子民举行盛宴。

words.definition: one of the light soft things that cover a bird’s body; plume; fledge
words.translation: 羽毛；翎毛；羽状物；用羽毛装饰；长羽毛

examples.en: an ostrich feather
examples.zh: 一根鸵鸟羽毛

words.definition: the second month of the year, between January and March
words.translation: 二月

examples.en: He joined the Army in February 1943.
examples.zh: 他1943年2月参军。

words.definition: a federal country or system of government consists of a group of states which control their own affairs, but which are also controlled by a single national government which makes decisions on foreign affairs, defence etc; confederal, fed.
words.translation: 联邦的；联盟的；同盟的

examples.en: Switzerland is a federal republic.
examples.zh: 瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

words.definition: an amount of money that you pay to do something or that you pay to a professional person for their work; charge, cost, tip
words.translation: 费，酬金；赏金；[会计]费用；[劳经]酬金；小费

examples.en: You can use the gym and pool for a fee of £35 a month.
examples.zh: 月付35英镑，即可使用健身房和游泳池。

words.definition: to give food to a person or animal; grass, take care of, range; take food, flow into; meal, breeding, husbandry
words.translation: 喂(养)；吃饲料；喂养；供给；放牧；抚养（家庭等）；靠…为生；吃东西；流入；[畜牧]饲料；饲养；（动物或婴儿的）一餐

examples.en: Have you fed the cat?
examples.zh: 你喂猫了吗？

words.definition: If you feel a particular emotion or physical sensation, you experience it; to give you a particular physical feeling, especially when you touch or hold something; expect, count, guess, find, make; fish for, poke about; consciousness, sense perception
words.translation: 有知觉；触，摸；感觉；认为；触摸；试探；觉得；摸索

examples.en: I am feeling very depressed.
examples.zh: 我感到很沮丧。

examples.en: Suddenly I felt a sharp pain in my shoulder.
examples.zh: 我突然感到肩部一阵剧痛。

examples.en: I felt as if all my strength had gone.
examples.zh: 我觉得好象自己的力气已经全没了。

words.definition: an emotion that you feel, such as anger, sadness, or happiness; mood, consciousness, emotion, affection, spirit; caring; sensing, handling
words.translation: 感情；感觉，知觉；[生理]感觉，触觉；[心理]感情，情绪；同情；有感觉的；有同情心的；富于感情的；[生理]感觉；认为（feel的现在分词）；触摸

examples.en: Knowing we’d won was a wonderful feeling.
examples.zh: 得知我们赢了，感觉真好。

words.definition: a man; apple, customer, friend, member, guy; companionate
words.translation: 人，家伙；伙伴；家伙；朋友；同事；会员；同伴的，同事的；同道的

examples.en: Paul’s an easy-going sort of fellow.
examples.zh: 保罗人很随和。

words.definition: an animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs; delicate, feminine; she, jenny
words.translation: 雌性的动物；女子；女性的；[生物]雌性的；柔弱的，柔和的；女人；[植][动]雌性动物

examples.en: As a group, females performed better on the test than males.
examples.zh: 整体来说，女性在这次测试中胜过男性。

words.definition: a structure made of wood, metal etc that surrounds a piece of land; bounding wall, perimeter wall; defend, forefend; prevaricate, tergiversate
words.translation: 栅栏；围墙；剑术；防护；用篱笆围住；练习剑术；击剑；搪塞；围以栅栏；跳过栅栏

examples.en: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills.
examples.zh: 村民们说栅栏将限制公众进入山区。

words.definition: a boat that carries people or goods across a river or a narrow area of water; to carry people or things a short distance from one place to another in a boat or other vehicle; lift, cross, wing
words.translation: 渡船；运送；（乘渡船）渡过；用渡船运送；空运

examples.en: They had recrossed the River Gambia by ferry.
examples.zh: 他们乘船又一次渡过了冈比亚河。

examples.en: The ship was used to ferry supplies to Russia during the war.
examples.zh: 这艘船在战时被用来往俄罗斯 运送补给。

words.definition: a special occasion when people celebrate something such as a religious event, and there is often a public holiday; holiday, joy, celebration; cheerful, enjoyable
words.translation: 节日；音乐节；庆祝，纪念活动；欢乐；节日的，喜庆的；快乐的

examples.en: Christmas is one of the main festivals in the Christian Calendar.
examples.zh: 圣诞节是基督教历的重大节日之一。

words.definition: If you fetch something or someone, you go and get them from the place where they are; absorb, attract, engage, draw, strike; take; taking, procurement, scheme, fraud
words.translation: 取回；取来；接来；到达；吸引；拿；取物；卖得；取得；诡计

examples.en: Sylvia fetched a towel from the bathroom.
examples.zh: 西尔维娅从浴室拿来一条毛巾。

examples.en: Fetch me a glass of water.
examples.zh: 给我拿杯水来。

words.definition: an illness or a medical condition in which you have a very high temperature; abandon, febricity; fanaticize; run a temperature, go wild
words.translation: 发热，发烧；狂热；[医]发烧，[临床]发热；[医]使发烧；使狂热；使患热病；[医]发烧；患热病

examples.en: Andy has a fever and won’t be coming into work today.
examples.zh: 安迪发烧了，今天不来上班。

examples.en: I woke up this morning with a fever and an upset stomach.
examples.zh: 今天早上醒来时我发烧了，胃也不舒服。

examples.en: She’s running a fever (= has a fever ) .
examples.zh: 她在发烧。

words.definition: Few is also an adjective; tiny, little, small
words.translation: 很少的；少数的；几乎没有的

examples.en: ...spending her few waking hours in front of the TV.
examples.zh: …把她清醒的个把钟头花在电视机前。

words.definition: the parts of plants that you eat but cannot  digest  . Fibre helps to keep you healthy by moving food quickly through your body.; fiber, funicle
words.translation: 纤维，纤维质；[材]纤维；纤维制品

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables are high in fibre content .
examples.zh: 水果和蔬菜的纤维素含量很高。

examples.en: food that is high in dietary fibre
examples.zh: 富含膳食纤维的食物

words.definition: books and stories about imaginary people and events; invention, novel
words.translation: 小说，虚构的文学作品；小说；虚构，编造；谎言

examples.en: romantic fiction
examples.zh: 爱情小说

examples.en: historical fiction
examples.zh: 历史小说

words.definition: an area of land in the country, especially one where crops are grown or animals feed on grass; domain, province, territory, world, kingdom, universe; wild, feral
words.translation: 田野；田；运动场；领域；牧场；旷野；战场；扫描场；田赛的；野生的

examples.zh: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。
