examples.en: The key was hanging on a nail by the door.
examples.zh: 钥匙挂在门边的一颗钉子上。

words.definition: what someone is called; to say what the name of someone or something is, especially officially; reputation, Bezeichnung; install, constitute, place, style, call
words.translation: 名字；名誉；说出；名称，名字；姓名；命名，任命；指定；称呼；提名；叫出

examples.en: Her name is Mandy Wilson.
examples.zh: 她的名字是曼迪•威尔逊。

examples.en: What’s your name?
examples.zh: 你叫什么名字？

words.definition: nice, limited, finite, exact, precision; neck, channel, sound; straiten
words.translation: 限制；狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的；海峡；狭窄部分，隘路；变窄

words.definition: a country, considered especially in relation to its people and its social or economic structure; country, state, folk, people, soil
words.translation: 民族；国家；国民

examples.en: the President’s radio broadcast to the nation
examples.zh: 总统对全国的广播讲话

examples.en: an independent nation
examples.zh: 独立的国家

examples.en: the world’s leading industrial nations
examples.zh: 世界上的主要工业国

words.definition: related to a whole nation as opposed to any of its parts; state, natl; subject
words.translation: 民族的；国家的；国民的；国立的；国民

examples.en: Religion matters very much at a national level.
examples.zh: 宗教事务在全国都非常重要。

examples.en: Between 1929 and 1933 America’s national income fell by more than half.
examples.zh: 1929至1933年间，美国的国民收入下降过半。

examples.en: There are strong indications that the Prime Minister will call national elections in May.
examples.zh: 有明显迹象预示首相将于5月召集全国大选。

words.definition: the state of being legally a citizen of a particular country; state, folk, people, soil
words.translation: 国籍；民族，族；国籍，国家；民族；部落

examples.en: people of the same nationality
examples.zh: 同国籍的人

words.definition: happening or existing in every part of the country; countrywide
words.translation: 全国性的；全国范围的

examples.en: a nationwide search for a missing British tourist
examples.zh: 在全国范围内对一名失踪英国游客的搜寻

examples.en: nationwide television
examples.zh: 全国性的电视节目

words.definition: a person or people who come from or have always lived in a particular place; a person who was born in a particular place; crude, inherent; indigen, local product
words.translation: 本土的；本地人；本国的；[生物]土著的；天然的；与生俱来的；天赋的；土产；当地居民

examples.en: Singapore has many native species of palm.
examples.zh: 新加坡有很多土生的棕榈树种。

words.definition: existing in nature and not caused, made, or controlled by people; material, physical, born, spontaneous; idiot, baichi
words.translation: 自然界的；天然的；自然的；物质的；天生的；不做作的；自然的事情；白痴；本位音

examples.en: the study of the natural world
examples.zh: 对自然界的研究

examples.en: an area of spectacular natural beauty
examples.zh: 自然风景秀丽的地区

examples.en: death from natural causes
examples.zh: 自然死亡

words.definition: everything in the physical world that is not controlled by humans, such as wild plants and animals, earth and rocks, and the weather; property, category, variety, manner, kind
words.translation: 大自然；本性；性质；自然；种类

examples.en: We grew up in the countryside, surrounded by the beauties of nature.
examples.zh: 我们在乡村长大，周围是美丽的大自然。

examples.en: nature conservation
examples.zh: 自然保护

examples.en: Disease is nature’s way of keeping the population down.
examples.zh: 疾病是大自然控制人口的方法。

words.definition: the part of a country’s military forces that fights at sea; seapower
words.translation: 海军；[军]海军

examples.en: the British Navy
examples.zh: 英国海军

examples.en: He joined the navy during the war.
examples.zh: 他在战争期间参加了海军。

words.definition: only a short distance from a person or thing; only a short distance away from someone or something; familiar, close; rising, forbye; next, anigh
words.translation: 近，接近；近的；亲近的；近似的；近；接近；靠近；近似于

examples.en: They live near London.
examples.zh: 他们住在伦敦附近。

examples.en: I’m sure they live somewhere near here.
examples.zh: 我肯定他们就住在这附近。

examples.en: They moved house to be nearer the school.
examples.zh: 他们把家搬到离学校近一些。

words.definition: not far away; If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away; adjacent, surrounding; around, close by; in the shadow of, in the vicinity of
words.translation: 附近的；在附近；附近的，邻近的；在…附近

examples.en: Lucy was staying in the nearby town of Hamilton.
examples.zh: 露西当时住在附近的汉密尔顿镇。

examples.en: He might easily have been seen by someone who lived nearby.
examples.zh: 他可能很容易被住在附近的人看到。

examples.en: The helicopter crashed to earth nearby.
examples.zh: 直升机坠毁在附近的地面上。

words.definition: almost, but not quite or not completely; almost, most, virtually, practically
words.translation: 差不多；密切地；差不多，几乎

examples.en: It took nearly two hours to get here.
examples.zh: 到这里花了将近两小时。

examples.en: Michelle’s nearly twenty.
examples.zh: 米歇尔年近二十。

examples.en: Is the job nearly finished?
examples.zh: 这工作快干完了吗？

words.definition: tidy and carefully arranged; elegant, flowing, graceful
words.translation: 整洁的；熟练的；灵巧的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的

examples.en: neat handwriting
examples.zh: 工整的笔迹

examples.en: His clothes were always neat and clean.
examples.zh: 他的衣服总是很整洁。

examples.en: Everything in the house was neat and tidy.
examples.zh: 房子里的每样物品都干净整齐。

words.definition: something that is necessary is what you need to have or need to do; inevitable, required, essential, certain, automatic; requirement, want
words.translation: 必要的；必然的；[数]必要的；必需的；必需品

examples.en: The booklet provides all the necessary information about the college.
examples.zh: 这本小册子提供了关于那所学院的所有必需信息。

examples.en: No further changes were considered necessary.
examples.zh: 没有必要作出进一步改变。

examples.en: The doctor says it may be necessary for me to have an operation.
examples.zh: 医生说我可能需要做手术。

words.definition: the part of your body that joins your head to your shoulders, or the same part of an animal or bird; narrow, channel, sound, collar
words.translation: 颈，脖子；脖子；衣领；海峡

examples.en: Mike rubbed the back of his neck.
examples.zh: 迈克揉了揉后颈。

examples.en: You have a lot of tension in your neck muscles.
examples.zh: 你的颈部肌肉很紧张。

examples.en: He patted his horse’s neck.
examples.zh: 他拍了拍马脖子。

words.definition: a string of jewels, beads etc or a thin gold or silver chain to wear around the neck
words.translation: 项链，项圈

examples.en: ...a diamond necklace and matching earrings.
examples.zh: …一条钻石项链和与之相配的耳环。

words.translation: 领带

words.definition: to have to have something or someone, because you cannot do something without them, or because you cannot continue or cannot exist without them; necessity, shortage, want, do, deficiency; ask, lack, claim, to require; wish, to require
words.translation: 需要；aux需要；需要，要求；缺乏；必要之物

examples.en: You don’t really need a car.
examples.zh: 你其实并不需要一辆车。

examples.en: Plants need light in order to survive.
examples.zh: 植物需要光才能存活。

examples.en: The camcorder needs a new battery.
examples.zh: 这台摄像机需要一块新电池。

words.definition: a very thin, pointed steel tube at the end of a syringe, which is pushed into your skin to put a drug or medicine into your body or to take out blood; stimulus, incentive, index, finger, excitement; sew; stimulate, fan, motivate, activate
words.translation: 针，缝补，编织针；[轻]针；指针；刺激；针状物；缝纫；做针线；用针缝

examples.en: She carried hypodermic needles and syringes in her bag.
examples.zh: 她包里带着皮下注射针和针筒。

examples.en: Drug users are at risk when they share needles.
examples.zh: 吸毒者共用注射针很危险。

words.definition: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics; transfer, surmount; transact
words.translation: 谈判，协商，交涉；谈判，商议；转让；越过；谈判，交涉

examples.en: His first aim is to get the warring parties back to the negotiating table (= discussing something ).
examples.zh: 他的首要目标就是把交战各方拉回到谈判桌上。

words.definition: someone who lives next to you or near you; joneses, vicinage; abut upon, abut against; abut; adjacent, nearby
words.translation: 邻居，邻国，邻人；邻居；仁慈的人；邻接；住在邻近；毗邻；友善；邻居的；邻近的

examples.en: One of the neighbors complained about the noise from the party.
examples.zh: 有位邻居抱怨聚会太吵。

examples.en: FBI agents were interviewing all their friends and neighbors.
examples.zh: 联邦调查局人员正在向他们所有的朋友和邻居问话。

examples.en: Our next-door neighbours (= the people who live in the house next to us ) say they’ll look after our cat for us while we’re away.
examples.zh: 我们隔壁的邻居说，我们不在时他们会照顾我们的猫。

words.definition: The neighbourhood of a place or person is the area or the people around them; contiguity, all around
words.translation: 邻居关系；邻近；周围；附近一带

examples.en: ...a suburban Boston neighbourhood close to where I live.
examples.zh: …离我住处较近的波士顿城郊。

words.definition: nor
words.translation: (两者)都不的；也不；既不

examples.en: She lives in retirement, neither making nor receiving visits.
examples.zh: 她过着隐退的生活， 既不访客， 也不见客。

words.definition: the son of your brother or sister, or the son of your husband’s or wife’s brother or sister
words.translation: 侄子，外甥

examples.en: I am planning a 25th birthday party for my nephew.
examples.zh: 我正在为侄子筹划他25岁的生日聚会。

words.definition: worried or frightened about something, and unable to relax; neural, jittery
words.translation: 神经的；易激动的；[解剖]神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的

examples.en: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
examples.zh: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

examples.en: By the time I got into the interview I was a nervous wreck (= was extremely nervous ).
examples.zh: 到了面试的时候，我紧张得要命。

words.definition: a place made or chosen by a bird to lay its eggs in and to live in; soil, eyrie; nidificate
words.translation: 巢，窝，穴；巢，窝；安乐窝；温床；筑巢；找鸟巢

examples.en: a bird’s nest
examples.zh: 鸟窝

examples.en: In May the females build a nest and lay their eggs.
examples.zh: 雌鸟在5月份筑巢产蛋。

examples.en: Young eagles leave the nest after only two months.
examples.zh: 雏鹰仅仅两个月以后就会飞离鸟巢。

words.definition: the system that allows millions of computer users around the world to exchange information; network, web; harvest, come into; pure, whole
words.translation: 网，网状物；通信网；网；网络；净利；实价；得到；净赚；用网捕；纯粹的；净余的

examples.en: Bruce spends most evenings surfing the Net (= looking at information in different places on the Internet ).
examples.zh: 布鲁斯晚上大多在网上浏览信息。

words.definition: a system of lines, tubes, wires, roads etc that cross each other and are connected to each other; net, meshwork
words.translation: 网状物；网络；[计][通信]网络；广播网

examples.en: Hungary’s telephone network
examples.zh: 匈牙利的电话网

examples.en: a high-speed European rail network
examples.zh: 欧洲的高速铁路网

words.definition: not at any time, or not once; none, nothing
words.translation: 永不，决不；不；从未；决不

examples.en: He’s never been to Australia.
examples.zh: 他从未去过澳大利亚。

examples.en: I’m never going back there again, not as long as I live.
examples.zh: 只要我活着，我再也不会回到那儿去。

examples.en: It is never too late to give up smoking.
examples.zh: 戒烟不言晚。

words.definition: recently made, built, invented, written, designed etc; fresh, updated; recently, freshly
words.translation: 新的；新近出现的；新的，新鲜的；更新的；初见的；新近

examples.en: the city’s new hospital
examples.zh: 市里新建的医院

examples.en: the new issue of ‘Time’ magazine
examples.zh: 新一期《时代周刊》

examples.en: new products on the market
examples.zh: 市场上的新产品

words.definition: information about something that has happened recently; message, word, press
words.translation: 新闻，消息；新闻报导

examples.en: I hope to have some good news for you soon.
examples.zh: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

words.definition: a set of large folded sheets of printed paper containing news, articles, pictures, advertisements etc which is sold daily or weekly; paper, courant
words.translation: 报纸，报；报纸

examples.en: She had read about it in the newspapers.
examples.zh: 关于这件事她已经在报纸上看到了。

examples.en: a series of newspaper articles about life in Cuba
examples.zh: 刊登在报纸上的一系列关于古巴生活的文章

words.definition: Thenext place or person is the one that is nearest to you or that is the first one that you come to; secondly, then, afterwards; following, posterior; near, anigh
words.translation: 紧接的；贴近的；然后；下次；其次；下一个的；其次的；靠近；居于…之后

examples.en: Grace sighed so heavily that Trish could hear it in the next room.
examples.zh: 格雷丝沉重地叹气，特蕾什在隔壁房间都听到了。

examples.en: The man in the next chair was asleep.
examples.zh: 邻座的男子睡着了。

words.definition: pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable; precision, exact, narrow, kind, benign
words.translation: 美好的，令人愉快的；精密的；美好的；细微的；和蔼的

examples.en: They’ve got a very nice house.
examples.zh: 他们的房子真漂亮。

examples.en: Did you have a nice time?
examples.zh: 你们玩得开心吗？

examples.en: It’s such a nice day (= good weather ), why not go for a swim?
examples.zh: 天气真好，为什么不去游泳呢？

words.definition: the daughter of your brother or sister, or the daughter of your wife’s or husband’s brother or sister
words.translation: 侄女，外甥女

examples.en: ...his niece, the daughter of his eldest sister.
examples.zh: …他的外甥女，他大姐的女儿。

words.definition: the dark part of each 24-hour period when the sun cannot be seen and when most people sleep; evening, nocte; vesperal
words.translation: 夜，夜间；夜晚，晚上；黑暗，黑夜；夜晚的，夜间的

examples.en: It was a cold moonlit night.
examples.zh: 那是个寒冷的月夜。

examples.en: I didn’t sleep too well last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚睡得不太好。

words.definition: the number 9
words.translation: 九，九个

examples.en: He’s only been in this job for nine months.
examples.zh: 他干这份工作才九个月。

examples.en: We open at nine (= nine o’clock ).
examples.zh: 我们9点开始营业。

examples.en: Kay was taught by her mother till she was nine (= nine years old ).
examples.zh: 凯一直由她妈妈教到九岁。

words.definition: the number 19
words.translation: 十九，十九个

examples.en: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
examples.zh: 当时是7点19分。

examples.en: I was only nineteen (= 19 years old ).
examples.zh: 我当时只有19岁。

words.definition: the number 90
words.translation: 九十，九十个

examples.en: America was far richer in the nineties.
examples.zh: 90年代的美国要富裕得多。

words.definition: one of nine equal parts of something
words.translation: 第九；九分之一

examples.en: In that region, Chile went from ninth to first, overall, as Chilean mobile web use increased by 3200% over the past year.
examples.zh: 智利从这一地区的第九跃升到第一位，因为智利的移动网络用户在过去一年增长了 3200% 。

words.definition: used to give a negative reply to a question, offer, or request; not, non, n't; nah
words.translation: 不；并不；没有；不是

examples.en: ‘Are you Italian?’ ‘No, I’m Spanish.’
examples.zh: “你是意大利人吗？”“不，我是西班牙人。”

examples.en: ‘Do you want any more?’ ‘No thanks.’
examples.zh: “你还要再来点吗？”“不要了，谢谢。”

examples.en: ‘Could you help me write this?’ ‘No, sorry, I haven’t got time at the moment.’
examples.zh: “你能帮我写这个吗？”“抱歉，不行，我现在没时间。”

words.definition: morally good or generous in a way that is admired; magnificent, grand; prince, nobility, aristocrat; grasp, collar
words.translation: 贵族的；高尚的；惰性的；宏伟的；贵族；抓住；逮捕

examples.en: It’s very noble of you to spend all your weekends helping the old folk.
examples.zh: 你心地真好，周末的时间全都用来帮助老人。

examples.en: noble ideals
examples.zh: 崇高的理想

words.definition: no one; small potatoes, worm
words.translation: 谁也不；无人；无名小卒；小人物

examples.en: I knocked on the door but nobody answered.
examples.zh: 我敲了敲门，但没人应门。

words.definition: to move your head up and down, especially in order to show agreement or understanding; swing, bob; noddle; to oscillate, to swing
words.translation: 点(头)；点头表示；点头；打盹；摆动

examples.en: I asked her if she was ready to go, and she nodded.
examples.zh: 我问她是否已准备好出发，她点了点头。

examples.en: Mom nodded her head sympathetically.
examples.zh: 妈妈同情地点了点头。

words.definition: a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or frightening; row-de-dow, klang; rumor; make a sound
words.translation: 喧闹声；响声；噪声；噪音；[环境]杂音；谣传；发出声音；大声议论

examples.en: What’s that noise?
examples.zh: 那是什么声音？

examples.en: Try not to make a noise when you go upstairs.
examples.zh: 上楼时尽量不要弄出声。

examples.en: There was a lot of noise outside.
examples.zh: 外面很吵闹。

words.definition: boisterously, uproariously
words.translation: 吵闹地；吵闹地，喧闹地

examples.en: It’s a colorful scene - laborers unload noisily, and small groups of women haggle for the pots of crabs and sardines to sell at village markets.
examples.zh: 在这个热闹的环境中，工人喧闹地卸着船，三五成群的妇女正在为一盆盆螃蟹和沙丁鱼讨价还价，以便在村里的鱼市出售。

words.definition: someone or something that is noisy makes a lot of noise; furious, boisterous; klang, babelism
words.translation: 嘈杂的；喧闹的；聒噪的；响声；嘈杂声

examples.en: The kids have been really noisy today.
examples.zh: 孩子们今天实在是吵。

examples.en: a noisy engine
examples.zh: 噪声大的发动机

words.definition: not any amount of something or not one of a group of people or things; not having any more understanding or knowledge about something than you had before; lacking, void of; nothing, noway
words.translation: 没有人；毫不；没有的，一点没有的；决不，一点也不

examples.en: I wish I could offer you some cake but there’s none left.
examples.zh: 我真想能请你吃些蛋糕，但一点也没剩的了。

examples.en: Although these were good students, none had a score above 60.
examples.zh: 虽然这些都是好学生，但是没有一个考到60分以上。

examples.en: She waited for a reply, but none came.
examples.zh: 她等着答复，可是什么也没等到。

words.translation: 面条；笨蛋

words.definition: 12 o’clock in the daytime; midday, midnoon
words.translation: 正午，中午；中午；[天]正午；全盛期

examples.en: We met at 12 noon.
examples.zh: 我们中午12点见了面。

words.definition: used when mentioning two things that are not true or do not happen; neither
words.translation: 也不；不；也不是

examples.en: He can neither read nor write (= he cannot read or write ).
examples.zh: 他既不会读也不会写。

examples.en: Hilary was neither shocked nor surprised by the news.
examples.zh: 希拉里对这个消息既没有感到震惊，也没有觉得意外。

examples.en: Neither Matt nor Julie said anything.
examples.zh: 马特和朱莉都没有说什么。

words.definition: usual, typical, or expected; standard, arm's-length; criterion, standard, level, prototype
words.translation: 正常的，普通的；[数]正常的；正规的，标准的；正常；标准；常态

examples.en: A normal working week is 40 hours.
examples.zh: 一个正常的工作周是40小时。

examples.en: She was assessed in the normal way, and placed on the waiting list.
examples.zh: 她接受了正常的评估后被列入等候名单。

examples.en: All I want is to lead a normal life.
examples.zh: 我想要的只是能过正常的生活。

words.definition: the direction that is at the top of a map of the world, above the Equator. It is on the left if you are facing the rising sun; in the north or facing the north; nord; boreal
words.translation: 北，北方；北方的；[测]北，[地理]北方；[地理]北方的；朝北的

examples.en: Which way is north?
examples.zh: 哪边是北？

words.definition: the direction that is exactly between north and east; The northeast edge, corner, or part of a place is the part which is toward the northeast
words.translation: 东北；位于东北的

examples.en: ...the warm waters of Salt Springs Island to the northeast.
examples.zh: …流向东北方向的盐泉岛的温泉水。

examples.en: ...a climate like that of our northeast coast.
examples.zh: …同我们东北部沿海气候相似的一种气候。

words.definition: in or from the north of a country or area; boreal, upstate
words.translation: 北方的，北部的；[地理]北部的；北方的

examples.en: a man with a northern accent

words.definition: a musical play in which all of the words are sung
words.translation: 歌剧

examples.en: We go to the opera (= go to a performance of opera ) regularly.
examples.zh: 我们常去听歌剧。

examples.en: an opera singer
examples.zh: 歌剧演员

words.definition: to use and control a machine or equipment; run, act; attract, keep, produce, work, handle
words.translation: 操作；施行手术；运转；动手术；起作用；经营；引起；对…开刀

examples.en: The Lewis family operated a number of boats on the canal.
examples.zh: 刘易斯一家在运河上经营着几艘船。

examples.en: Clive was experienced in operating the computers.
examples.zh: 克莱夫对操作电脑很有经验。

words.definition: the process of cutting into someone’s body to repair or remove a part that is damaged; work, manipulation
words.translation: 手术；行动；操作；[贸易]经营；[外科]手术；[数][计]运算

examples.en: The UN rescue operation started shortly after dawn.
examples.zh: 联合国的救援行动在破晓后不久就开始了。

words.definition: someone who works on a telephone switchboard, who you can call for help; expert, proprietor
words.translation: 操作人员，接线员；[经管]经营者；[计]操作员；[通信]话务员；行家

examples.en: Hello, operator? Could you put me through to Room 31?
examples.zh: 喂，接线员吗？请帮我接31号房间。

words.definition: your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject; comment, view, judgement, mind, thinking
words.translation: 意见，看法，主张；意见；主张

examples.en: When choosing an insurance policy it’s best to get an independent opinion.
examples.zh: 选择保险时，最好听听专家的独立意见。

words.definition: to disagree with something such as a plan or idea and try to prevent it from happening or succeeding; combat, sit down on; object, sit down on
words.translation: 反对；反抗；对抗，抗争

examples.en: Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
examples.zh: 国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

words.definition: as different as possible from something else; contrary, adverse, counter, against, cross; antithesis, antonym; across
words.translation: 相反的；[植]对面的；对立的；对立面；反义词；在对面

examples.en: I thought the medicine would make him sleep, but it had the opposite effect.
examples.zh: 我以为这药会让他睡觉，但是它却起了反作用。

examples.en: At the opposite extreme, Ashworth’s style is very simple and modern.
examples.zh: 截然相反的是，阿什沃思的风格非常简单和现代。

examples.en: Bob was quicker than Ed? It’s usually the opposite way round.
examples.zh: 鲍勃比埃德快？通常是反过来的。

words.definition: believing that good things will happen in the future; rose-colored, rosy
words.translation: 乐观的；乐观主义的

examples.en: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
examples.zh: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

words.definition: if something is optional, you do not have to do it or use it, but you can choose to if you want to; selectable, hit-or-miss; elective subjects
words.translation: 可以任意选择的；可选择的，随意的；选修科目

examples.en: three optional courses
examples.zh: 三门选修课

examples.en: The other excursions are optional.
examples.zh: 其他的短途旅行是自选项目。

words.definition: used between two words or phrases to show that either of two things is possible, or used before the last in a list of possibilities or choices; either, ossia
words.translation: 或，或者；即；还是

examples.en: Shall we go out to the cinema or stay at home?
examples.zh: 我们是出去看电影还是待在家里？

examples.en: You can have ham, cheese, or tuna.
examples.zh: 你可以选择火腿、干酪或者金枪鱼。

examples.en: She wasn’t involved in drugs or anything like that.
examples.zh: 她没有涉毒之类的行为。

words.definition: spoken, not written; spoken, verbal, word-of-mouth; viva voce
words.translation: 口头的；口的；[药][解剖]口头的，口述的；口试

examples.en: oral history
examples.zh: 口述的历史

examples.en: an oral agreement
examples.zh: 口头协议

words.definition: a round fruit that has a thick orange skin and is divided into parts inside; aurantia; aurantium
words.translation: 橙(树)；柑(树)；橙色的；橘色的；[园艺]橙；橙色；桔子

examples.en: orange juice
examples.zh: 橙汁

examples.en: orange peel
examples.zh: 橙子皮

examples.en: Peel the oranges and divide them into segments.
examples.zh: 把橙子去皮，然后切成片。

words.definition: the curved path travelled by an object which is moving around another much larger object such as the Earth, the Sun etc; to travel in a curved path around a much larger object such as the Earth, the Sun etc; path, track, railway, trajectory; serpentuate, circle round
words.translation: 运行轨道；环绕；[天][航]轨道；[昆]眼眶；势力范围；生活常规；盘旋；绕轨道运行

examples.en: Mars and Earth have orbits which change with time.
examples.zh: 火星和地球的轨道随着时间而发生改变。

words.definition: the way that things or events are arranged in relation to each other, so that one thing is first, another thing is second etc; to tell someone that they must do something, especially using your official power or authority; instruction, bidding, telling, regulation, word; require, command, arrange; command
words.translation: 次序；整齐；命令；[军]命令；顺序；规则；[贸易]定单；整理；定购；[贸易]定货

examples.en: There seemed to be no logical order to the sections.
examples.zh: 这几部分似乎没有逻辑顺序。

words.definition: average, common, or usual, not different or special; usual, general, average, regulation, stock; common
words.translation: 平常的；平凡的；普通的；普通；平常的人（或事）

examples.en: It’s just an ordinary camera.
examples.zh: 这只是普通的相机。

examples.en: The book is about ordinary people.
examples.zh: 这本书描写的是普通人。

examples.en: Art should be part of ordinary life.
examples.zh: 艺术应该是日常生活的一部分。

words.definition: a part of the body, such as the heart or lungs, that has a particular purpose; machinery, apparatus, voice, house
words.translation: 器官；[生物]器官；机构；风琴；管风琴；嗓音

examples.en: the liver, heart, and other internal organs
examples.zh: 肝脏、心脏及其他内脏器官

examples.en: loss of blood flow to his vital organs
examples.zh: 他的生命器官供血不足

examples.en: Extra doses of the hormone caused the animals’ reproductive organs to develop sooner than usual.
examples.zh: 额外使用激素使得这些动物的生殖器官比正常情况下发育得更快。

words.definition: structure, form
words.translation: 组织， 编组；组织（等于organize）；有机化；给予生机

examples.en: Do they organise words around a principle of syntax?
examples.zh: 他们会按照一定的句法规则组织单词吗？

examples.en: And where it is needed—to organise investment in infrastructure, for instance, and to regulate markets—it needs to become more open in its dealings.
examples.zh: 而在那些需要政府去组织投资、监管市场的方面（比如说基础设施部门），在管理过程中需要变得更为开放。

examples.en: The team then started to organise a set of clinical trials of personalised treatments for lung and breast cancer.
examples.zh: 于是研究小组开始着手组织一套针对肺癌和乳腺癌病人的个人化治疗临床试验。

words.translation: 组织者；发起人；形成体（等于organizer）

words.definition: a group such as a club or business that has formed for a particular purpose; fabric, machinery, system, community, body
words.translation: 组织；团体，机构；机构；体制；团体

examples.en: The public expect high standards from any large organization.
examples.zh: 公众对任何大型机构都期望很高。

examples.en: the World Trade Organization
examples.zh: 世界贸易组织

examples.en: a voluntary organization which helps disabled people with their transport needs
examples.zh: 帮助残疾人士满足其交通需求的一个志愿组织

words.definition: the place or situation in which something begins to exist; birth, extraction, dawn
words.translation: 起源；[数]原点；出身；开端

examples.en: The tradition has its origins in the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 这一传统源于中世纪。

examples.en: old folk tales of unknown origin
examples.zh: 起源不明的古老民间传说

words.definition: You use other to refer to an additional thing or person of the same type as one that has been mentioned or is known about; another, else
words.translation: 另外的；其余的；其他的，另外的

examples.en: They were just like any other young couple.
examples.zh: 他们那时就和其他任何年轻夫妇一样。

words.definition: used when saying what bad thing will happen if something is not done; else, extra; another, elsewise
words.translation: 另外；要不然；否则；在其他方面；另外的；其他方面的

examples.en: You’ll have to go now, otherwise you’ll miss your bus.
examples.zh: 你现在就得走，要不然就赶不上公共汽车了。

examples.en: Put your coat on, otherwise you’ll get cold.
examples.zh: 穿上外套，不然你会着凉的。

words.translation: 渥太华（加拿大首都）
扣环；哎哟（突然疼痛时发出的声音）

words.definition: should, must; would have, be supposed to
words.translation: aux应当，应该；应该，应当；大概
我们的

examples.en: They partook of our triumph.
examples.zh: 他们分享我们的胜利。

examples.en: She spread our lunch on the grass.
examples.zh: 她在草地上摆好了我们的午饭。

examples.en: We avenged ourselves on  our enemy.
examples.zh: 我们向我们的敌人报仇。

words.definition: used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with us
words.translation: 我们的

examples.en: I’ll show you to your room. Ours is next door.
examples.zh: 我带你去你的房间，我们的房间在你的隔壁。

examples.en: The main difference between our brains and those of monkeys is that ours are bigger.
examples.zh: 我们的大脑和猴子的大脑之间的主要差别在于我们的要大些。

examples.en: No, that’s not ours.
examples.zh: 不，那不是我们的。

words.definition: used by the person speaking to show that they and one or more other people are affected by their own action
words.translation: 我们自己

examples.en: We prepared ourselves for the long journey ahead.
examples.zh: 我们为将要开始的长途旅行做好了准备。

examples.en: It was strange seeing ourselves on television.
examples.zh: 在电视上看到自己感觉很奇怪。

words.definition: from inside an object, container, building, or place; aloud, outward; outer, outside, external; putout; towards, unto, at, on, to; emerge, come forth; expel, dispel

examples.en: She opened her suitcase and took out a pair of shoes.
examples.zh: 她打开手提箱，拿出一双鞋。

examples.en: Lock the door on your way out.
examples.zh: 你出去时把门锁上。

examples.en: Charlotte went to the window and looked out.
examples.zh: 夏洛特走到窗前往外看。

words.definition: the final result of a meeting, discussion, war etc – used especially when no one knows what it will be until it actually happens; product, result, conclusion, event, feedback
words.translation: 结果；结果，结局；成果

examples.en: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
examples.zh: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

words.definition: outside, not in a building; alfresco, out-of-doors; open air; out of door, hypaethral
words.translation: 在户外，在野外；在户外；户外；户外的（等于outdoor）

examples.zh: 今晚很暖和，可以在户外用餐。

examples.en: He likes to work outdoors.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在户外工作。

words.definition: on the outside of something; outside, external, out
words.translation: 外部的，外面的；外面的，外部的；远离中心的

examples.en: Remove the tough outer leaves before cooking.
examples.zh: 烹煮之前先把外面的老叶子去掉。

words.definition: someone who is outgoing likes to meet and talk to new people; egressive; issue, expense, flux, going out; exceeding
words.translation: 开朗的；外出的；即将离职的；乐于助人的；外出；流出；开支；超过；优于（outgo的ing形式）

examples.zh: 我们在找一个性格外向的人。

words.definition: a short trip that a group of people take for pleasure; excursion, jaunt; baring

examples.zh: 一天晚上，她难得地去了一趟当地的夜总会。

words.translation: 梗概，提纲，草稿，要点；轮廓；大纲；概要；略图；概述；略述；描画…轮廓

examples.zh: 研究计划梗概

examples.en: Output is up 30% on last year.
examples.zh: 产量比去年提高了30%。

words.definition: the part or surface of something that is furthest from the centre; outer, external, out; without, surface, face, garment; without, ectad; beyond the pale

examples.en: ...the outside of the building.
examples.zh: …该建筑物的外部。

words.definition: expressing your opinions honestly and directly, even when doing this might annoy some people; honest, transparent, open
words.translation: 直言不讳的， 坦率的；坦率的，直言不讳的

examples.en: an outspoken critic of the education reforms
examples.zh: 对教育改革直言不讳的批评者

words.definition: extremely good; prominent, excellent, obvious, brilliant, marked
words.translation: 突出的，杰出的；杰出的；显著的；未解决的；[会计][经]未偿付的

examples.en: an outstanding example of a 13th-century castle
examples.zh: 13世纪城堡的杰出典范

examples.en: an outstanding success
examples.zh: 了不起的成功

examples.en: His performance was outstanding.
examples.zh: 他的表演相当出色。

words.definition: relating to how a person or situation seems to be, rather than how it really is; outer, outside, external, material, open; forth, out; person, external, garment, without

examples.zh: 该地区的经济和面貌发生了很大的变化。

examples.en: His clenched fist was the only outward sign of his anger.
examples.zh: 他那紧握的拳头是他内心愤怒的唯一外在表现。

words.translation: 椭圆形的；椭圆形；椭圆的；[数]卵形的；[数]卵形

examples.zh: …一个小男孩的镶在椭圆形框架里的小幅照片。

words.definition: above or higher than something, without touching it; all up; upon, onto, beyond, past, up; ended, upper, closing, past, concluding; negotiate, surmount
words.translation: 在…上方；超过；结束；越过；从头到尾；在…之上；遍于…之上；结束的；上面的

examples.zh: 一盏灯悬挂在桌子上方。

examples.en: She leaned over the desk to answer the phone.
examples.zh: 她身子探过桌面接电话。

examples.en: The sign over the door said ‘Mind your head’.
examples.zh: 门上方的警示牌写着“小心碰头”。

words.definition: a long thick warm coat; outerwear, outer coat
words.translation: 外衣，大衣；[服装]大衣，外套

examples.zh: 给她买那件大衣，我花了400镑。

examples.en: He placed his cap and overcoat on a chair.
examples.zh: 他把帽子和大衣搁在一张椅子上。

examples.en: She removed all the grease stains from her overcoat.
examples.zh: 她把她大衣上所有油渍都去掉了。

words.definition: to successfully control a feeling or problem that prevents you from achieving something; exceed, cap, surmount; rise above, get over sth
words.translation: 战胜，克服；克服；胜过；得胜

examples.en: He struggled to overcome his shyness.
examples.zh: 他努力克服自己的羞怯。

examples.en: Her financial problems could no longer be overcome.
examples.zh: 她的经济困难再也无法解决。

words.definition: forget, examine, survey, review, inspect; inobservancy, negligence
words.translation: 眺望；看漏；放任；忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上；忽视

words.definition: superheavy; load down
words.translation: 超重的；[交]超重的；过重的；使负担过重；[交]超重

examples.en: I wonder if this letter is overweight.
examples.zh: 我想知道这封信是否超重。

examples.en: If your luggage is overweight, you'll have to pay extra.
examples.zh: 假如你的行李过重了， 你得付额外的运费。

examples.en: Why are so many of us overweight?
examples.zh: 为什么我们中的许多人会超重？

words.definition: to need to pay someone for something that they have done for you or sold to you, or to need to give someone back money that they have lent you; appreciate, be grateful to
words.translation: 欠；应把…归功于；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于

examples.en: How much do I owe you (= often used to show that you want to pay for something )?
examples.zh: 我该付你多少钱？

words.definition: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with a particular person or thing and not any other; to have something which belongs to you, especially because you have bought it, been given it etc and it is legally yours; accept, agree, recognize, acknowledge, grant; accept, recognize; typical, characteristic, proper, very
words.translation: 自己的；有，拥有；拥有；承认；特有的

examples.en: Bring your own equipment.
examples.zh: 带上你自己的装备。

examples.en: Every dance has its own rhythm.
examples.zh: 每一种舞蹈都有自己的节奏。

examples.en: The yacht was intended for the King’s own personal use.
examples.zh: 这艘游艇是专供国王私用的。

words.definition: someone who owns something; proprietor
words.translation: 物主，所有人；[经]所有者；[法]物主

examples.en: He was now the proud owner of a bright red sports car.
examples.zh: 他现在拥有了一辆亮红色跑车，很是自豪。

words.definition: the fact of owning something; property, droit
words.translation: 所有(权)，所有制；[法]所有权；物主身份

examples.en: The price of home ownership is increasing.
examples.zh: 房价在不断上涨。

words.definition: a bull whose sex organs have been removed, often used for working on farms; cattle, bull
words.translation: 牛；公牛，阉牛；[畜牧][脊椎]牛；公牛

words.translation: 氧， 氧气；氧气，[化学]氧

examples.zh: 人脑缺氧只需4分钟就会造成永久性损伤。

words.definition: the speed at which someone walks, runs, or moves; to walk first in one direction and then in another many times, especially because you are nervous; footwork
words.translation: 步，步速；踱步；一步；步速；步法

examples.en: He quickened his pace , longing to be home.
examples.zh: 他加快步伐，盼望着早点回到家中。

examples.en: Traffic slowed to a walking pace .
examples.zh: 车流速度减缓，犹如步行。

words.definition: peaceful and loving or wanting peace; peaceful, soft, calm, moderate, gentle
words.translation: 和平的；太平洋；温和的；平静的

examples.en: a normally pacific community
examples.zh: 平日里静悄悄的社区

words.definition: to go in large numbers into a space, or to make people or animals do this, until the space is too full; something wrapped in paper or packed in a box and then sent by post or taken somewhere; pair, casing; impact, select, stuff; pile, crowd, host
words.translation: 捆扎；挤满；包；[包装]包装；一群；背包；[临床]包裹；一副；压紧；挑选；塞满；挤；包装货物；[包装]被包装；群集

examples.en: Hundreds of people packed into the mosque.
examples.zh: 成百上千的人挤进了清真寺。

words.definition: something wrapped in paper, packed in a box, and then sent by mail or delivered; envelopment, fardel; parcel
words.translation: 包裹，包，捆；[计][通信]包，[邮]包裹；套装软件，程序包；打包；将…包装

examples.en: There’s a package here for a Miami Lakes address.
examples.zh: 这里有一个寄往迈阿密湖的包裹。

words.definition: a small flat package that is sent by post or delivered to someone; parcel; encase, sheathe
words.translation: 小包(裹)，小捆；[计]数据包，信息包；[贸易]小包，小捆；包装，打包

examples.zh: 保罗一收到包裹就拆开了。

words.translation: 划桨；明轮翼；拌；搅；用桨划；戏水；涉水

examples.en: We might be able to push ourselves across with the paddle.
examples.zh: 我们或许可以自己划桨过去。

words.definition: one side of a piece of paper in a book, newspaper, document etc, or the sheet of paper itself; period, season, day, register, log; leaf, glance through

examples.zh: 僵硬疼痛的关节

examples.zh: 你的手臂很疼吗？

examples.zh: 脖子肿起来了，一碰就疼。

examples.zh: 天花板需要粉刷了。

examples.zh: 粉刷得很亮丽的房屋

examples.zh: 起居室被漆成淡雅的粉色和蓝色。

words.translation: 漆工，画家，绘画者；画家；油漆匠

examples.zh: 格里的志向是成为一名肖像画家。

words.definition: a painted picture that you put on a wall for people to see; brushwork, coloration; drawing
words.translation: 油画；绘画；着色；绘画（paint的ing形式）；涂色于

examples.zh: 一批珍贵的画作

words.translation: 平底锅，盘子；[轻]平锅，盘子；摇镜头

examples.zh: 锅碗瓢盆

examples.zh: 把意大利面放在一大锅开水里煮。

examples.zh: 笼子里的大熊猫贴在栅栏上蹭它的身体。

examples.zh: 不，如果明天早上那熊猫还不走

words.translation: 恐慌的；恐慌，惊慌；[金融]大恐慌；没有理由的；使恐慌

examples.zh: 她的脸因恐慌而变相了。

examples.zh: 惊慌的人群向四面八方逃去。

examples.zh: 由于我纯粹因惊慌而做的事，他们认为我很有勇气。

words.definition: material in the form of thin sheets that is used for writing on, wrapping things etc; thesis, dissertation, newspaper, document, file

examples.zh: 我给你找张纸，你好把号码写下来。

examples.zh: 你有笔和纸吗？

words.translation: (文章的)段，节

words.definition: two lines, paths etc that are parallel to each other are the same distance apart along their whole length; contrast; same, uniform

words.definition: an object that has been wrapped in paper or put in a special envelope, especially so that it can be sent by post; package, bindle; package, enlace
words.translation: 包裹，小包，邮包；[邮]包裹，小包；打包；捆扎

examples.en: The parcel was delivered last week.
examples.zh: 那个邮包上周送到了。

examples.en: He sends regular food parcels to his family in Libya.
examples.zh: 他定期给在利比亚的家人邮寄食品包裹。

words.definition: used to say ‘sorry’ after you have made an impolite sound such as a  burp; to forgive someone for behaving badly; forgiveness, absolution; forgive, tolerate
words.translation: 原谅；赦免；[法]赦免；宽恕

examples.zh: 沃尔特请求她原谅自己给她造成那么多痛苦。

words.definition: the father or mother of a person or animal; father, principle, root
words.translation: 父亲，母亲，双亲；父亲（或母亲）；父母亲；根源

examples.zh: 14 岁以下儿童须由一位家长陪同。

examples.zh: 那些蛋由两只亲鸟共同守护着。

examples.en: Melissa’s spending the weekend at her parents’ house.
examples.zh: 梅利莎正在父母家度周末。

examples.zh: 那个凶手被追踪到巴黎。

examples.zh: 这封电报将把他截在巴黎。

examples.en: We have to change for Paris at this station.
examples.zh: 我们必须在这个车站换车去巴黎。

words.definition: a large open area with grass and trees, especially in a town, where people can walk, play games etc; public garden, stopping place; check, place in
words.translation: 公园；停车场；[建]公园；[交]停车场；停放；放置；寄存

examples.zh: 我们去公园散步吧。

examples.en: a park bench
examples.zh: 公园长椅

examples.zh: 一套可以俯瞰海德公园的公寓

words.definition: the act of parking a car or other vehicle; power-off
words.translation: 机动车停放；停车场；[交]停车

examples.en: No Parking (= used on signs )
examples.zh: 禁止停车

examples.en: a £45 parking fine
examples.zh: 45英镑的违章停车罚款

words.definition: a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly coloured feathers that can be taught to copy human speech; Nuri, popinjay
words.translation: 鹦鹉；[鸟]鹦鹉；学舌者，应声虫；机械模仿别人的人

examples.zh: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

words.translation: 参与，参加；分享；分担

examples.zh: 这件事没有其他人牵涉其中。

examples.en: Most students choose one particular area for research.
examples.zh: 大多数学生选择一个特定领域进行研究。

examples.en: a particular type of food
examples.zh: 某一类食品

words.definition: to some degree, but not completely; half
words.translation: 部分地，不完全地；部分地；在一定程度上

examples.zh: 天气不好是造成坠机事故的部分原因。

examples.zh: 那家公司的问题部分是由于管理不善造成的。

examples.en: It is partly because of her sick mother that she hasn’t taken the job abroad.
examples.zh: 她没有接受那份去国外的工作，部分原因是母亲病了。

words.definition: one of two people who are married, or who live together and have a sexual relationship; comrade, associate; joint stock, tie up; team
words.translation: 伙伴；搭挡；配偶；[法]合伙人；[法]合伙；合股；成为搭档；使合作；与…合伙

examples.zh: 和伴侣谈谈你的忧虑。

examples.zh: 人群分开让卡车通过。

examples.zh: 他们对命运的消极接受

examples.zh: 我提心吊胆地沿着花园的小道向前门走去。

examples.zh: 草地上被踏出的小径

examples.zh: 你只能耐心点，等我打完电话。

words.translation: 模式；图案；样品；模仿；以图案装饰

examples.zh: 一个总体模式开始显现。

examples.zh: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

words.translation: 和平；和睦；平静；秩序

examples.zh: 这是多年来该国与其邻国第一次和平共处。

examples.zh: 到那个世纪末，法国和英国议和了。

examples.zh: 不同宗教的人们和平共处数百年的城市

words.translation: 平静的，和平的；和平的，爱好和平的；平静的

examples.zh: 孩子们不在，我们度过了一个宁静的下午。

examples.en: It’s very peaceful out here in the woods.
examples.zh: 这树林里真安静。

examples.zh: 那些男孩子把我们花园里的桃树抢摘光了。

examples.zh: 这片桃树中杂有几棵苹果树。

words.translation: 梨子，梨树

examples.zh: 我误将这个苹果当作梨子，直到我尝了才知道。

words.translation: 农民；乡下人

examples.zh: 大多数村民是农民。

words.translation: 行人，步行者；徒步的；缺乏想像力的；行人；步行者

examples.zh: 所有受伤的行人中有1/3以上是儿童。

words.translation: 钢笔，自来水笔；钢笔；作家；围栏；写；关入栏中

words.definition: an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a wooden stick with a thin piece of a black or coloured substance in the middle
words.translation: 铅笔

examples.zh: 尖尖的铅笔

examples.en: a blue pencil
examples.zh: 蓝色铅笔

examples.en: a pencil sketch

examples.zh: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了一个多便士。

examples.zh: 如果你是自由职业者，应该考虑办理私人养老金事宜。

examples.zh: 许多人发现仅凭国家基本养老金不能养活自己。

examples.zh: 有多少人到会？

examples.zh: 至少有40人遇害。

words.definition: a powder that is used to add a hot taste to food; if something is peppered with things, it has a lot of those things in it or on it; peper, capsicum; besprinkle
words.translation: 胡椒，胡椒粉；在…上撒；使布满；[食品][植]胡椒；[园艺]辣椒；胡椒粉；[食品]加胡椒粉于

examples.en: salt and pepper
examples.zh: 盐和胡椒粉

words.definition: during each hour etc; in accordance, in the light of
words.translation: 每；经；按照；每一

examples.en: The park attracts four million visitors per year.
examples.zh: 那座公园每年吸引400万游客。

words.definition: proportion, part, portion, integral, fraction
words.translation: 百分之…；[数]百分比，百分率；部分；百分数

examples.en: At the end of the day, add up the percent DVs.
examples.zh: 在一天结束后，把所有营养素的百分比加起来。

examples.en: Machines are delivering up to only 25 percent of the fuel they combust.
examples.zh: 机器的运转效率只能达到所耗燃料的百分之二十五。

examples.en: But there are billions more people out there who are not in the top one percent, and they’re not in the top two or three either.
examples.zh: 但是还有十亿多的人不在其中，他们不在其中的百分之一，也不再其中的两百分之一或者三百分之一的其中。

words.definition: an amount expressed as if it is part of a total which is 100; centage
words.translation: 百分比，百分率；[数]百分比；百分率，百分数

examples.en: Interest rates fell by six percentage points (= 6% ) .
examples.zh: 利息下降了6个百分点。

examples.en: The numbers are small in percentage terms (= when calculated as a percentage ) .
examples.zh: 按百分比来看，这些数字很小。

words.definition: not having any mistakes, faults, or damage; greatest, ideal, prime, best, full; round off, polish up
words.translation: 完美的；完全的；最好的；精通的；使完美；使熟练

examples.en: His English was perfect.
examples.zh: 他的英语很地道。

examples.en: The car was in perfect condition.
examples.zh: 这辆车的车况极佳。

examples.en: You’re very lucky to have perfect teeth.
examples.zh: 你能拥有一口完美的牙齿太幸运了。

words.definition: to do something to entertain people, for example by acting a play or playing a piece of music; accomplish, implement, achieve, complete, fulfil; put into effect, to carry out
words.translation: 履行，执行；演出；执行；完成；演奏；执行，机器运转；表演

examples.en: Chenier and the band are performing at the Silver Palace tomorrow.
examples.zh: 车尼尔和乐队明天将在银宫演出。

examples.en: The children perform two plays each school year.
examples.zh: 孩子们一学年表演两部话剧。

words.definition: when someone performs a play or a piece of music; property, capability, enforcement, execution, implementing
words.translation: 演出，履行，表现；性能；绩效；表演；执行

examples.en: This evening’s performance will begin at 8.00 pm.
examples.zh: 今晚的演出8点开始。

words.definition: an actor, musician etc who performs to entertain people; player, executive
words.translation: 表演者；执行者；演奏者

examples.en: circus performers
examples.zh: 马戏演员

examples.en: He was a better songwriter than performer.
examples.zh: 他更擅长写歌，而不是演唱。

words.definition: a liquid with a strong pleasant smell that women put on their skin or clothing to make themselves smell nice; to make a place have a sweet pleasant smell; fragrance, parfum
words.translation: 香水，香料，香气；使充满芳香；洒香水于；香水；香味

examples.en: She was wearing the perfume that he’d bought her.
examples.zh: 她擦了他买给她的香水。

words.definition: used to say that something may be true, but you are not sure; maybe, possibly, like; assumption, presupposition
words.translation: 也许，可能，多半；也许；可能；假定；猜想；未定之事

examples.en: Perhaps she’s next door.
examples.zh: 她也许在隔壁。

examples.en: Perhaps it will snow tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天可能会下雪。

examples.en: It won’t take so long next time, perhaps.
examples.zh: 也许下次不用那么久。

words.definition: a particular length of time with a beginning and an end; hour, circle, cycle, season, day
words.translation: 时期；学时；句号；周期，期间；月经；课时

examples.en: Tomorrow’s weather will be dry with sunny periods.
examples.zh: 明天天气干燥，间或晴朗。

examples.en: The drug was tested over a five-week period.
examples.zh: 那种药品进行了为期五周的试验。

examples.en: They adopted the system for a trial period (= time in which something is tested to see if it works well ) .
examples.zh: 那套系统他们试用了一段时间。

words.definition: continuing to exist for a long time or for all the time in the future; eternal, constant, steady, lasting, perpetual
words.translation: 永久的；永久的，永恒的；不变的

examples.en: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
examples.zh: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

examples.en: a permanent change in your eating habits
examples.zh: 饮食习惯的永久改变

examples.en: The blindness that the disease causes will be permanent.
examples.zh: 这种疾病引起的失明是永久性的。

words.definition: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it; allows, liberty, leave
words.translation: 允许，许可，同意；允许，许可

examples.en: He asked permission to leave the room.
examples.zh: 他请求离开房间的许可。

examples.en: They cannot leave the country without permission.
examples.zh: 没有许可他们不得离开这个国家。

words.definition: to allow something to happen, especially by an official decision, rule, or law; to allow, make a promise; license, let, have, grant; license, patent
words.translation: 允许；执照；许可；许可证，执照

examples.en: Smoking is only permitted in the public lounge.
examples.zh: 只允许在公共休息室里抽烟。

examples.en: He had more than the permitted level of alcohol in his blood.
examples.zh: 他血液中的酒精含量超出了允许的水平。

words.definition: a human being, especially considered as someone with their own particular character; body, feature, creature, human being, garment
words.translation: 人；人身；本人；[人类]人；身体；容貌，外表；人称

examples.en: He was a very nice person, always pleasant and friendly.
examples.zh: 他是个很好的人，始终彬彬有礼。

examples.en: The only person who really said anything helpful was Jack.
examples.zh: 只有一个人真正说了些有用的话，就是杰克。

examples.en: I like her as a person , but not as a boss.
examples.zh: 我喜欢她这个人，但作为老板我就不喜欢了。

words.definition: belonging or relating to one particular person, rather than to other people or to people in general; individual, subjective, physical
words.translation: 个人的；本人的；身体的；亲自的

examples.en: My personal view is that we shouldn’t offer him the job.
examples.zh: 我个人认为我们不该给他这份工作。

examples.en: Style and colour are a matter of personal taste .
examples.zh: 款式和颜色是个人爱好问题。

examples.en: She took full personal responsibility for all the arrangements.
examples.zh: 她个人对所有的安排承担全部责任。

words.definition: used to emphasize that you are only giving your own opinion about something; separately, individually
words.translation: 亲自；就个人来说；亲自地；当面；个别地；就自己而言

examples.en: Personally, I don’t think much of the idea.
examples.zh: 就个人而言，我认为这个主意不怎么样。

examples.en: I personally think it’s too cold to go out.
examples.zh: 我个人认为太冷了不能出去。

words.definition: the people who work in a company, organization, or military force; crew, Personnel Department
words.translation: 全体人员，全体职员；人事部门；全体人员

examples.en: All personnel are to receive security badges.
examples.zh: 所有人员都将拿到安保徽章。

words.definition: to make someone decide to do something, especially by giving them reasons why they should do it, or asking them many times to do it; satisfy, convince, argue; talk around, win over; available, leisure, off
words.translation: 说服；说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事；被说服；空闲的，有闲的

examples.en: He was fairly easily persuaded .
examples.zh: 他很轻易就被说服了。

words.definition: a small animal or insect that destroys crops or food supplies; verm, injurious insect
words.translation: 害虫；[植保]有害之物；讨厌的人

examples.en: a chemical used in pest control
examples.zh: 用于防治虫害的一种化学品

words.definition: an animal such as a cat or a dog which you keep and care for at home; vitality, animation; dote on, cosset; take offense, take offence; favorite, fond
words.translation: 爱畜；宠儿a宠爱的；宠物；生气；受宠爱的人；宠爱；爱抚；宠爱的

examples.en: They have two pets – a cat and a dog.
examples.zh: 他们有两只宠物，一只猫和一只狗。

examples.en: We weren’t allowed to keep pets at school.
examples.zh: 学校里不许我们养宠物。

examples.en: Rabbits make good pets .
examples.zh: 兔子是很好的宠物。

words.definition: a liquid obtained from  petroleum  that is used to supply power to the engine of cars and other vehicles; gasoline, gas
words.translation: (英)汽油；（英）[油气]汽油

examples.en: unleaded petrol
examples.zh: 无铅汽油

examples.en: petrol prices
examples.zh: 汽油价格

examples.en: The petrol tank is leaking.
examples.zh: 油箱漏了。

words.definition: something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand; wonder, miracle
words.translation: 现象；[物]现象；奇迹；杰出的人才

examples.en: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
examples.zh: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

words.definition: a telephone; telephone, call; call up sb, ring up; telephone, call up sb
words.translation: 电话，电话机；耳机；[通信]电话；耳机，听筒；[通信]打电话

examples.en: Much of his work is done by phone .
examples.zh: 他的工作大部分是通过电话进行的。

examples.en: Who was that on the phone ?
examples.zh: 谁来的电话？

examples.en: I wish Amy would get off the phone .
examples.zh: 我真希望埃米别再打电话了。

words.definition: a photograph; picture, pix
words.translation: 照片，相片；照片

examples.en: Can you take a photo of me and Rachel?
examples.zh: 你能给我和雷切尔拍张照吗？

words.definition: a picture obtained by using a camera and film that is sensitive to light; take a photo, to take a picture; picture, pix
words.translation: 照片，相片；拍照；在照片上显得；照片，[摄]相片

examples.en: a colour photograph
examples.zh: 彩色照片

examples.en: a black and white photograph
examples.zh: 黑白照片

examples.en: Tim was looking through an old photograph album (= book in which you put photographs ) .
examples.zh: 蒂姆在翻看一本旧相册。

words.definition: someone who takes photographs, especially as a professional or as an artist; cameraman, lensman
words.translation: 摄影师；照相师

examples.en: a fashion photographer
examples.zh: 时装摄影师

words.definition: a group of words that have a particular meaning when used together, or which someone uses on a particular occasion; idiom, diction
words.translation: 短语；习惯用语；成语；习语；措词

examples.en: Who first used the phrase ‘survival of the fittest’?
examples.zh: “适者生存”这一说法最早是谁说的？

examples.en: Shakespeare’s plays are full of well-known phrases .
examples.zh: 莎士比亚的戏剧中写满了众所周知的名言警句。

words.definition: related to someone’s body rather than their mind or emotions; personal, material, natural; medical examination, check-up
words.translation: 身体上的；[物]物理的；身体的；物质的；体格检查

examples.en: She was in constant physical pain.
examples.zh: 她一直感到身上疼痛。

examples.en: the physical and emotional needs of young adults
examples.zh: 青年人的身心需求

examples.en: people with severe physical disabilities
examples.zh: 身体重度残疾的人

words.definition: a doctor; medical doctor, medico
words.translation: 医生，内科医生；[医]医师；[内科]内科医师

examples.en: ...your family physician.
examples.zh: …你的家庭医生。

words.definition: a scientist who has special knowledge and training in  physics; physical scientist
words.translation: 物理学家；唯物论者

examples.en: ...a nuclear physicist.
examples.zh: …一位核物理学家。

words.definition: the science concerned with the study of physical objects and substances, and of natural forces such as light, heat, and movement
words.translation: 物理，物理学

examples.en: ...the laws of physics.
examples.zh: …物理学定律。

words.definition: someone who plays the piano
words.translation: 钢琴家

examples.en: She was an accomplished pianist, a superb swimmer, and a gifted artist.
examples.zh: 她曾是一位很有造诣的钢琴家、一流的游泳健将和天才艺术家。

words.definition: a large musical instrument that has a long row of black and white  key s  . You play the piano by sitting in front of it and pressing the keys.
words.translation: 钢琴

examples.en: Jean accompanied her on the piano .
examples.zh: 琼为她钢琴伴奏。

words.definition: a  pickaxe; select, choose from; dig, handpick; chose, selection, choice
words.translation: 镐，鹤嘴锄；挑选；采摘；挖；拾取；掘；精选；选择；[农机]鹤嘴锄

words.definition: if you have a picnic, you take food and eat it outdoors, especially in the country; to have a picnic; junket
words.translation: 郊游，野餐；野餐

examples.en: We decided to have a picnic down by the lake.
examples.zh: 我们决定在湖边野餐。

examples.en: a picnic table
examples.zh: 野餐桌

examples.en: There is free parking for visitors, as well as a restaurant and picnic area (= a special area with tables where people can have a picnic ) .
examples.zh: 除了餐厅和野餐区，我们还为游客提供免费停车位。

words.definition: shapes, lines etc painted or drawn on a surface, showing what someone or something looks like; to show someone or something in a photograph, painting, or drawing; photo, scenery, drawing, landscape, prospect; draw, imagine, brush, think of
words.translation: 画，图片；画；照片，图画；影片；景色；化身；想像；描写

examples.en: The room had several pictures on the walls.
examples.zh: 那个房间墙上有几幅画。

examples.en: a book with pictures in it
examples.zh: 带插图的书

examples.en: He asked her permission to paint her picture (= paint a picture of her ) .
examples.zh: 他请求她允许为她画像。

words.definition: fruit baked inside a  pastry  covering; pastie, talkee-talkee; clutter up
words.translation: (西点)馅饼；馅饼；饼图；爱说话的人；使杂乱

examples.en: I had a steak and kidney pie with chips.
examples.zh: 我吃了一份牛肉腰子馅饼加薯条。

words.definition: an amount of something that has been separated from the main part; block, mass; cement, joint
words.translation: 碎片，块；拼合；[计]块；件；篇；硬币；修补；接合；凑合

examples.en: Cut off a piece of wood 5 cm in length.
examples.zh: 截下一段五厘米长的木头。

examples.en: His trousers were held up with a piece of string.
examples.zh: 他的裤子靠一根细绳系着。

examples.en: Would you like a small or a large piece?
examples.zh: 你想要一小块还是一大块？

words.definition: a farm animal with short legs, a fat body and a curved tail. Pigs are kept for their meat, which includes  pork  ,  bacon  and  ham  .; police, copper, swine, pork
words.translation: 猪，小猪，野猪；猪；猪肉；警察

examples.en: He kept pigs and poultry.
examples.zh: 他养过猪和家禽。

words.definition: a group of several things of the same type that are put on top of each other; to arrange things in a pile; lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, body; cumulate; crowd, pack
words.translation: 堆；堆叠，累积；大量；建筑群；累积；打桩于；挤；堆积；积累

examples.en: He balanced the plate on the top of a pile of books.
examples.zh: 他把盘子在一摞书上放稳。

words.definition: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow whole; globule, bullet; harry, rob of
words.translation: 药丸，丸剂；药丸；弹丸，子弹；口服避孕药；把…制成丸剂；使服用药丸；抢劫，掠夺（古语）

examples.en: He has to take pills to control his blood pressure.
examples.zh: 他必须服药控制血压。

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["sleeping pills"]}
examples.zh: 安眠药

examples.en: a bottle of vitamin pills
examples.zh: 一瓶维生素片

words.definition: a cloth bag filled with soft material that you put your head on when you are sleeping; weeping willow
words.translation: 枕头

examples.en: I’ll be asleep as soon as my head hits the pillow.
examples.zh: 我头一碰到枕头就会睡着。

words.definition: someone who operates the controls of an aircraft or spacecraft; aviator, amn; to navigate, experiment with
words.translation: 领航员；飞行员；[航]飞行员；[水运]领航员；[航]驾驶；[水运]领航；试用

examples.en: an airline pilot
examples.zh: 航空公司飞行员

examples.en: a fighter pilot
examples.zh: 战斗机驾驶员

examples.en: The official report into the accident says that it was caused by pilot error (= a mistake by the pilot ) .
examples.zh: 那宗事故的官方报告称事故是由飞行员失误造成的。

words.definition: a piece of metal, sometimes containing jewels, that you fasten to your clothes to wear as a decoration; a short thin piece of metal with a sharp point at one end, used especially for fastening together pieces of cloth while making clothes; needle, plug; nail up, transfix
words.translation: 针，饰针；别住；大头针，针；栓；琐碎物；钉住；压住；将……用针别住

examples.en: ...necklaces, bracelets, and pins.
examples.zh: …项链、手镯和胸针。

words.definition: a tall tree with long hard sharp leaves that do not fall off in winter; rare, aspire; ananas; regret, grieve over
words.translation: 松树，松木；渴望，痛苦；憔悴；[林]松树；凤梨，菠萝；为…悲哀；哀悼

examples.en: an ancient pine forest
examples.zh: 一片古老的松树林

words.definition: a large yellow-brown tropical fruit or its sweet juicy yellow flesh; ananas, unemployment benefit
words.translation: 凤梨，波萝；[园艺]菠萝；凤梨；失业救济金

examples.en: pineapple chunks
examples.zh: 菠萝块

examples.en: pineapple juice
examples.zh: 菠萝汁

words.definition: a pale red colour; pale red; picture, ideal; stick, string
words.translation: 粉红色；粉红色的；化身，典范；石竹花；头面人物；扎，刺，戳；使…变粉红色；使…面红耳赤

examples.en: Her room was decorated in bright pinks and purples.
examples.zh: 她的房间装饰成明亮的粉红色和紫色。

examples.en: She had arrived dressed in pink.
examples.zh: 她穿着粉色的衣服来了。

words.definition: a unit for measuring an amount of liquid, especially beer or milk. In Britain a pint is equal to 0.568 litres, and in the US it is equal to 0.473 litres.
words.translation: 品脱

examples.en: He’s gone down the pub for a quick pint.
examples.zh: 他去小酒馆匆匆喝上一品脱啤酒。

words.definition: to be the first person to do, invent or use something; vanguard, avant-courier; advocate, inaugurate
words.translation: 开拓，开发；先锋；拓荒者；开辟；倡导；提倡

examples.en: The new cancer treatment was pioneered in the early eighties by Dr Sylvia Bannerjee.
examples.zh: 这种新的癌症治疗方法是由西尔维娅·班纳基医生在80年代初期开创的。

words.definition: a tube through which a liquid or gas flows; tube, cigarette holder; scream
words.translation: 管子，导管；烟斗；[建]管；[轻]烟斗；笛；吹笛；尖叫

examples.en: a water pipe
examples.zh: 水管

examples.en: a frozen waste pipe
examples.zh: 冻住的污水管

examples.en: copper pipes
examples.zh: 铜管

words.definition: used to show that you are disappointed about something and you wish things could happen differently; to feel sorry for someone because they are in a very bad situation; regret, feeling, compassion, mercy, sympathy
words.translation: 怜悯；遗憾；同情；怜悯，同情

examples.en: It’s a great pity Joyce wasn’t invited.
examples.zh: 乔伊斯没有受到邀请太遗憾了。

examples.en: I like Charlie. Pity he had to marry that awful woman.
examples.zh: 我喜欢查利，遗憾的是他得和那个糟糕的女人结婚。

examples.en: A pity we can’t find the guy who did it.
examples.zh: 真遗憾我们找不到那个干了这件事的家伙。

words.definition: a space or area, for example a particular point on a surface or in a room, building, town, city etc; district, seat; install, constitute, park, name; come to the top
words.translation: 地方，地点；住所；地方；座位；放置；任命；寄予；名列前茅；取得名次

examples.en: Make sure you keep the key in a safe place.
examples.zh: 一定要把钥匙放在安全的地方。

examples.en: I’ve spent the day dashing about from place to place.
examples.zh: 我这一天尽是在东奔西跑。

examples.en: The place was full of screaming children.
examples.zh: 那地方全是大叫大嚷的孩子们。

words.definition: a large area of flat dry land; very clear, and easy to understand or recognize; simple, defined, plane; flatland, puszta; definitely, fair, expressly
words.translation: 平原；清楚的；平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的；[地理]平原；无格式；朴实无华的东西；清楚地；平易地

examples.en: The grassy plain gave way to an extensive swamp.
examples.zh: 青草覆盖的平原被广阔的沼泽地所取代。

examples.en: the vast plains of central China
examples.zh: 华中地区的广阔平原

words.definition: something you have decided to do; scheme, programme, project; design, schedule, propose, map, project; project, aim, propose
