words.definition: a group of numbers and letters that you write at the end of an address on an envelope, package etc. The postcode shows the exact area where someone lives and helps the post office deliver the post more quickly.; zip code, postal code
words.translation: 邮政编码；（英）邮政编码；邮区号

examples.en: Type your street address and postcode.
examples.zh: 键入你的街道地址和邮政编码。

words.definition: a large printed notice, picture, or photograph, used to advertise something or as a decoration; advertisement, bill, publicity
words.translation: 海报，广告；招贴；[印刷]招贴

examples.en: A team of volunteers were putting up posters .
examples.zh: 一队志愿者正在张贴海报。

examples.en: a poster campaign for the election
examples.zh: 选举的海报宣传

words.definition: someone whose job is to collect and deliver letters; letter carrier, mailman
words.translation: 邮递员；邮差

examples.en: That postman is in charge of this route.
examples.zh: 那个邮递员负责这条投递线路。

examples.en: The old man often stands here to watch out for the postman.
examples.zh: 老人常常站在这儿等邮递员。

words.definition: to change the date or time of a planned event or action to a later one; adjourn; stave off, time delay
words.translation: 延迟，推迟，延缓；使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面；延缓，延迟；延缓发作

examples.en: The match had to be postponed until next week.
examples.zh: 比赛不得不推迟到下周举行。

examples.en: His trial has been postponed indefinitely (= no one knows when it will happen ) .
examples.zh: 对他的审判被无限期推迟了。

words.definition: a container used for cooking which is round, deep, and usually made of metal; basin, kettle; flight, take a shot at
words.translation: 锅，壶，罐，盆；[轻]壶；盆；罐；把…装罐；射击；节略

examples.en: herbs growing in pots
examples.zh: 长在花盆里的草本植物

words.definition: a round white vegetable with a brown, red, or pale yellow skin, that grows under the ground; murphy, tater
words.translation: 马铃薯，土豆；土豆，[作物]马铃薯

examples.en: Marie stood at the sink, peeling potatoes (= cutting off the skin ) .
examples.zh: 玛丽站在洗涤槽边削土豆皮。

words.definition: the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect; likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future; possibility, probability, feasibility, maybe, chance; feasible, possible, underlying, latent
words.translation: 潜力；有可能的；潜在的；潜能；可能性；[电]电势；可能的；势的

examples.en: The boy has great potential.
examples.zh: 这个男孩有很大的潜力。

words.definition: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 16  ounce s  or 0.454 kilograms; prison, devel; hold, prison; drive, belt
words.translation: 磅；英磅；英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所；捣烂；敲打；监禁，拘留；连续重击，猛击

examples.en: Moira weighs about 130 pounds .
examples.zh: 莫伊拉的体重约为130磅。

examples.en: The grapes cost $2 a pound .
examples.zh: 葡萄的价格是2美元一磅。

words.definition: to make a liquid or other substance flow out of or into a container by holding it at an angle; if a lot of liquid or smoke pours out, it comes out from somewhere in very large amounts; issue, flux, dumping; shed; flow
words.translation: 灌，倒；倾泻；流出；骤雨；灌，注；倒；倾吐；涌流；斟茶

examples.en: She poured coffee for everyone.
examples.zh: 她为每个人都倒了咖啡。

words.definition: a dry substance in the form of very small grains; dust, dirt; pulverize
words.translation: 粉末；药粉；火药；[材]粉；[化工][军]火药；尘土；使成粉末；撒粉；搽粉于

examples.en: curry powder
examples.zh: 咖喱粉

examples.en: talcum powder
examples.zh: 滑石[爽身]粉

examples.en: Grind the sugar into a powder .
examples.zh: 把糖碾成粉末。

words.definition: the ability or right to control people or events; strength, ability, competence, regime, force; stimulate, bestir; make good time
words.translation: 能力；力；权；幂；[物]功率；力量；政权；势力；[数]幂；激励；供以动力；使…有力量；快速前进

examples.en: They seized power in a military coup.
examples.zh: 他们在一场军事政变中夺取了政权。

words.definition: a powerful person, organization, group etc is able to control and influence events and other people’s actions; formidable, cogent; greatly, quite, badly, extremely, too, highly, far
words.translation: 强有力的；有权威的；强大的；很；非常

examples.en: He was one of the most powerful men in Bohemia.
examples.zh: 他是波希米亚最有权势的人物之一。

examples.en: a very influential and powerful family
examples.zh: 很有权势的家庭

examples.en: rich and powerful nations
examples.zh: 富强的国家

words.definition: relating to real situations and events rather than ideas, emotions etc; actual, effective, real, pragmatic, positive
words.translation: 实践的；实用的；实际的；实用性的

examples.en: Candidates should have training and practical experience in basic electronics.
examples.zh: 应征者应该具备基础电子学方面的培训和实践经验。

examples.en: the practical problems of old age
examples.zh: 老年的实际问题

examples.en: They provide financial and practical help for disabled students.
examples.zh: 他们为残障学生提供经济上的援助以及实际的帮助。

words.definition: when you do a particular thing, often regularly, in order to improve your skill at it; tradition, convention, usage, exercise; exercise, bring to pass; execute, exercise
words.translation: 实践；练习；业务；惯例；[劳经]实习；实行

examples.en: It takes hours of practice to learn to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 学习弹吉他需要长时间的练习。

examples.en: With a little more practice you should be able to pass your test.
examples.zh: 稍微再练一练，你应该能通过考试了。

examples.en: We have choir practice on Tuesday evening.
examples.zh: 星期二晚上我们要练习合唱。

words.definition: a wide open area of fairly flat land in North America which is covered in grass or wheat; field, steppe
words.translation: 大草原，牧场；[畜牧]大草原；牧场

examples.en: Andrew traversed the prairie on horseback.
examples.zh: 安德鲁骑马穿越大草原。

words.definition: to say that you admire and approve of someone or something, especially publicly; worship, favoring and praising; celebrate, bless, admire; speak highly of, talk up
words.translation: 赞扬，赞美；赞扬；称赞；荣耀；崇拜；赞美，歌颂；表扬；赞美

examples.en: Jane was praised by her teacher.
examples.zh: 简受到了老师的表扬。

examples.en: a highly praised novel
examples.zh: 受到高度赞扬的小说

words.definition: to speak to God in order to ask for help or give thanks; beseech, obsecrate; cry on, appeal to sb for sth
words.translation: 请求；祈祷；恳求；央求；请

examples.en: They went to the mosque to pray.
examples.zh: 他们去清真寺祷告。

words.definition: words that you say when praying to God or gods; suit, blessing
words.translation: 祷告， 祈祷；祷文；祈求， 祈望；祈祷，祷告；恳求；祈祷文

examples.en: Our thoughts and prayers are with you at this difficult time.
examples.zh: 在这艰难时期我们时刻思念你，为你祈祷。

examples.en: The children said their prayers and got into bed.
examples.zh: 孩子们做完祷告后上床睡觉了。

examples.en: God has answered your prayer .
examples.zh: 上帝应许了你的祷告。

words.definition: something that is precious is valuable and important and should not be wasted or used without care; golden, valued
words.translation: 珍贵的，宝贵的；宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的

examples.en: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
examples.zh: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

examples.en: our planet’s precious resources
examples.zh: 我们星球上的宝贵资源

words.definition: precise information, details etc are exact, clear, and correct; accurate, strict, mathematical, rigid, decided
words.translation: 精确的，准确的；精确的；明确的；严格的

examples.en: precise sales figures
examples.zh: 准确的销售数据

examples.en: It was difficult to get precise information.
examples.zh: 很难得到确切的消息。

examples.en: ‘She’s a lot older than you, isn’t she?’ ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .’
examples.zh: “她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

words.definition: to say that something will happen, before it happens; forecast, advance information
words.translation: 预言，预测，预告；预报，预言；预知

examples.en: Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
examples.zh: 销售额比预期低5%。

examples.en: As Liz had predicted , the rumours were soon forgotten.
examples.zh: 正如利兹所预料的，流言很快就被淡忘了。

words.definition: introduce, promote, present, upgrade, file; affect, take a fancy to
words.translation: 宁可，宁愿；更喜欢；宁愿；提出；提升；喜欢；愿意

words.definition: if you have a preference for something, you like it more than another thing and will choose it if you can; tendency, liability, priority, trend, favour
words.translation: 偏爱；偏爱，倾向；[经][计]优先权

examples.en: Do you have a colour preference ?
examples.zh: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

examples.en: Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
examples.zh: 家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。

examples.en: The amount of sugar you add will depend on personal preference .
examples.zh: 加多少糖取决于个人的喜好。

words.definition: if a woman or female animal is pregnant, she has an unborn baby growing inside her body; cyetic, childing
words.translation: 怀孕的；富有意义的

examples.en: care for pregnant women
examples.zh: 孕妇保健

examples.en: I knew right away that I was pregnant.
examples.zh: 我立即明白我怀孕了。

examples.en: I thought I was too old to get pregnant .
examples.zh: 我觉得自己年龄太大，已经不能怀孕了。

words.definition: an un-reasonable dislike and distrust of people who are different from you in some way, especially because of their race, sex, religion etc – used to show disapproval; violation, bias; hurt, blast
words.translation: 偏见；侵害；损害；使有偏见

examples.en: Women still face prejudice in the workplace.
examples.zh: 女性在职场中仍然面临歧视。

examples.en: It takes a long time to overcome these kinds of prejudices.
examples.zh: 战胜这些偏见需要假以时日。

words.definition: Premier is used to describe something that is considered to be the best or most important thing of a particular type; a  prime minister  – used in news reports; initial, first, original; chancellor, Taoiseach
words.translation: 首要的， 首位的， 首次的；总理，首相；第一的；最初的

examples.en: ...the country's premier opera company.
examples.zh: …这个国家最好的歌剧团。

words.definition: the process of preparing something or preparing for something; arrangement, preliminary, provision
words.translation: 准备，预备；制备；预备；准备

examples.en: This dish is good for dinner parties because much of the preparation can be done ahead of time.
examples.zh: 这道菜适合宴会，因为很多准备工作可以事先做好。

examples.en: Plans for the new school are now in preparation .
examples.zh: 新学校的设计图正在绘制中。

examples.en: a course in food service and food preparation
examples.zh: 餐饮服务和备菜课程

words.definition: to make plans or arrangements for something that will happen in the future; provide, make, fix
words.translation: 做准备；准备；使适合；装备；起草

examples.en: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.
examples.zh: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

words.definition: a piece of paper on which a doctor writes what medicine a sick person should have, so that they can get it from a  pharmacist; tradition, instruction, convention, usage, pointing
words.translation: 处方；[医]药方；指示；惯例

examples.en: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs .
examples.zh: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

examples.en: a repeat prescription
examples.zh: 重复处方

words.definition: in a particular place; at this time; prefer, file, advance, recommend, assume; current, now; gift, giving, aiming, training, tribute
words.translation: 现在的；目前；提出；介绍；呈现；赠送；出席的；现在；礼物；瞄准

examples.en: the present situation of the millions of people who are suffering poverty and disease
examples.zh: 遭受贫困和疾病折磨的数百万人民的现状

words.definition: the act of giving someone a prize or present at a formal ceremony; description, statement, representation, characterization
words.translation: 提供， 显示；外观， 图像；授予， 赠送；报告， 介绍；表演；描述，陈述；介绍；赠送

examples.en: the presentation ceremony
examples.zh: 颁奖仪式

examples.en: Dr Evans thanked him for coming to make the presentations .
examples.zh: 埃文斯博士感谢他来颁奖。

words.definition: to save something or someone from being harmed or destroyed; maintain, save, secure, corn, sustain; conservation area, conservation district
words.translation: 保护；保存；维持；腌；禁猎；保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品

examples.en: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
examples.zh: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

words.definition: the official leader of a country that does not have a king or queen; principal, prez
words.translation: 总统；校长；会长；董事长

examples.en: President Bush
examples.zh: 布什总统

words.definition: to push something firmly against a surface; push, hug; clic, news bulletin
words.translation: 压，按，揿；催促；压；按；逼迫；紧抱；新闻；出版社；[印刷]印刷机

examples.en: Manville kept his back pressed flat against the wall.
examples.zh: 曼维尔后背紧紧地贴在墙上。

examples.en: She pressed the gas pedal and the car leapt forwards.
examples.zh: 她踩下油门，汽车向前冲了出去。

examples.en: He pressed a card into her hand before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开之前他往她手里塞了一张卡片。

words.definition: an attempt to persuade someone by using influence, arguments, or threats; heat, compression force; reduce to, compel
words.translation: 压力；压，按；[力]压力；压迫，[物]压强；迫使；密封；使……增压

examples.en: They are putting pressure on people to vote yes.
examples.zh: 他们正在向民众施加压力，要求他们投赞成票。

examples.en: You must never give in to pressure .
examples.zh: 你绝不能屈从压力。

words.definition: to behave as if something is true when in fact you know it is not, in order to deceive people or for fun; simulate, come; act, fox; affected, assumed, simulate
words.translation: 假托，借口vi假装；假装；假扮；伪称；假装的

examples.en: Let’s pretend we’re on the moon.
examples.zh: 我们假装自己是在月球上吧。

examples.en: He’s not asleep – he’s just pretending.
examples.zh: 他并没睡着，不过是装睡而已。

examples.en: To pretend ignorance of the situation would be irresponsible.
examples.zh: 装作不知情是不负责任的做法。

words.definition: a woman or child who is pretty has a nice attractive face; lovely, taking, smart, cute, tony; relatively, fairly, comparatively, reasonably, considerably
words.translation: 漂亮的，标致的；漂亮的；可爱的；优美的；相当地；颇

examples.en: a pretty little girl
examples.zh: 漂亮的小姑娘

examples.en: Maria looks much prettier with her hair cut short.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚把头发剪短好看多了。

words.definition: to stop something from happening, or stop someone from doing something; dispute, stem, block; stem, hinder from
words.translation: 预防；预防，防止；阻止；妨碍，阻止

examples.en: The rules are intended to prevent accidents.
examples.zh: 这些规定旨在预防事故。

examples.en: We were prevented from entering the site.
examples.zh: 我们被阻止进入现场。

examples.en: Wrap small ornaments in paper to prevent them being damaged.
examples.zh: 把小饰品用纸包上以免损坏。

words.definition: an occasion when you can see a film, play, painting etc before it is shown to the public; rehearse
words.translation: 预映， 预演；预告；预览；预演；事先查看

examples.en: the press preview of the show (= when people who write for newspapers, television etc could see it )
examples.zh: 该节目的媒体试映

words.definition: the amount of money you have to pay for something; importance, value, expense, rate, figure
words.translation: 价格，价钱；代价；[物价]价格；价值；[贸易]代价

examples.en: They may pay a high price for their few years of glory.
examples.zh: 为了短短几年的辉煌，他们也许要付出高昂的代价。

words.definition: a feeling that you are proud of something that you or someone connected with you has achieved; to be especially proud of something that you do well, or of a good quality that you have; selfrespect, pretension; exalt; glory, be proud of
words.translation: 骄傲；自豪；自夸；自尊心；使得意，以…自豪

examples.en: He wore his medals with pride.
examples.zh: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

examples.en: The people have a sense of pride in their community.
examples.zh: 人们对自己的社区有一种自豪感。

examples.en: His heart swelled with pride when his daughter came in.
examples.zh: 女儿进来时他的内心充满了自豪感。

words.definition: most important; elementary, major, central, main, leading; original color, fundamental colour
words.translation: 主要的，基本的；主要的；[数]初级的；基本的；原色；最主要者

examples.en: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
examples.zh: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

examples.en: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
examples.zh: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

examples.en: Personal safety is of primary importance .
examples.zh: 人身安全至关重要。

words.definition: belonging to a simple way of life that existed in the past and does not have modern industries and machines; original, simple, crude, plain, rough; Euroman
words.translation: 原始的；简单的；[数][生物][地质]原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的；[数][生物][地质]原始人

examples.en: a primitive society
examples.zh: 原始社会

examples.en: a primitive nomadic tribe
examples.zh: 原始的游牧部落

examples.en: the tools used by primitive man
examples.zh: 原始人所用的工具

words.definition: a moral rule or belief about what is right and wrong, that influences how you behave; theory, mechanism, element, essence, parent
words.translation: 原则，原理；原理，原则；主义，道义；本质，本义；根源，源泉

examples.en: Schools try to teach children a set of principles.
examples.zh: 学校设法教给孩子们一套道德准则。

examples.en: He’s got no principles at all!
examples.zh: 他毫无道德准则！

examples.en: It’s against my principles to accept gifts from clients.
examples.zh: 收受客户礼物违背我的原则。

words.definition: to produce many printed copies of a book, newspaper etc; writing that has been printed, for example in books or newspapers; impression, seal; strike off; bring out, get out
words.translation: 印刷；正片；[印刷]印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记；[印刷]印刷；[计]打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样；出版

examples.en: Over five million copies of the paper are printed every day.
examples.zh: 这份报纸每日印量超过五百万。

examples.en: When the book was first written no publisher would print it.
examples.zh: 这本书刚写成时没有出版商愿意出版。

words.definition: someone who is employed in the trade of printing; machineman, typothetae
words.translation: 印刷工；印花工；[印刷][摄][计]打印机
印刷；印刷术

words.definition: a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime, or while they are waiting to go to court for their  trial; jail, big house; imprison, jail
words.translation: 监狱，监禁；[法]监狱；监禁；拘留所；监禁，关押

examples.en: He visits his dad in prison every week.
examples.zh: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

examples.en: Ricky has been out of prison for three years now.
examples.zh: 里基现已出狱三年。

examples.en: They’ll probably put him in prison for a long time.
examples.zh: 他们很可能会让他在监狱里待很长时间。

words.definition: someone who is kept in a prison as a legal punishment for a crime or while they are waiting for their  trial; capture, galley slave
words.translation: 囚犯；囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告

examples.en: Relationships between the staff and the prisoners are good.
examples.zh: 狱警和犯人相处良好。

examples.en: Prisoners here only serve short sentences.
examples.zh: 这里的犯人只是短期服刑。

examples.en: The organization is arguing for the release of political prisoners (= people in prison because of their political opinions ) .
examples.zh: 该组织正在争取释放政治犯。

words.definition: for use by one person or group, not for everyone; chamber, cabinet; seaman second class
words.translation: 私人的；私有的；私下的；列兵；二等兵

examples.en: Morris has a private jet.
examples.zh: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

examples.en: He made some notes for his private use.
examples.zh: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

examples.en: They objected to any form of private property .
examples.zh: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

words.definition: a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people; franchise, peculiar
words.translation: 特权，优惠；[计]特权；优待；基本权利

examples.en: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
examples.zh: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

words.definition: something that is given to someone who is successful in a competition, race, game of chance etc; to think that someone or something is very important or valuable; award, capture; assess, acquire, evaluate, value, rate
words.translation: 奖赏，奖金；珍视；[劳经]奖品；奖赏；战利品；捕获；估价

examples.en: In this month’s competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
examples.zh: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

examples.en: The first prize has gone to Dr John Gentle.
examples.zh: 获得一等奖的是约翰·金特尔博士。

examples.en: The prizes are awarded (= given ) every year to students who have shown original thinking in their work.
examples.zh: 这些奖项每年颁发给在学习中表现出创造性思维的学生。

words.definition: likely to exist, happen, or be true; likely, trusted, authentic
words.translation: 或有的；大概的；很可能的；可信的

examples.en: The probable cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
examples.zh: 起火的原因很可能是电路故障。

examples.en: Success is highly probable .
examples.zh: 成功的希望相当大。

words.definition: a situation that causes difficulties; conundrum, puzzler; debatable, stubborn
words.translation: 问题；习题，问题；难题；引起麻烦的人；成问题的；难处理的

examples.en: She was older than me, but that wasn’t really a problem.
examples.zh: 她比我年长，不过那不算什么问题。

words.definition: a way of doing something, especially the correct or usual way; routine, program, move, step
words.translation: 程序；程序，[管理]手续；步骤

examples.en: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
examples.zh: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

words.definition: a series of actions that are done in order to achieve a particular result; to deal with an official document, request etc in the usual way; manufacture, cope with; going on, course, system, method, approach
words.translation: 过程，进程；工序；(法律)程序；处理；加工；过程，进行；方法，步骤；作用；程序；推移

examples.en: the Israeli-Egyptian peace process
examples.zh: 以－埃和平进程

examples.en: Repetition can help the learning process.
examples.zh: 重复对学习过程会有帮助。

words.definition: to cause a particular result or effect; attract, cause, operate, occasion, induce; manufacture, work, agricultural products; turn out, bring in
words.translation: 生产；产生；展现；引起；创作；农产品，产品；生产，创作

examples.en: New drugs are producing remarkable results .
examples.zh: 新药正在产生显著的效果。

examples.en: a rise in sea level produced by climatic change
examples.zh: 由气候变化引起的海平面升高

examples.en: As a policy, it did not produce the desired effect .
examples.zh: 作为一项政策，它并未产生预期的效果。

words.definition: something that is grown or made in a factory in large quantities, usually in order to be sold; outcome, event, result, manufacture, writing
words.translation: 产品，产物；(乘)积；[经]产品；结果；[数]乘积；作品

examples.en: The London factory assembles the finished product .
examples.zh: 伦敦工厂组装成品。

examples.en: He works in marketing and product development.
examples.zh: 他从事营销和产品开发。

words.definition: the process of making or growing things to be sold, especially in large quantities; feedback, outcome, writing, manufacture, work
words.translation: 生产；产品；总产量；成果；[经]生产；作品

examples.en: That model won't go into production before late 2007.
examples.zh: 那种型号要到2007年底才会投入生产。

words.definition: a job that needs a high level of education and training; employment, career, calling, pursuit, statement, occupation
words.translation: 职业；职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白

examples.en: people who work in the professions
examples.zh: 从事专业性工作的人

examples.en: nurses, social workers, and other people in the caring professions
examples.zh: 护士、社工和其他从事护理行业的人

words.definition: money that you gain by selling things or doing business, after your costs have been paid; to be useful or helpful to someone; behalf, margin, benefit, gain, sake; advantage, gain; benefit, be good for
words.translation: 益处；利润；得益；[会计]利润；利益；获利；有益；有益于

examples.en: The shop’s daily profit is usually around $500.
examples.zh: 这家商店每天的利润一般在500美元左右。

examples.en: She sold the business and bought a farm with the profits.
examples.zh: 她卖了公司，用所得利润买下了一座农场。

examples.en: They sold their house at a healthy profit .
examples.zh: 他们卖掉房子，赚了一大笔钱。

words.definition: a series of actions which are designed to achieve something important; plan, scheme, procedure, routine, formulation; formulate, mark out
words.translation: 计划，规划；节目；程序；编程序；制作节目；[计]程序；规划；拟…计划

examples.en: the US space program
examples.zh: 美国太空计划

words.definition: the process of getting better at doing something, or getting closer to finishing or achieving something; development, growth, making, advancement; wage, do, go ahead
words.translation: 前进，进展；进步；进步，发展；前进；前进，进步；进行

examples.en: We made good progress despite the snow.
examples.zh: 尽管下雪，我们的行程还是很顺利。

words.definition: to say that an action is illegal or not allowed; stem, block, dispute, bar, discourage
words.translation: 禁止，阻止，防止；阻止，禁止

examples.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the factory.
examples.zh: 厂区严禁吸烟。

words.definition: a carefully planned piece of work to get information about something, to build something, to improve something etc; design, engineer; design, schedule, engineer, style, frame; engineering, career, enterprise, plan, scheme
words.translation: 工程，作业；设计；计划；表达；投射；发射；放映；工程；事业

examples.en: The project aims to provide an analysis of children’s emotions.
examples.zh: 该计划旨在对儿童情绪作出分析。

examples.en: a three-year research project
examples.zh: 一项为期三年的研究计划

examples.en: The scheme will now be extended after a successful pilot project (= a small trial to test if an idea will be successful ) .
examples.zh: 试行成功后，该方案现在将得到推广。

words.definition: a statement that you will definitely do or provide something or that something will definitely happen; to tell someone that you will definitely do or provide something or that something will happen; wish, hope, pleasure; pledge, vouchsafe

examples.en: If you make a promise, you should keep it.
examples.zh: 如果你许下一个诺言，你就应该遵守它。

words.definition: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread; facilitate, boost, prefer, upgrade, further
words.translation: 促进，提升，推销；促进；提升；推销；发扬

examples.en: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
examples.zh: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

words.definition: to make the sound of a letter, word etc, especially in the correct way; declare, pass sentence; articulate
words.translation: 发…的音；宣布；发音；宣判；断言；作出判断

examples.en: How do you pronounce your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字怎么念？

words.definition: the way in which a language or a particular word is pronounced; sonation, vocalization
words.translation: 发音，发音法；发音；读法

examples.en: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
examples.zh: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。

words.definition: right, suitable, or correct; suitable, appropriate, adequate, typical, becoming; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully
words.translation: 适合的；合乎体统的；适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的；完全地

examples.zh: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

examples.en: the proper way to clean your teeth
examples.zh: 正确的刷牙方法

examples.en: The proper name for Matthew’s condition is hyperkinetic syndrome.
examples.zh: 马修的病的恰当名称是多动症。

words.definition: correctly, or in a way that is considered right; correctly, exactly, well, appropriately, adequately
words.translation: 适当地；正确地；恰当地

examples.en: The brakes don’t seem to be working properly.
examples.zh: 刹车似乎不正常。

examples.en: Then he’s not doing his job properly.
examples.zh: 那么他没把分内事做好。

examples.en: Parents should teach their children to behave properly in public.
examples.zh: 家长应该教导子女在公共场合要有规有矩。

words.definition: to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or illness; secure, watch, preserve
words.translation: 保护，保卫，警戒；保护，防卫；警戒

examples.en: Are we doing enough to protect the environment?
examples.zh: 我们在保护环境方面做得够吗？

words.definition: when someone or something is protected; lee, safeguard, conservation, defence, pass
words.translation: 保护，警戒；保护；防卫；护照

examples.en: protection money
examples.zh: 保护费

words.definition: feeling pleased about something that you have done or something that you own, or about someone or something you are involved with or related to; beamish, complacent
words.translation: 骄傲的；自豪的；得意的；自负的

examples.en: Seth was the proud owner of a new sports car.
examples.zh: 赛思因为有了新跑车而扬扬得意。

words.definition: to show that something is true by providing facts, information etc; demonstrate, reveal, make clear, argue
words.translation: 证明；结果是；检验；显示

examples.en: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
examples.zh: 你错了，我可以证明。

examples.en: To prove his point (= show that he was right ) , he mentioned several other experiments which had produced similar results.
examples.zh: 为了证明自己的观点，他提到了另外几个结果相似的实验。

words.definition: to give something to someone or make it available to them, because they need it or want it; afford, define, regulate, tender, state; take care of, prime
words.translation: 提供；装备，供给；规定；准备；装备；抚养；作准备

examples.en: Tea and biscuits will be provided.
examples.zh: 有茶水和饼干供应。

words.definition: one of the large areas into which some countries are divided, and which usually has its own local government; domain, territory, world, universe, kingdom
words.translation: 省；领域，部门；领域；职权

examples.en: a Chinese province
examples.zh: 中国的一个省

words.definition: a building in Britain where alcohol can be bought and drunk, and where meals are often served; hotel, tavern
words.translation: 酒馆；客栈

examples.en: Do you fancy going to the pub?
examples.zh: 你想去酒吧吗？

examples.en: a pub lunch
examples.zh: 酒吧午餐

examples.en: the pub landlord
examples.zh: 酒吧老板

words.definition: relating to all the ordinary people in a country, who are not members of the government or do not have important jobs; ordinary people who do not work for the government or have any special position in society; governmental, commonable; society, ambiente
words.translation: 公众的；公众；政府的；公用的；公立的；社会；公共场所

examples.zh: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

examples.zh: 公众对信息的充分知情权

examples.en: Public opinion is gradually shifting in favor of the imprisoned men.
examples.zh: 舆论渐渐倾向于同情入狱的男子。

words.translation: 公然地, 舆论上；公然地；以公众名义

examples.en: publicly elected bodies
examples.zh: 由公众选举产生的机构

words.definition: to arrange for a book, magazine etc to be written, printed, and sold; deliver, post; print, bring out
words.translation: 公布；发表；出版；发行；刊印

examples.zh: 第一版于1765年出版。

examples.en: They are publishing the dictionary on CD-ROM.
examples.zh: 那部词典他们将以光盘版的形式推出。

words.definition: to use your hands to make something or someone move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving; draw, snake; draw; tension, digging rope

examples.zh: 妈妈! 戴维拽我的头发！

examples.zh: 他呼吸很浅，脉搏微弱。

examples.zh: 她摸了摸他的颈部，没有脉搏。

examples.en: Her pulse raced (= beat very quickly ) with excitement.
examples.zh: 她激动得脉搏急速跳动。

words.translation: 泵；用抽机抽；打气；用抽水机抽…；[机]泵，抽水机；打气筒

examples.zh: …使燃料在发动机内循环的压泵。

examples.zh: 仅用水泵将未经处理的污水排入海中是不够的。

examples.zh: 筹到的钱款将用来挖井眼，再将水抽入干涸的湖中。

words.translation: 准时的；准时的，守时的；精确的

examples.zh: 她一向准时赴约。

examples.en: the punctual payment of invoices
examples.zh: 准时结清费用清单

words.translation: 不时打断；强调；加标点于
标点；标点符号

examples.zh: 要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。

examples.zh: 他承诺要严惩任何在选举中有欺诈行为的官员。

examples.zh: 他们置乘客于危险之中，理应受到惩罚。

words.definition: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or of being punished; rod, payment, discipline, abuse
words.translation: 惩罚, 处罚；[动]惩罚；严厉对待，虐待

examples.zh: …一个发起运动反对体罚儿童的组织。

words.translation: 学生，小学生；学生；[解剖]瞳孔；未成年人

examples.zh: 大约20名小学生在这里学习音乐。

examples.en: staff and pupils
examples.zh: 教职员工和学生

examples.en: a star pupil
examples.zh: 一名优秀的小学生

examples.zh: 她付钱买好东西离开了。

examples.zh: 我附上小票作为购物凭证。

examples.zh: 她从我的货摊上买了两样东西。

words.translation: 纯粹的；纯洁的；纯的；清白的；纯理论的

examples.en: rings made of pure gold
examples.zh: 纯金制成的戒指

examples.en: Our beef patties are 100% pure .
examples.zh: 我们的牛肉饼是100%的纯牛肉。

words.definition: a dark colour that is a mixture of red and blue; having a dark colour that is a mixture of red and blue; regal, violet; lila, amethyst; empurple
words.translation: 紫色；紫的；紫色的；帝王的；华而不实的；紫袍；使成紫色

examples.zh: 红色染上蓝色便可成为紫色。

examples.en: She had a purple dress on with a silver-white necklace.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条紫色的连衣裙配着一条银白色的项链。

words.definition: the purpose of something is what it is intended to achieve; goals, intention, sake, objective, use; propose, think
words.translation: 目的；意图；效果；用途；意志；决心；企图；打算

examples.zh: 尼克开始的时候头脑中并没有明确的目标。

examples.zh: 我锁上门，然后把钥匙丢进手提包里。

words.translation: 推，逼迫；推；推动；增加；推行；逼迫；推进；伸展；努力争取；决心；奋力；攻击；干劲；进取心

examples.zh: 它一动不动，因此她加力去推。

examples.en: I promised to push him on the swings for as long as he wanted.
examples.zh: 我答应他想在秋千上荡多久我就推多久。

examples.en: shoppers pushing their grocery carts
examples.zh: 推着购物车的购物者

words.definition: to move something to a particular place or position, especially using your hands; set, establish, voice, gift, station; leave, set out; simple, turkey

examples.zh: 他把咖啡放在桌上。

examples.zh: 你把节目单放在哪里了？

words.translation: 迷惑；使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出；冥思苦想；谜；难题

examples.zh: 我的妹妹常会让我不解，使我焦虑。

words.translation: 困惑的；茫然的；搞糊涂的

words.definition: a large stone building with four  triangular (= three-sided )  walls that slope in to a point at the top, especially in Egypt and Central America; advance, to go up
words.translation: 金字塔；渐增；上涨；[建]成金字塔状

examples.zh: 金字塔式管理体系中的不同层次

words.definition: if you have a qualification, you have passed an examination or course to show you have a particular level of skill or knowledge in a subject; membership, limitation, capacity, condition, restriction
words.translation: 资格(证明)，合格证书；资格；条件；限制；赋予资格

examples.en: He left school without any qualifications.
examples.zh: 他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。

words.translation: 品质；质量，[统计]品质；特性；才能

examples.zh: 很多地的土质很差。

examples.zh: 只使用上等的材料。

words.translation: 量，数量；大量；总量

examples.zh: 这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

words.translation: 争吵，吵架，口角；吵架；争论；挑剔；反目；怨言；争吵的原因；方头凿

examples.zh: 我和其他几个兄弟大吵了一架。

words.definition: one of four equal parts into which something can be divided; region, area, direction, orientation, aspect; room, stop at
words.translation: 四分之一；一刻钟；季度；[数]四分之一；地区；方向；两角五分；驻扎；住宿

examples.zh: 大概是一又四分之一页。

examples.zh: 把蛋糕切成四等份。

words.translation: 王后；女王；女王，王后；（纸牌中的）皇后；（蜜蜂等的）蜂王

examples.zh: 方块Q，方块王后

examples.zh: 我能问你个问题吗？

examples.zh: 我恐怕无法回答那个问题。

words.translation: 调查表，征求意见表

examples.zh: 雨季

examples.zh: 这所大学正在努力增加公立学校学生的入学人数。

examples.zh: 父母离婚的时候，她非常难过。

examples.zh: 她拿起信读了起来。

examples.zh: 开始前要仔细阅读说明。

examples.zh: 快点，你还没准备好吗？

examples.zh: 这种疾病确实有蔓延的危险。

examples.zh: 我们需要解决失业和贫穷这两个实际问题。

examples.zh: 没有什么真正的理由需要担心。

examples.zh: 幻想和现实之间的区别

examples.zh: 电视成了逃避现实的一种方式。

examples.zh: 我们过了一段时间才意识到这场悲剧有多严重。

examples.zh: 我到后来才认识到自己的错误。

examples.zh: 要讲道理，你不能指望她一个人干所有的工作！

words.translation: 收到；得到；接待；接纳；接收

examples.zh: 每个孩子都会收到一份小礼物。

examples.zh: 李得到324票。

examples.zh: 欧文最新的书

examples.zh: 近来对致癌原因的研究

examples.zh: 发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。

words.translation: 接待员；传达员

examples.en: You tell the receptionist that you are expecting a call from this client and to put them through.
examples.zh: 你告诉传达员你正在等待一个来自这个客户的电话，并允许将他们接进来。

words.definition: a set of instructions for cooking a particular type of food; secret, tips
words.translation: 秘方，食谱；食谱；[临床]处方；秘诀

examples.en: a recipe book
examples.zh: 一本烹饪书

words.definition: to say a poem, piece of literature etc that you have learned, for people to listen to; repeat, specify, relate; say over, learn sth by memory
words.translation: 背诵， 朗诵；列举， 一一说出；背诵；叙述；列举

examples.en: She recited a poem that she had learnt at school.
examples.zh: 她背诵了一首学校里学的诗。

words.definition: accept, agree, allow, identify, acknowledge
words.translation: 认出， 识别；承认；承认，认可；识别

words.definition: to advise someone to do something, especially because you have special knowledge of a situation or subject; present, put in a good word; put in a good word, advise
words.translation: 推荐，劝告，使受欢迎；推荐，介绍；劝告；使受欢迎；托付；推荐；建议

examples.en: Doctors strongly recommend that fathers should be present at their baby’s birth.
examples.zh: 医生极力建议孩子出生时父亲应该在场。

examples.en: Sleeping tablets are not recommended in this case.
examples.zh: 这种情况下不建议使用安眠药。

examples.en: It is dangerous to exceed the recommended dose .
examples.zh: 超过建议剂量很危险。

words.definition: information about something that is written down or stored on computer, film etc so that it can be looked at in the future; to write information down or store it in a computer or on film so that it can be looked at in the future; register, keep track of; keep track of, make notes of; disk, file, resume, disc
words.translation: 记录；履历；记录，记载；标明；将...录音；录音；档案，履历；[电子]唱片；最高纪录

examples.en: According to official records, five people were killed last year near that road junction.
examples.zh: 据官方记录，去年有五人在那个路口附近丧生。

words.definition: a piece of electrical equipment that records music, films etc; tape-recorder, dictating machine
words.translation: 记录者；录音机；[电讯]录音机；[法][仪][电子]记录器；记录员；八孔直笛

examples.en: Rodney put the recorder on the desk top and pushed the play button.
examples.zh: 罗德尼把录音机放在桌面上，按下了播放键。

words.definition: to get better after an illness, accident, shock etc; restore, repair, offset, resume; restore, unsave
words.translation: 恢复，重新获得；恢复；弥补；重新获得；胜诉；重新得球

examples.en: After a few days of fever, she began to recover.
examples.zh: 发烧几天之后，她开始恢复。

words.definition: an activity that you do for pleasure or amusement; entertainment, pleasure, sport, occupation, amusement
words.translation: 娱乐活动， 消遣；娱乐；消遣；休养

examples.en: His only recreations are drinking beer and watching football.
examples.zh: 他唯一的消遣就是喝啤酒和看足球比赛。

examples.en: the provision of recreation facilities
examples.zh: 提供娱乐设施

words.definition: a shape that has four straight sides, two of which are usually longer than the other two, and four 90˚ angles at the corners; orthogon
words.translation: 矩形，长方形；[数]矩形；长方形

examples.en: Suppose the width of a rectangle is x metres.
examples.zh: 设长方形的宽是 x 米。

words.definition: to put used objects or materials through a special process so that they can be used again; regeneration, breeding, rebirth
words.translation: 循环，再利用；再生；再循环；重复利用

examples.en: We take all our bottles to be recycled.
examples.zh: 我们把我们所有的瓶子都回收利用。

examples.en: packaging made of recycled paper
examples.zh: 再生纸包装材料

words.definition: having the colour of blood; the colour of blood; deficit, clred; erythroid, rojo
words.translation: 红色的；红色；[光]红色，[颜料][染料]红颜料；赤字；[光]红色的；红肿的，充血的

examples.en: We painted the door bright red .
examples.zh: 我们把门漆成鲜红色。

examples.en: a red balloon
examples.zh: 一个红气球

words.translation: 使改方向；重新寄送；再直接的；再直接询问

words.definition: to make something smaller or less in size, amount, or price; shorten, weaken; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 减少；降低；使处于；把…分解；缩小；归纳为

examples.en: The governor announced a new plan to reduce crime.
examples.zh: 州长宣布了一项降低犯罪率的新计划。

examples.en: The helmet law should reduce injuries in motorcycle accidents.
examples.zh: 头盔法的实施应该能减少摩托车事故的受伤率。

examples.en: Small businesses will need to reduce costs in order to survive.
examples.zh: 小企业要想生存必须削减成本。

words.definition: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them; deal with, to consult; deal with, to relate to
words.translation: 使求助于；谈到；参考；涉及；提到；查阅；委托；归诸于；使…求助于

examples.en: In his speech, he referred to a recent trip to Canada.
examples.zh: 在他的讲话中，他提到了最近的加拿大之行。

words.definition: someone who makes sure that the rules of a sport such as football, basketball , or boxing , are followed; judge, pacifier; go between, reconcile
words.translation: （足球等）裁判员；裁判员；调解人；介绍人；为…当裁判；调停

examples.en: He was sent off for arguing with the referee.
examples.zh: 他因为和裁判发生争执而被罚出场。

words.definition: part of something you say or write in which you mention a person or thing; involved in, mention; quote; cite
words.translation: 参考；出处；提及；参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书；引用

examples.en: ...a reference from the Koran.
examples.zh: …一段《可兰经》的引文。

words.definition: if a person or a thing is reflected in a mirror, glass, or water, you can see an image of the person or thing on the surface of the mirror, glass, or water; glass, image; give back, flash back
words.translation: 反映；反射，照出；反省；反射，映现；深思

examples.en: The drop in consumer spending reflects concern about the economy.
examples.zh: 消费支出的下降反映出人们对经济的担忧。

words.definition: to improve a system, law, organization etc by making a lot of changes to it, so that it operates in a fairer or more effective way; transformation, correction, amendment; renovate, reconstitute; shake up, realign
words.translation: 改革，改良；改正；改革，革新；重新组成；重组；改过

examples.en: plans to radically reform the tax system
examples.zh: 彻底改革税收制度的计划

words.definition: to make someone feel less tired or less hot; renovate, to update; revive
words.translation: 使清新vi恢复精神；更新；使……恢复；使……清新；消除……的疲劳；恢复精神；喝饮料，吃点心；补充给养

examples.en: A shower will refresh you.
examples.zh: 洗个淋浴你就凉快了。

words.translation: 点心；[食品] 茶点；小吃

words.definition: a large piece of electrical kitchen equipment, shaped like a cupboard, used for keeping food and drink cool; icebox, freezer
words.translation: 冰箱，冷藏库；[制冷]冰箱，冷藏库

words.definition: when you say firmly that you will not do, give, or accept something; rejection, denial
words.translation: 拒绝；[贸易][金融]优先取舍权；推却；取舍权

examples.en: Her country suffered through her refusal to accept change.
examples.zh: 她的国家因为她拒绝接受变革而受了害。

words.definition: to say firmly that you will not do something that someone has asked you to do; garbage, waste, junk, rubbish, trash; negative, turn down; object, turn down
words.translation: 拒绝；垃圾；[环境]废物；不愿；抵制

examples.en: She asked him to leave, but he refused.
examples.zh: 她叫他走，但他不肯。

examples.en: When he offered all that money, I could hardly refuse (= could not refuse ) , could I?
examples.zh: 他愿意给那么多钱，我怎么可能拒绝呢？

words.definition: to think about someone or something in a particular way; estimation, respect, notice, publicity; view, study, honor, think about; take care of, watch
words.translation: 把…看作；尊敬；注意；尊重；问候；凝视；注重，考虑；看待；与…有关；注意，注重；注视

examples.en: He was regarded as the most successful president of modern times.
examples.zh: 他被看成是近代最成功的总统。

words.definition: without being affected or influenced by something; irregardless
words.translation: 不顾一切地；不管；不顾；不注意

examples.en: Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
examples.zh: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

words.translation: 致意，问候；视为，注意（regard的第三人称单数）

words.definition: an official list of names of people, companies etc, or a book that has this list; book in, book down; entry, page, enrollment
words.translation: 登记，注册；登记；[专利]注册；记录；挂号邮寄；把…挂号；正式提出；挂号；寄存器；登记簿

examples.en: Have you signed the hotel register ?
examples.zh: 你在酒店登记簿上签名了吗？

examples.en: Police want a national register of DNA samples.
examples.zh: 警方想要一个全国范围的DNA样本登记册。

words.definition: used in official letters or statements when saying that you are sorry or sad about something; sadness that you feel about something, especially because you wish it had not happened; pity, sorriness; grieve over, mourn over
words.translation: 懊悔；抱歉；遗憾；悲叹；后悔；惋惜；哀悼

examples.en: We regret any inconvenience caused to our customers.
examples.zh: 我们对于给顾客造成的不便表示歉意。

words.definition: happening every hour, every week, every month etc, usually with the same amount of time in between; qualified, stated, ordered, straight, periodic; familiar, elite; frequently, periodically
words.translation: 有规律的，经常的；定期的；有规律的；合格的；[植]整齐的；常客；正式队员；中坚分子；定期地；经常地

examples.en: The company holds regular meetings with employees.
examples.zh: 公司定期召集雇员开会。

examples.en: His breathing was slow and regular.
examples.zh: 他的呼吸缓慢而均匀。

examples.en: Trains will run at regular intervals from 11 am to 4 pm.
examples.zh: 火车从上午11点到下午4点每隔一定时间开行。

words.definition: an official rule or order; governance, administration, management, supervision, control; specified, stated, usual, prescribed, ordinary
words.translation: 管理；规则；[数]规则；校准；规定的；平常的

examples.en: There seem to be so many rules and regulations these days.
examples.zh: 如今好像条条框框很多。

examples.en: regulations governing the safety of toys
examples.zh: 监控玩具安全的条例

examples.en: All companies must comply with the regulations .
examples.zh: 所有公司都必须遵守规定。

words.definition: to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something; refuse, negative; inferior, degraded product
words.translation: 拒绝，驳回；拒绝；排斥；抵制；丢弃；被弃之物或人；次品

examples.en: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
examples.zh: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

examples.en: Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
examples.zh: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

examples.en: His proposal was rejected outright (= completely rejected ) .
examples.zh: 他的建议被彻底否决了。

words.definition: to tell someone about events that have happened to you or to someone else; narrate, recount; deal with, identify
words.translation: 叙述；使联系；使…有联系；涉及；认同；符合；与…有某种联系

examples.en: I don’t understand how the two ideas relate.
examples.zh: 我不明白这两个观点有什么联系。

words.definition: a connection between two or more things; connection, statement, bearing, concern, story
words.translation: 关系，联系；家属；[计]关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系

examples.en: The price the meat is sold for bears no relation to (= is not connected to ) the price the farmer receives.
examples.zh: 肉的售价和农民拿到的价格无关。

words.definition: the way in which two people or two groups feel about each other and behave towards each other; connection, correlation, bearing, concern, link
words.translation: 关系，联系；关系；关联

examples.en: He’s never had a sexual relationship before.
examples.zh: 他以前从未与人有过性关系。

words.definition: having a particular quality when compared with something else; a member of your family; opposing, proportional; kin, belongings
words.translation: 相对的；亲戚；有关系的；成比例的；相关物；[语]关系词；亲缘植物

examples.en: The relative merits of both approaches have to be considered.
examples.zh: 两种方法的相对优点都得考虑在内。

examples.en: her opponent’s relative lack of experience
examples.zh: 她的对手相对来说缺少经验

examples.en: You may think you’re poor, but it’s all relative (= you are not poor compared to some people ) .
examples.zh: 你可能认为自己很穷，但一切都是相对的。

words.definition: if you relax a part of your body or it relaxes, it becomes less stiff or less tight; to rest or do something that is enjoyable, especially after you have been working; lighten up, ease down; rest, lighten up
words.translation: 使松弛；松弛；放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容；休养；放松；使休息；缓和；使松懈

examples.en: Gentle exercise can relax stiff shoulder muscles.
examples.zh: 和缓的运动可以使僵硬的肩部肌肉放松。

words.definition: if radio or television signals are relayed, they are received and sent, especially so that they can be heard on the radio or seen on television; take sth over; realy, supersedure; retransmit
words.translation: 接替，转播；转播；接替；[电]继电器；接替，接替人员；驿马；使接替；分程传递

examples.en: The broadcasts were relayed by satellite.
examples.zh: 这些电视节目通过卫星进行转播。

words.definition: directly relating to the subject or problem being discussed or considered; concerned, involved
words.translation: 有关的，中肯的；有关的；中肯的；有重大作用的

examples.en: Relevant documents were presented in court.
examples.zh: 法庭上出示了相关的文件。

examples.en: We received all the relevant information.
examples.zh: 我们收到了所有相关信息。

words.definition: someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or depended on; responsible, tried, honest, safe, sure; true-blue
words.translation: 可靠的，可信赖的；可靠的；可信赖的；可靠的人

examples.en: a birth control method that is cheap and reliable
examples.zh: 既便宜又可靠的避孕方法

examples.en: Miller was a quiet and reliable man.
examples.zh: 米勒是个话不多且可靠的人。

words.definition: when something reduces someone’s pain or unhappy feelings; comfort, almsgiving
words.translation: 减轻；救济；援救；减轻，解除；安慰

examples.en: Marijuana can provide pain relief for some cancer patients.
examples.zh: 大麻可以为一些癌症患者减轻疼痛。

words.definition: a belief in one or more gods; deen, religious belief
words.translation: 宗教；宗教信仰

examples.en: The U.S. Constitution promises freedom of religion.
examples.zh: 美国宪法保证宗教信仰自由。

examples.en: a course on philosophy and religion
examples.zh: 关于哲学和宗教的课程

words.definition: relating to religion in general or to a particular religion; good, sacred; monk, cenobite
words.translation: 宗教的；虔诚的；严谨的；修道的；修道士；尼姑

examples.en: I don’t share her religious beliefs .
examples.zh: 她的宗教信仰和我的不同。

examples.en: a religious school
examples.zh: 宗教学校

examples.en: the dates of major religious observances such as Easter or Christmas
examples.zh: 复活节和圣诞节等重要宗教节日的日期

words.definition: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly; trust, hope
words.translation: 依赖，依靠；信赖；依靠

examples.en: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers.
examples.zh: 他们非常依赖专业顾问的建议。

words.definition: to stay in the same place without moving away; stop, keep up; debris, relic
words.translation: 剩下，余留；保持；依然；留下；剩余；逗留；残存；遗迹；剩余物，残骸

examples.en: The refugees were allowed to remain in the UK.
examples.zh: 难民获准留在英国。

words.definition: something that you say when you express an opinion or say what you have noticed; regard, notice, publicity; observe on, to comment on; talk of, discourse
words.translation: 评论，谈论；注意；言辞；评论；觉察；谈论

examples.en: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
examples.zh: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

words.definition: to have a picture or idea in your mind of people, events, places etc from the past; to learn by heart, honour the memory of; think of, come back
words.translation: 记得，想起；记住；记得；牢记；纪念；代…问好；记得，记起

examples.en: Do you remember Rosa Davies?
examples.zh: 你记得罗莎·戴维斯吗？

examples.en: I can’t remember her exact words.
examples.zh: 我记不得她的原话了。

examples.en: I remember it well ; I’d never seen my mother so angry.
examples.zh: 这件事我记得很清楚；我从未见过母亲这么生气。

words.definition: to make someone remember something that they must do; jack, put in mind
words.translation: 提醒，使想起；提醒；使想起

examples.en: Yes, I’ll be there. Thanks for reminding me.
examples.zh: 是的，我会去那里的。 谢谢提醒。

examples.en: He made a few notes to remind himself of what he wanted to say.
examples.zh: 他记了几条，提醒自己要说些什么。

words.definition: far from towns or other places where people live; distant, lonely
words.translation: 相隔很远的；冷淡的；遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的

examples.en: a remote border town
examples.zh: 一个偏远的边境小镇

examples.en: a fire in a remote mountain area
examples.zh: 偏远山区的火灾

words.definition: to get rid of something so that it does not exist any longer; put, translate; to shift, to move; move, shift, separation, distance, motion
words.translation: 消除，移除；移动，迁移；开除；调动；搬家；移动；距离

examples.en: a cleaner that will remove wine stains
examples.zh: 可去除葡萄酒酒渍的清洁剂

examples.en: The college removed rules that prevented women from enrolling.
examples.zh: 这所大学取消了禁止女性入学的规定。

words.definition: the money that someone pays regularly to use a room, house etc that belongs to someone else; to regularly pay money to live in a house or room that belongs to someone else, or to use something that belongs to someone else; letting, hire; lease out, hire out
words.translation: 租金，租；出租；[租赁]租金；租用；租借；[租赁]租

examples.en: I pay the rent at the beginning of every month.
examples.zh: 我每逢月初交付房租。

words.definition: to fix something that is damaged, broken, split, or not working properly; perform maintenance, fix up; restore, doctor, help; renovation, fixing
words.translation: 修理，修补；修理；修复；恢复；补救，纠正；修补部位

examples.en: Dad was up the ladder, repairing the roof.
examples.zh: 爸爸在梯子上修补屋顶。

examples.en: Where can I get my shoes repaired ?
examples.zh: 哪儿能修补鞋子？

words.translation: 修理；[会计] 修理费；备件；修理工作（repair的复数形式）；修理；恢复（repair的三单形式）；弥补；纠正

words.definition: to say or write something again; an event that is very like something that happened before; read back, echo; counterpart, iterance; do over, begin again
words.translation: 重说，重做；重复；复制；背诵；副本；重做；重复发生

examples.en: Can you repeat your question?
examples.zh: 你能重复一遍你的问题吗？

examples.en: Sorry - could you repeat that?
examples.zh: 对不起——你能再说一遍吗？

examples.en: It is not, I repeat not, my fault.
examples.zh: 那不是我的错，我再说一遍，不是。

words.definition: to start doing something instead of another person, or start being used instead of another thing; restore, return, shift, tender
words.translation: 代替；取代，代替；替换，更换；归还，偿还；把…放回原处

examples.en: I’m replacing Sue on the team.
examples.zh: 我将接替队里的休。

examples.en: Lectures have replaced the old tutorial system.
examples.zh: 课堂授课取代了旧式的导师制。

words.definition: to answer someone by saying or writing something; respond, answer; response, defence, answer; answer
words.translation: 回答，答复；[通信][计]回答；[法]答辩；回击；[计]回答；[通信]答复

examples.en: I asked Clive where he was going, but he didn’t reply.
examples.zh: 我问克莱夫到哪儿去，但他没有回答。

examples.en: Sorry it took me so long to reply.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我过了这么久才回复。

examples.en: ‘Did you see Simon today?’ ‘Of course,’ Nathalie replied with a smile.
examples.zh: “你今天见到西蒙了吗？”“当然啦。”纳萨莉笑着答道。

words.definition: to give people information about recent events, especially in newspapers and on television and radio; advisory, rept; cover, give notice to; message, inform of
words.translation: 报告；汇报；报道；成绩单；报导；使报到；报到；写报导

examples.en: This is Gavin Williams, reporting from the United Nations in New York.
examples.zh: 我是加文·威廉斯，在纽约联合国总部为您报道。

examples.en: We aim to report the news as fairly as possible.

words.definition: a building or part of a building where you can buy things, food, or services; to go to one or more shops to buy things; store, market; make a purchase
words.translation: 商店；店铺；购物；[贸易]商店；买东西

examples.en: a barber’s shop
examples.zh: 理发店

examples.en: a fish-and-chip shop
examples.zh: 炸鱼薯条店

examples.en: the local shops
examples.zh: 当地的商店

words.definition: someone who owns or is in charge of a small shop; boss, employer
words.translation: 店主，老板

examples.en: The girl had only worked for the shopkeeper for three days when she packed him in.
examples.zh: 这姑娘替那店主只干了三天， 就辞职不干了。

examples.en: In Jermyn Street in London, a shopkeeper anxiously asked who the next president would be.
examples.zh: 在伦敦的杰明街，一个店主焦急地问道，谁将是（美国）下一任总统。

examples.en: I was an unknown foreigner, and could have easily evaded payment with impunity, yet no London shopkeeper ever mistrusted me.
examples.zh: 我是一个没人知道的异乡人，本可以大胆地轻易逃避付款，但是从来没有一个伦敦的店主不信任我。

words.translation: 购物，买东西；购物（shop的ing形式）

words.definition: the land along the edge of a large area of water such as an ocean or lake; support, uphold, sustain; leg, backbone, stay
words.translation: 滨，岸；支撑，使稳住；用支柱撑住；海滨；支柱

examples.en: We could see a boat about a mile from shore.
examples.zh: 我们看见离岸边大约一英里的地方有一艘船。

examples.en: Only a few survivors reached the shore.
examples.zh: 仅有几个生还者到达岸边。

examples.en: She began to swim to shore.
examples.zh: 她开始朝岸边游去。

words.definition: happening or continuing for only a little time or for less time than usual; a short film shown in the cinema; to almost do something but then decide not to do it; insufficient, deficient, lacking; pop, hardly more than; deficiency, need, drought, want, default
words.translation: 短的；不足的；矮的，低的；短；缺乏；短路；短裤；不足；突然；唐突地；急速的；唐突的

examples.en: a short meeting
examples.zh: 一个短会

examples.en: Morris gave a short laugh.
examples.zh: 莫里斯笑了一声。

examples.en: a short course on business English
examples.zh: 商业英语短期课程

words.definition: a fault or weakness that makes someone or something less successful or effective than they should be; defect, deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault
words.translation: 短处， 缺点；缺点；短处

examples.en: Peter was painfully aware of his own shortcomings.
examples.zh: 彼得痛苦地认识到了自己的短处。

words.definition: soon; soon, immediately, now
words.translation: 立刻；简短地；唐突地

examples.en: Ms Jones will be back shortly.
examples.zh: 琼斯女士很快就会回来。

words.translation: 短裤

words.definition: small metal balls that are shot, many at a time, from a  shotgun; emission, sending, launch, shell, projection; varied, shabby
words.translation: 发射；弹丸；射门；[军]发射；炮弹；射手；用尽的；破旧的；杂色的，闪光的

examples.en: He shot all his bullets, but no one hit.
examples.zh: 他射出了所有的子弹却没有一发命中。

words.definition: used to say what is the right or sensible thing to do; ought, may, would
words.translation: 应该；竟然会；就；可能；将要

examples.en: He shouldn’t be so selfish.
examples.zh: 他不该这么自私。

examples.en: Why should anyone want to marry Tony?
examples.zh: 怎么竟然会有人意嫁给托尼？

words.definition: to accept a difficult or unpleasant responsibility, duty etc; undertake, accept, sustain
words.translation: 承担；挑起；肩负，承担

examples.en: The residents are being asked to shoulder the costs of the repairs.
examples.zh: 居民们被要求承担这笔修理费用。

examples.en: They shouldered the boat and took it down to the river.
examples.zh: 他们把船扛在肩上抬到河里。

words.definition: to say something very loudly; a loud call expressing anger, pain, excitement etc; yell out, exclaim; cry, yell out; cry, call
words.translation: 呼喊；喊叫；大声说；呼叫

examples.en: There’s no need to shout! I can hear you!
examples.zh: 用不着大声喊叫！我听得见！

examples.en: ‘Watch out!’she shouted, as the car started to move.
examples.zh: “小心！”汽车开动时，她大声喊道。

words.translation: 显示；说明；演出；展出；显示；表演；炫耀

words.definition: a piece of equipment that you stand under to wash your whole body; blast, flood; have a bath
words.translation: 阵雨；(一)阵；淋浴；（倾泻般出现的）一阵，一大批；[气象]阵雨；[气象]下阵雨

examples.en: Why does the phone always ring when I’m in the shower?
examples.zh: 为什么电话铃总是在我洗澡的时候响？

examples.en: I’d like to use the shower if that’s all right.
examples.zh: 如果可以的话，我想用一下这里的淋浴。

examples.en: The bathroom has a separate shower cubicle (= a shower in a separate part of the room ) .
examples.zh: 卫生间里有一个独立的淋浴间。

words.definition: to close something, or to become closed; not open; close down, close up; closure, closing down; circumambient
words.translation: 关闭；停业；幽禁；关闭的；围绕的

examples.en: Shut the window, Ellen!
examples.zh: 埃伦，把窗关上！

examples.en: I heard his bedroom door shut.
examples.zh: 我听到他的卧室门关上了。

examples.en: She lay down on her bed and shut her eyes .
examples.zh: 她在床上躺下，闭上眼睛。

words.definition: a  space shuttle; spaceplane
words.translation: 航天飞机；[航]航天飞机；穿梭；[纺]梭子；穿梭班机、公共汽车等

examples.en: They stand guard with weapons as the human survivors of the battle are marched onto the shuttle.
examples.zh: 他们站在一起用武器护卫着战后的人类幸存者鱼贯进入航天飞机。

examples.en: Simultaneously, a mysterious piece of debris flew high into the air near the shuttle, apparently from the flame trench.
examples.zh: 同时，一个未知的碎片在太空梭附近飞向天空，显然这个碎片是来自下方的火焰的。

words.definition: nervous and embarrassed about meeting and speaking to other people, especially people you do not know; if a horse shies, it makes a sudden movement away from something because it is frightened; chicken, blate; cast, recoil from; throw, cast, pitch; putting, cast, throw, jump
words.translation: 害羞的；畏缩的，胆怯的；投；畏缩；惊退；厌恶；投掷；惊跳；乱掷

examples.en: He was a quiet shy man.
examples.zh: 他是个话不多、害羞的男人。

examples.en: a shy smile
examples.zh: 羞怯的微笑

examples.en: As a teenager, I was painfully shy (= extremely shy ) .
examples.zh: 我十几岁时害羞得很。

words.definition: suffering from a disease or illness; patient, invalid; eager, hungry, anxious, desired, keen; shoot the cat, throw up
words.translation: 有病的；恶心的；病人；厌恶的；病态的；不舒服；渴望的；使狗去咬；呕吐；追击

examples.en: His mother’s very sick.
examples.zh: 他母亲病得很重。

examples.en: Maria can’t come in today because she’s sick.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚因为生病今天不能来了。

examples.en: a sick child
examples.zh: 生病的孩子

words.definition: the state of being ill; complaint, ailments
words.translation: 疾病, 呕吐；[医]疾病；呕吐；弊病

examples.en: an insurance policy against long-term sickness and injury
examples.zh: 保长期患病和受伤的保险单

examples.en: working days lost due to sickness
examples.zh: 因病损失的工作日

words.definition: one of the two areas that are on the left or the right of an imaginary line, or on the left or the right of a border, wall, river etc; to support or argue against a person or group in a quarrel, fight etc; aspect, respect; support of, root for; undertake, encourage, carry, second, back
words.translation: 旁边，侧面；坡，岸；一边/侧/方；支持；方面；侧面；旁边；赞助；偏袒；同意，支持

examples.en: Fuel is cheaper on the French side of the border.
examples.zh: 燃料在边境那边的法国要便宜些。

examples.en: A man stood watching me from the other side of the road.
examples.zh: 有个男人站在马路的对面看着我。

examples.en: His friends and family were all on the other side of the world.
examples.zh: 他的朋友和家人都在地球的另一边。

words.translation: 人行道；小巷；斜地里；旁边的；向侧面的（等于sideways）

words.definition: with the side, rather than the front or back, facing forwards; laterad
words.translation: 向侧面；向侧面地；向一旁

examples.en: They brought the piano sideways through the front door.
examples.zh: 他们把钢琴侧着从前门抬进来。

words.definition: to breathe in and out making a long sound, especially because you are bored, disappointed, tired etc; an act or sound of sighing; suspire; suspiration
words.translation: 叹气， 叹息；叹息；叹息，叹气

examples.en: ‘Well, there’s nothing we can do about it now,’ she sighed.
examples.zh: “唉，我们现在对此无能为力。”她叹口气说。

words.definition: something you can see; vision, scene, eye, scope, seeing; see, clap eyes on; level, watch; off-the-cuff, improvisatorial
words.translation: 景象；名胜，风景；视力；眼界；见解；看见；瞄准；观看；见票即付的；即席的

examples.en: the sights and sounds of the forest
examples.zh: 森林的景致与声音

examples.en: In the afternoon, you’ll have a chance to relax or see the sights.
examples.zh: 大家下午可以休息，也可以去参观名胜。

words.definition: when you visit famous or interesting places, especially as tourists; tourism, pleasure trip; visiting, touring
words.translation: 观光；游览；观光的；游览的

examples.en: She swam and sunbathed, went sightseeing and relaxed.
examples.zh: 她游泳，晒日光浴，观光，放松。

words.definition: a mark or shape that has a particular meaning; symbol, breath, evidence, mark, motion; subscribe; ink, endorse
words.translation: 符号；招牌；签名；迹象；记号；手势；签署；示意

examples.en: the dollar sign
examples.zh: 美元符号

examples.en: a minus sign
examples.zh: 减号

words.definition: a sound or action that you make in order to give information to someone or tell them to do something; high sign, alarm-word; mark; obvious, prominent, marked, noted, outstanding; semaphore
words.translation: 信号，发信号；信号；暗号；导火线；标志；用信号通知；显著的；作为信号的；发信号

examples.en: At a prearranged signal the lights went out.
examples.zh: 预定的信号一发出，灯就全灭了。

words.definition: your name written in the way you usually write it, for example at the end of a letter, or on a cheque etc, to show that you have written it; a scratch of pen
words.translation: 签名；署名；信号

examples.en: Her signature is totally illegible (= cannot be read ) .
examples.zh: 她的签字完全无法辨认。

examples.en: The school collected 4,000 signatures for the petition.
examples.zh: 学校为这份请愿书收集到了四千个签名。

examples.en: The Ukrainians put their signatures to the Lisbon Protocol.
examples.zh: 乌克兰签署了《里斯本协议》。

words.definition: The significance of something is the importance that it has, usually because it will have an effect on a situation or shows something about a situation; meaning, stress, weight, consequence
words.translation: 意义，意味；重要性；意义；意思

examples.en: Ideas about the social significance of religion have changed over time.
examples.zh: 有关宗教的社会意义的观念已随时间的流逝发生了改变。

words.definition: complete quiet because nobody is talking; to make someone stop talking, or stop something making a noise; still, quiescence; becalm, extinguish
words.translation: 沉默；使沉默；寂静；缄默；不谈；无声状态；使安静；压制；消除噪音

examples.en: There was a brief silence before anyone answered.
examples.zh: 沉默了片刻才有人回答。

examples.en: ‘Silence in court!’ roared the judge.
examples.zh: “法庭上请保持肃静！”法官吼道。

examples.en: The accused exercised his right to silence (= the legal right to choose to say nothing ) .
examples.zh: 被告行使了沉默权。

words.definition: without any sound, or not making any sound; still, mum
words.translation: 沉默的；寂静无声的；寂静的；无记载的

examples.en: The large house was silent and lonely.
examples.zh: 这幢大房子寂静荒凉。

examples.en: At last the guns fell silent .
examples.zh: 枪声终于沉寂了下来。

examples.en: Julie offered up a silent prayer that she would pass her exam.
examples.zh: 朱莉默默地祈祷，希望能通过这次考试。

words.definition: a thin smooth soft cloth made from very thin thread which is produced by a silkworm; seda; filar, sericeous
words.translation: 蚕丝，丝，丝织品；丝绸；[纺]蚕丝；丝织物；丝的；丝绸的；丝制的

examples.en: pure silk stockings
examples.zh: 生丝面料的漂亮连衣裙

words.definition: not sensible, or showing bad judgment; foolish, stupid, mad, doltish, insipient; stupid, fool, donkey, gump, aleck
words.translation: 傻的，愚蠢的；愚蠢的；傻瓜

examples.en: Stop asking silly questions.
examples.zh: 别再问傻问题了。

examples.en: You made a lot of silly mistakes .
examples.zh: 你犯了许多愚蠢的错误。

examples.en: I left my keys at home, which was a pretty silly thing to do .
examples.zh: 我干了件傻事，把钥匙落在家里了。

words.definition: almost the same; alike, like; analog
words.translation: 相似的；类似物

examples.en: We have similar tastes in music.
examples.zh: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

examples.en: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
examples.zh: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

examples.en: A number of his friends had been affected in a similar way .
examples.zh: 他的一些朋友也受到了类似的影响。

words.definition: used to emphasize that only one thing is involved; plain, primitive; turkey, put, idiot, stupid
words.translation: 单纯的；迟钝的；[生物]简单的；天真的；笨蛋；愚蠢的行为；出身低微者

examples.en: Completing the race is not just a simple matter of physical fitness.
examples.zh: 跑完比赛不仅仅是纯粹的体力问题。

examples.en: I’m afraid Luke’s a bit simple.
examples.zh: 我觉得卢克有点笨。

words.definition: to make something easier or less complicated; predigest, deformalize
words.translation: 简化；使单纯；使简易

examples.en: an attempt to simplify the tax system
examples.zh: 简化税制的尝试

examples.en: The law needs to be simplified.
examples.zh: 这部法律需要简化。

examples.en: a simplified version of the game
examples.zh: 这个游戏的简化版

words.definition: if you say or explain something simply, you say it in a way that is easy for people to understand; merely, fairly, just, only, but
words.translation: 简单地；朴素地；仅仅；简直；坦白地

examples.en: Try to express yourself more simply.
examples.zh: 尽量把你的意思表达得更简单明了。

examples.en: To put it simply, the tax cuts mean the average person will be about 3% better off.
examples.zh: 简单地说，这次减税意味着普通人的收入将增加 3% 左右。

words.translation: 因为；由于；既然；自…以来；自…以后；自…以来；自…以后；后来
真诚地；由衷地，诚恳地

words.definition: to produce a musical sound with your voice; pay a tribute to, descant; chant; stridulation
words.translation: 唱歌；歌颂；鸣叫；呼号；演唱；鸣声；呼啸声；唱；用诗赞颂；唱着使

examples.en: She can sing beautifully.
examples.zh: 她唱歌很好听。

examples.en: Most children enjoy singing.
examples.zh: 大多数孩子都喜欢唱歌。

examples.en: We had a great time singing some of the old songs .
examples.zh: 我们唱了一些老歌，非常开心。

words.definition: someone who sings; vocalist, chansonnier
words.translation: 歌手；歌手，歌唱家

examples.en: the lead singer (= main singer ) of Slade
examples.zh: 施莱德乐队的主唱

examples.en: Tina Turner’s backing singers
examples.zh: 蒂纳·特纳的伴唱歌手

words.definition: only one; a ticket for a trip from one place to another but not back again; unitary, onefold; yin, one-way ticket
words.translation: 单一的；独身的；单程的；单程票；单身的；一个；单打

examples.en: A single tree gave shade from the sun.
examples.zh: 唯有一棵树遮阴。

examples.en: They won the game by a single point.
examples.zh: 他们仅以一分的优势赢得比赛。

examples.en: the highest price ever paid for a single work of art
examples.zh: 为单件艺术品所支付的最高价格

words.definition: a large open container that you fill with water and use for washing yourself, washing dishes etc; dip; to dig, tap into; trough, washing tank
words.translation: （厨房内的）洗涤槽；下沉；消沉；渗透；使下沉；挖掘；使低落；[化工]水槽；洗涤槽；污水坑

examples.en: Dirty plates were piled high in the sink.
examples.zh: 脏盘子在洗涤槽里堆得很高。

words.definition: used when speaking to a man in order to be polite or show respect; don, gentleman
words.translation: 先生；（用于姓名前）爵士；阁下；（中小学生对男教师的称呼）先生；老师；阁下，先生

examples.en: ‘Report back to me in an hour, sergeant.’ ‘Yes, sir.’
examples.zh: “一小时后向我报告，中士。”“是，长官。”

examples.en: Can I help you, sir?
examples.zh: 我能为您效劳吗，先生？

examples.en: Sir! You dropped your wallet.
examples.zh: 先生！ 您的钱包掉了。

words.definition: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you; sis, tittie
words.translation: 姐，妹；护士长；修女，女教士；姐妹；修女；护士

examples.en: Janet and Abby are sisters.
examples.zh: 珍妮特和阿比是两姐妹。

examples.en: He has two sisters and a brother.
examples.zh: 他有两个姊妹和一个弟弟。

examples.en: She’s my twin sister .
examples.zh: 她是我的孪生妹妹。

words.definition: to be in a particular position or condition; lie on, be located on
words.translation: 坐；位于；(Sit)人名；(东南亚国家华语)硕；(罗)西特

examples.en: The parliament building sits in a large square.
examples.zh: 议会大楼位于一个大广场上。

examples.en: He’s got a computer sitting on his desk, but he doesn’t use it.
examples.zh: 他有一台电脑放在书桌上，但他不用。

examples.en: My climbing boots were sitting unused in a cupboard.
examples.zh: 我的登山靴在橱柜里，一直没有穿。

words.definition: a combination of all the things that are happening and all the conditions that exist at a particular time in a particular place; circumstance, case, location, thing, aspect
words.translation: 情况；形势；处境；位置

examples.en: I explained the situation to everyone.
examples.zh: 我向大家介绍了一下情况。

words.definition: the number 6; hexa
words.translation: 六,六个；六，六个

examples.en: six months ago
examples.zh: 六个月前

examples.en: She arrived just after six (= six o’clock ) .
examples.zh: 她六点刚过就到了。

examples.en: He learnt to play the violin when he was six (= six years old ) .
examples.zh: 他六岁学拉小提琴。

words.definition: the number
words.translation: 十六

examples.en: sixteen years later
examples.zh: 16年后

examples.en: He moved to London when he was sixteen (= 16 years old ) .
examples.zh: 他 16 岁时搬到了伦敦。

words.definition: one of 16 equal parts of something; sexadecimal
words.translation: 第十六,十六分之一；第十六；十六分之一

examples.en: But in the course of history, we settled beginning in the sixteenth and seventeenth century, down into just two patterns: what we call the major pattern and the minor pattern.
examples.zh: 但在历史的发展过程中,在十六到十七世纪期间,人们最终确定了下列两种模式,我们称之为大调模式和小调模式

words.definition: one of six equal parts of something; sextus
words.translation: 第六, 六分之一；（与 the 连用）第六的，第六个的；六分之一的

examples.en: About one sixth of the children admitted to taking drugs.
examples.zh: 大约六分之一的儿童承认吸毒。

words.translation: 六十；六十个

words.definition: how big or small something is; to sort according to size; measurement, magnitude, dimension
words.translation: 大小；尺寸；一定尺寸的；依大小排列

examples.en: He’s a small boy, about John’s size.
examples.zh: 他是个小男孩，个子和约翰差不多。

examples.en: Jensens’ house is about the same size as ours.
examples.zh: 詹森的房子和我们的差不多大。

examples.en: He’s quite a big dog, but he’s still not full size yet.
examples.zh: 这条狗体型很大，但还没有长足。

words.definition: to move on skates; one of a pair of boots with metal blades on the bottom, for moving quickly on ice; ice skating, ice-skate; ice-skating
words.translation: 滑冰；滑过；溜冰；冰鞋

examples.en: The children skated on the frozen pond.
examples.zh: 孩子们在结冰的池塘上滑冰。

examples.en: an enemy soldier
examples.zh: 敌兵

words.definition: hard or firm, with a fixed shape, and not a liquid or gas; responsible, honest, united, consistent, reliable; cube
words.translation: 扎实的，坚实的；[物]固体的；可靠的；[数]立体的；结实的；一致的；[物]固体；[数]立方体

examples.en: The lake was frozen solid .
examples.zh: 湖水冻得结结实实。

examples.en: It was good to be back on solid ground again.
examples.zh: 又能踏上坚实的土地感觉真好。

examples.en: Is the baby eating solid food (= bread, meat etc ) yet?
examples.zh: 宝宝吃固体食物了吗？

words.translation: 一些；某个；大约；相当多的；一些；若干；其中的一部分；（数量不确切时用）有些人；非常；相当；<美>稍微

words.definition: used to mean a person, when you do not know, or do not say who the person is; anybody, big people
words.translation: 某人，有人；大人物；重要人物

examples.en: There’s somebody waiting to see you.
examples.zh: 有人等着要见你。

examples.en: Somebody’s car alarm kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 不知谁的汽车警报器吵得我整晚都无法入睡。

examples.en: ‘Who can we get to babysit?’ ‘I’ll call Suzie or somebody .’
examples.zh: “我们能请谁来看小孩呢？”“我会叫苏齐或别的什么人。”

words.definition: used to mean a person, when you do not know or do not say who the person is
words.translation: 有人, 某人

examples.en: What would you do if someone tried to rob you in the street?
examples.zh: 要是有人在街上抢劫你，你会怎么办？

examples.en: Will someone please explain what’s going on?
examples.zh: 谁能说说是怎么回事？

examples.en: Have Brooks or someone fax this to New York right away.
examples.zh: 叫布鲁克斯或谁立刻把这个发传真到纽约。

words.definition: used to mean a particular thing when you do not know its name or do not know exactly what it is; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too
words.translation: 某事,某物；有点,大约；非常；有点；大约

examples.en: There’s something in my eye.
examples.zh: 我眼睛里有什么东西。

examples.en: Sarah said something about coming over later.
examples.zh: 萨拉说她等一会儿过来什么的。

examples.en: I don’t know what he does exactly, but I know it has something to do with computers (= is related to them in some way ) .
examples.zh: 我不知道他具体是干什么的，只知道和电脑有关。

words.definition: on some occasions but not always; occasionally, betweentimes
words.translation: 不时，有时，间或；有时，间或

examples.en: I sometimes have to work late.
examples.zh: 我有时得工作到很晚。

examples.en: Sometimes, Grandma would tell us stories about her childhood in Italy.
examples.zh: 有时候，祖母会跟我们讲讲她儿时在意大利的经历。

examples.en: ‘Do you ever wish you were back in Japan?’ ‘Sometimes. Not very often.’
examples.zh: “你有没有想过希望回到日本？”“有时候吧，但不经常这么想。”

words.definition: in or to a place, but you do not say or know exactly where
words.translation: 某处, 在某处

examples.en: My wallet must be around here somewhere.
examples.zh: 我的钱包肯定是在这里的什么地方。

examples.en: We could meet for dinner at Giorgio’s or somewhere (= or a similar place ) .
examples.zh: 我们可以在乔治家或别的什么地方一起吃饭。

words.definition: someone’s male child; child, fils
words.translation: 儿子；孩子（对年轻人的称呼）；男性后裔

examples.en: Her son Sean was born in 1983.
examples.zh: 她的儿子肖恩出生于 1983 年。

examples.en: They have three sons and a daughter.
examples.zh: 他们有三个儿子和一个女儿。

examples.en: In those days, the property went to the oldest son.
examples.zh: 那时候，财产由长子继承。

words.definition: the musical sounds made by birds and some other animals such as  whales; poems, melody
words.translation: 歌曲；歌唱；诗歌；鸣声

examples.en: the song of the lark
examples.zh: 云雀的鸣唱

words.definition: in a short time from now, or a short time after something else happens; immediately, rather, now, first, quick
words.translation: 不久,很快；快；不久，一会儿；立刻；宁愿

examples.en: It will be dark soon.
examples.zh: 天很快就要黑了。

examples.en: David arrived sooner than I expected.
examples.zh: 戴维到得比我预料的快。

examples.en: ‘Who?’ ‘You’ll find out soon enough (= fairly soon ) .’
examples.zh: “谁？”“你很快就会知道的。”

words.definition: a feeling of great sadness, usually because someone has died or because something terrible has happened to you; soreness, disconsolateness; feel sad
words.translation: 悲痛，悲哀，悲伤；悲伤；懊悔；伤心事；遗憾；感到悲伤

examples.en: the family’s joys and sorrows
examples.zh: 这家人的喜与悲

words.translation: 遗憾的；对不起的，抱歉的；对不起，抱歉（表示委婉的拒绝等）

words.definition: a group or class of people, things etc that have similar qualities or features; to put things in a particular order or arrange them in groups according to size, type etc; category, manner, way of, variety, kind, mode, nature; travel, company, mix, associate, concert; systematize
words.translation: 种类；类别；整理；方式；品质；[计]分类；协调；交往；将…分类；将…排序；挑选出某物

examples.en: Most of the victims developed psychological problems of one sort or another (= of various different types ) .
examples.zh: 大多数受害者都出现了这样那样的心理问题。

examples.en: They do burgers, pizzas, that sort of thing .
examples.zh: 他们供应汉堡包、比萨饼什么的。

words.definition: the part of a person that is not physical, and that contains their character, thoughts, and feelings. Many people believe that a person’s soul continues to exist after they have died.; energy, spirit, mind, ka, genius
words.translation: 灵魂；心灵；精神；鬼魂；美国黑人文化的

examples.en: the immortality of the soul
examples.zh: 灵魂的不灭

examples.en: It was as if those grey eyes could see into the very depths of her soul .
examples.zh: 仿佛那双灰眼睛能看到她的灵魂深处。

examples.en: the souls of the dead
examples.zh: 亡灵

words.definition: complete and thorough; hear, feel, scale; voice, speech, noise, neck, row; healthy, reasonable, responsible, honest, logical; thoroughly, fully, entirely, completely, well; ring, noise
words.translation: 健康的；完好的；听（诊）；测量，测…深；使发声；试探；宣告；[声]声音，语音；噪音；海峡；吵闹；听力范围；[医]探条；健全的，健康的；合理的；可靠的；有效彻底的；彻底地，充分地；听起来；发出声音；回响；测深

examples.en: a sound understanding of money and banking systems
examples.zh: 对货币和银行业体制的透彻理解

examples.en: a sound knowledge of English
examples.zh: 扎实的英语知识

examples.en: He has sound grasp of European history.
examples.zh: 他对欧洲历史有着透彻的理解。

words.definition: cooked liquid food, often containing small pieces of meat, fish, or vegetables; horsepower, gippo; increase speed, quicken up
words.translation: 汤，羹；马力；加速；增加马力

examples.en: homemade tomato soup
examples.zh: 自制的番茄汤

words.definition: having a sharp acid taste, like the taste of a  lemon  or a fruit that is not ready to be eaten; grinding, acid, raised, evil, sharp; go bad, get tired of; fail, fox
words.translation: 酸的；脾气坏的；[化学]酸的；发酵的；刺耳的；酸臭的；讨厌的；发酵；变酸；厌烦；使变酸；使失望

examples.en: Rachel sampled the wine. It was sour.
examples.zh: 雷切尔尝了尝葡萄酒，是酸的。

examples.en: sour cherries
examples.zh: 酸樱桃

words.definition: the direction that is at the bottom of a map of the world, below the Equator. It is on the right if you are facing the rising sun.; towards the south; in the south, or facing the south; austral
words.translation: 南方，南边；南部；在南方，向南方；南的，南方的

examples.en: Which way is south?
examples.zh: 哪面是南？

words.translation: 南的；南方的；南方人

examples.en: a southern accent
examples.zh: 南部口音

examples.en: Southern Italy
examples.zh: 意大利南部

words.definition: the direction that is exactly between south and west; a southwest wind comes from the southwest; If you go southwest, you travel toward the southwest
words.translation: 西南方；西南的；往西南；来自西南

examples.en: ...some 500 kilometres to the southwest of Johannesburg.
examples.zh: …约翰内斯堡西南约五百公里。

examples.en: We took a plane southwest across the Anatolian plateau to Cappadocia.
examples.zh: 我们乘飞机朝西南方,越过安纳托利亚高原,飞往卡帕多细亚。

words.translation: 纪念品；旅游纪念品；回忆

words.translation: 播(种)；播种；散布；使密布

examples.en: Sow the seeds in late March.
examples.zh: 三月底播种。

words.definition: the amount of an area, room, container etc that is empty or available to be used; separation, vacuum, room, distance, remove; keep distance; partition off, fence out
words.translation: 空间；太空；距离；留间隔；隔开

examples.zh: 每张磁盘有多大容量？

examples.en: The hedge takes up too much space .
examples.zh: 这树篱占了太多的地方。

words.definition: a vehicle for carrying people through space; aerospacecraft
words.translation: [航] 宇宙飞船；[航]宇宙飞船

examples.en: ...an alien spaceship.
examples.zh: …一艘外星人的宇宙飞船。

words.definition: a tool for digging that has a long handle and a broad metal blade that you push into the ground; rabbler; shool; shovel
words.translation: 铲，铁锹；铁锹，铲子；[建]铲；把……弄实抹平

examples.zh: …一把花园里使用的锹。

words.translation: 意大利式细面条

examples.zh: 比尔：我想要份土豆泥和意大利面条。

examples.en: Dawson: Suppose I tell them how you followed her to that studio in Chelsea and watched them cooking spaghetti and all that rubbish. Wouldn't that ring a bell?
examples.zh: 道森：假设我告诉他们你怎样尾随她到了切尔西的工作室，看他们煮意大利面条，以及所有那些废话。那不会使他们有所警觉吗?。

words.translation: 西班牙(欧洲南部国家)

examples.en: They are touring in Spain.
examples.zh: 他们正在西班牙旅游。

examples.en: She chose Spain, but personally I'd prefer to go to France.
examples.zh: 她选择了西班牙，而我个人倒更愿意去法国。

examples.en: This island was ceded to Spain more than one hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 这个岛屿在一百多年以前就割让给西班牙了。

words.definition: the language used in Spain and parts of Latin America; Hispanic; Espanyol, gachupin
words.translation: 西班牙(的),西班牙人(的)；西班牙的；西班牙语的；西班牙人的；西班牙语；西班牙人

words.definition: not being used or not needed at the present time; economize on, save on; excuse from, economize on; thin, unnecessary, waste, redundant, superfluous; surplus, residual
words.translation: 空闲的；节约，吝惜；饶恕；分出，分让；饶恕，宽恕；节约；多余的；瘦的；少量的；剩余；备用零件

examples.en: Have you got any spare boxes?
examples.zh: 你有没有多余的盒子？

examples.en: You could sleep in the spare bedroom.
examples.zh: 你可以睡那间空着的客房。

examples.en: Do you have any spare cash?
examples.zh: 你手头有闲钱吗？

words.definition: a small brown bird, very common in many parts of the world; small, spadger
words.translation: [鸟]麻雀；麻雀；矮小的人

examples.zh: 桃金娘，鸽子，麻雀和天鹅是她的圣物。

examples.en: Appearing in great danger, the tiny sparrow tumbled on to the lawn, but softy Flint appeared to have taken pity on him.
examples.zh: 跌落在草地上的小麻雀看起来处于非常危险的境地，但是温柔的“弗林特”似乎非常同情他。

examples.en: Only a solitary cracked-voiced reed-sparrow greeted her from the bushes by the river, in a sad, machine-made tone, resembling that of a past friend whose friendship she had outworn.
examples.zh: 只有一只声音嘶哑的芦雀，在河边的树丛中用悲伤机械的音调向她打招呼，就像一个已经没有了友谊的从前的朋友向她打招呼的声音一样。

words.translation: 说话；演讲；表明；陈述；讲话；发言；讲演

examples.zh: 我震惊得说不出话来。

examples.en: He spoke very softly (= quietly ) .
examples.zh: 他说话声音非常轻柔。

words.definition: someone who makes a formal speech to a group of people; lecturer, rostrum
words.translation: 演讲者；扬声器；说话者；说某种语言的人；[电子]扬声器

examples.en: The keynote speaker (= main or most important speaker ) was Robert Venturi, the architect.
examples.zh: 主要发言人是建筑师罗伯特·文图里。

words.definition: a pole with a sharp pointed blade at one end, used as a weapon in the past; to push or throw a spear into something, especially in order to kill it; pike
words.translation: 矛，枪；用矛刺

examples.en: I fended off his sword thrust with my spear.
examples.zh: 他一刀砍来， 我拿枪架住。

examples.en: He transfixed the enemy's heart with a spear.
examples.zh: 他用长矛刺穿了敌人的心脏。

examples.en: Yes,of course. My shield is the strongest.It can stop any spear in the world.
examples.zh: 当然是了。我的盾是最结实的，它能抵挡住世界上任何矛。

words.definition: not ordinary or usual, but different in some way and often better or more important; bargain; particular, extraordinary, technical, dedicated, express
words.translation: 特殊的,专门的;附加的,额外的；特使，特派人员；特刊；特色菜；专车；特价商品；特别的；专门的，专用的

examples.en: a special place in the classroom for reading
examples.zh: 教室里的阅读专区

examples.en: No one receives special treatment.
examples.zh: 没有人享有特殊待遇。

examples.en: Maria’s special recipe for apple pie
examples.zh: 玛丽亚的苹果馅饼秘方

words.translation: 专家；专门医师；专家的；专业的
