examples.zh: 心脏专科医生

words.definition: a talk, especially a formal one about a particular subject, given to a group of people; address, lecture, talk, sound
words.translation: 演讲；讲话；[语] 语音；演说；[语]语音

examples.en: He has to make a lot of after-dinner speeches .
examples.zh: 他经常要发表席后演说。

examples.en: Collins gave the keynote speech (= most important speech ) .
examples.zh: 科林斯作了主题发言。

words.definition: to be driving faster than the legal limit; the rate at which something moves or travels; quicken up, to accelerate; velocity, prosperity, up, tempo; make a go of
words.translation: 超速，加速；加速，迅速前行；兴隆；速度，速率；迅速，快速；昌盛，繁荣；[力]速度，速率；加快…的速度；使成功，使繁荣

examples.en: I got caught speeding on the A40 yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我在 A40 号干线公路上超速行驶被逮到。

words.definition: to form a word by writing or naming the letters in order; a piece of magic that someone does, or the special words or ceremonies used in doing it; possess, invite, court, secure; cycle, grace, while, charm, period of time; turn taking
words.translation: 拼，拼写；意味着；招致；拼成；迷住；轮值；符咒；一段时间；魅力；拼字；轮替

examples.en: How do you spell ‘juice’?
examples.zh: juice 怎么拼？

examples.en: Pupils should know how to spell commonly used words.
examples.zh: 小学生应该知道常用词的拼法。

words.definition: the act of spelling words correctly, or the ability to do this; beguiling
words.translation: 拼字， 拼法， 拼写法；拼写；意味着（spell的ing形式）；迷住

examples.en: Her spelling has improved.
examples.zh: 她的拼写进步了。

examples.en: an essay full of spelling mistakes
examples.zh: 一篇满是拼写错误的文章

words.definition: to use your money to pay for goods or services; invested, lose, cost, last; peter, consume; budget
words.translation: 度过，消磨（时光）；花费；浪费；用尽；预算；花钱；用尽，耗尽

examples.en: I can’t afford to spend any more money this week.
examples.zh: 这星期我没有能力花更多的钱了。

examples.en: The repairs cost a lot, but it’s money well spent (= a sensible way of spending money ) .
examples.zh: 修理费很高，但这是该花的钱。

words.definition: to turn around and around very quickly, or to make something do this; an act of turning around quickly; wheel, circle; turn, swing; revolution, rotation, rolling, turning
words.translation: 纺；使旋转；旋转；[物]旋转；纺纱；吐丝；晕眩；[物]使旋转；编造；结网；疾驰

examples.en: The plane’s propellers were spinning.
examples.zh: 飞机的螺旋桨在快速旋转。

words.definition: the qualities that make someone live the way they do, and make them different from other people; mood, emotion, energy, soul, mind; heart, stimulate, lift, uphold, inspire
words.translation: 精神;志气;(pl.)情绪,心情;(pl.)酒精；精神；心灵；情绪；志气；烈酒；鼓励；鼓舞；诱拐

examples.en: His spirits were so low (= he was so sad ) that he refused to answer his phone.
examples.zh: 他情绪非常低落，连电话也不愿接。

words.definition: relating to your spirit rather than to your body or mind; motet, canticle; mental, inner
words.translation: 精神的， 心灵的；宗教的；圣歌（尤指美国南部黑人的）；精神的，心灵的

examples.en: Painting helps fill a spiritual need for beauty.
examples.zh: 绘画可以满足对美的精神需求。

examples.en: spiritual values
examples.zh: 精神价值

words.definition: to force a small amount of  saliva (= the liquid in your mouth )  out of your mouth; the watery liquid that is produced in your mouth; golly; release, project, let go; saliva, slabber

examples.zh: 尼克摇下窗子，啐了口唾沫。

words.translation: 壮丽的；极好的；辉煌的；灿烂的；杰出的

examples.zh: 很妙的主意

examples.en: a splendid opportunity
examples.zh: 绝佳的机会

examples.en: The staff are doing a splendid job.
examples.zh: 员工们干得非常棒。

words.translation: 劈开；被劈开；分离；使分离；离开；断绝关系；[木]裂缝；劈开的

examples.zh: 树枝承受不住他们的重量断裂了。

examples.zh: 在一次强劲的大风中那艘船断成了两半。

examples.en: If the chicken is fairly small, you may simply split it in half.
examples.zh: 要是鸡不太大，你把它分成两半就行。

words.translation: 口语的，口头的；说（speak的过去分词）

words.definition: to agree to help someone or be responsible for what they do; friend, guarantee, entrepreneur; launch, support of
words.translation: 赞助；赞助者；主办者；保证人；发起

examples.en: Dozens of companies, including Hewlett-Packard, are sponsoring the event.
examples.zh: 包括惠普在内的许多公司都在赞助这项赛事。

words.definition: an object that you use for eating, cooking, or serving food. It has a small bowl-shaped part and a long handle.; to move food with a spoon; scooper
words.translation: 匙，勺子；一杓的量；用匙舀；使成匙状

examples.en: He spooned instant coffee into two of the mugs.
examples.zh: 他用勺把速溶咖啡舀进了两个杯子里。

words.translation: 一匙

examples.en: He took a spoonful of the stew and ate it.
examples.zh: 他舀起一匙炖菜吃了下去。

words.translation: 特定的，具体的；特殊的，特定的；明确的；详细的；[药]具有特效的；特性；细节；特效药

examples.en: games suitable for specific age groups
examples.zh: 适合特定年龄组的游戏

examples.en: a specific example of alcohol’s effect on the body
examples.zh: 酒精对身体影响的具体例子

words.definition: correct and true in every detail; precise, mathematical, strict, rigid, refined
words.translation: 精确的，准确的；精确的

examples.en: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
examples.zh: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

words.definition: to promise that you will pay back money that someone else has borrowed, if they do not pay it back themselves; assurance, certification, commitment, warranty, pledge; assure, undertake, swear for
words.translation: 保证，担保；[金融]保证；[法]担保；保证人；保证书；[经]抵押品

examples.en: The bank will only lend me money if my parents guarantee the loan.
examples.zh: 只有我父母作担保，银行才会给我贷款。

words.definition: towards the outside or away from the centre of something
words.translation: 向外，往海外

examples.en: The door opens outwards.
examples.zh: 这门是朝外开的。

words.translation: 旅行，游历

examples.en: He devilled her during the tour.
examples.zh: 他在旅行中拿她打趣逗乐。

examples.en: We tour by car every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天我们都驾车出外旅行。

words.definition: large objects such as chairs, tables, beds, and cupboards
words.translation: 家具；装置，设备

examples.en: I helped him choose the furniture for his house.
examples.zh: 我帮他挑选房子里用的家具。

examples.en: I can’t think of a single piece of furniture in my house that I bought new.
examples.zh: 我想不出家里有哪件家具是新买的。

examples.en: office furniture
examples.zh: 办公室家具

words.definition: to give something, especially money, to a person or an organization in order to help them; make a contribution to, endow; give, make a contribution to; contribution, endowment, subscription
words.translation: 捐赠；[经]捐献

examples.en: people who volunteer to donate blood
examples.zh: 自愿献血者

words.definition: if something occupies you or your time, you are busy doing it; bag, exercise
words.translation: 占领；占，占有；占据，占领；居住；使忙碌

examples.en: Football occupies most of my leisure time.
examples.zh: 足球占去了我大部分的闲暇时间。

words.definition: an object that you buy or keep to remind yourself of a special occasion or a place you have visited; gift, giving, present, tribute
words.translation: 纪念品；礼物

examples.en: a souvenir shop
examples.zh: 纪念品商店

words.definition: haircloth, woollen fabric
words.translation: 毛线的；毛制品；毛织品

examples.en: And whenever I saw woolen products advertised, I stopped to see what was on offer.
examples.zh: 无论我在哪儿看见关于羊毛制品的广告，我都会停下来看看。

examples.en: I loved the smell of cork grease and slide oil, of musty woolen uniforms, and the tangy dankness of brassy horn bells.
examples.zh: 我喜欢闻松脂和黑色润滑油味道，喜欢闻羊毛制服的霉味和潮湿的黄铜喇叭的扑鼻气味。

words.definition: a woman whose husband has died and who has not married again; relict
words.translation: 寡妇；孀妇

examples.en: an elderly widow who was attacked and robbed last month
examples.zh: 上个月遭到行凶抢劫的一位寡居老妇

examples.en: a wealthy widow
examples.zh: 富孀

words.translation: 过客， 过路人

words.definition: after an event or time that has already been mentioned; then, next, since, subsequently
words.translation: 后来， 以后；后来；然后

examples.en: Charles arrived shortly afterwards .
examples.zh: 过了不多久，查尔斯来了。

examples.en: She died not long afterwards .
examples.zh: 不久以后她去世了。

examples.en: Afterwards, I was asked to write a book.
examples.zh: 后来，有人要我写一本书。

words.definition: to become smaller, or to make something smaller, through the effects of heat or water; contract, recoil from; astrict, constringe; contraction, necking down
words.translation: 起皱；收缩；退缩， 畏缩；畏缩；使缩小，使收缩

examples.en: I’m worried about washing that shirt in case it shrinks.
examples.zh: 我不太敢洗那件衬衫，怕它会缩水。

words.definition: to injure yourself or someone else; wound, blast; pain; smart, painfulness; injured, painful, wounded, bitter
words.translation: 使受伤；使痛心；损害；使疼痛；感到疼痛；有坏处；带来痛苦；痛苦；危害；痛苦的原因；受伤的；痛苦的；受损的

examples.en: Was anyone hurt in the accident?
examples.zh: 事故中有人受伤吗？

examples.en: Put that thing down - you might hurt someone with it.
examples.zh: 快把那东西放下，你会伤着别人的。

words.definition: used instead of repeating a verb that has already been used; requirement, provision, need, desire, demand; accomplish, carry out, come, achieve, perform; progress, wage
words.translation: v；做，干，办；要求；规定；C大调音阶中的第一音；做；进行；完成；解答

examples.en: ‘Will Kay come?’ ‘She may do.’
examples.zh: “凯来吗？” “或许吧。”

examples.en: So now you know as much as I do.
examples.zh: 那么现在你知道的和我一样多了。

examples.en: ‘You forgot all about it.’ ‘No, I didn’t.’
examples.zh: “你把这事忘记得一干二净。” “没有，我没忘记。”

words.definition: a chemical substance used to kill insects and small animals that destroy crops; insecticide, insect repellent, insect killer, insect spray, anabasin
words.translation: 杀虫剂， 农药；[农药]杀虫剂

examples.en: They sprinkled pesticide to bug the potatoes .
examples.zh: 他们喷撒杀虫剂给马铃薯除虫。

examples.en: This resulted in the contamination of the bags used in that facility's fluid bed dryers with pesticide contamination.
examples.zh: 这导致了由于工厂的流体床干燥器被杀虫剂污染而把使用的包装袋污染。

examples.en: Investigators in Japan have found punctures on the outside of at least one of the bags tied to the poisonings as well as traces of the pesticide.
examples.zh: 日本调查人员在其中至少一袋涉及中毒案的饺子的外包装袋上发现了刺孔以及杀虫剂的痕迹。

words.translation: 连锁店
无轨电车
大使夫人； 女大使

words.definition: for some reason that is not clear to you or that you do not understand; one way or another, puzzlingly
words.translation: 由于某种原因；以某种方法；莫明其妙地

examples.en: Somehow, I just don’t think it’ll work.
examples.zh: 不知为什么，我总觉得那样行不通。

words.definition: towards the east; orient
words.translation: 向东；东部；东方

examples.en: A powerful snow storm is moving eastward.
examples.zh: 一场强暴风雪正在东移。

words.definition: a wound or damage to part of your body caused by an accident or attack
words.translation: 损害，伤害；受伤处

examples.en: She was taken to hospital with serious head injuries.
examples.zh: 她头部受重伤被送到医院。

examples.en: Beckham has missed several games through injury
examples.zh: 贝克汉姆因伤错过了几场比赛。

examples.en: He’s a lawyer who specializes in personal injury claims.
examples.zh: 他是个专门从事人身伤害索赔的律师。

words.definition: a unit for measuring temperature. It can be shown as a symbol after a number. For example, 70° means 70 degrees.; extent, classification, measure, grade, plane
words.translation: 程度；程度，等级；度；学位；阶层

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees.
examples.zh: 把烘箱预热至425度。

words.definition: happening slowly over a long period of time; piecemeal
words.translation: 逐渐的；渐进的；平缓的

examples.en: There has been a gradual change in climate.
examples.zh: 气候渐渐发生了变化。

examples.en: the gradual decline in manufacturing industry
examples.zh: 制造业的逐渐衰退

examples.en: Education is a gradual process.
examples.zh: 教育是一个循序渐进的过程。

words.definition: A previous event or thing is one that happened or existed before the one that you are talking about; ago, fore; antecedently
words.translation: 之前的；先前地；以前的；早先的；过早的；在先；在…以前

examples.en: She has a teenage daughter from a previous marriage.
examples.zh: 她有个出自前一次婚姻的十几岁的女儿。

words.definition: a class at a university or college for a small group of students and a teacher to study or discuss a particular subject; forum, consultation, symposium
words.translation: 研究班， 研讨会；讨论会，研讨班

examples.en: a Shakespeare seminar
examples.zh: 莎士比亚研讨班

words.definition: to do an activity, often regularly, in order to improve your skill or to prepare for a test; exercise, wage; execute, exercise, fulfil, enforce
words.translation: 练习，实习，训练；练习，实践；实施，实行；从事

examples.en: They moved the furniture back to practise their dance routine.
examples.zh: 他们把家具往后挪以便练习舞蹈动作。

examples.en: It gives students the opportunity to practice their speaking skills.
examples.zh: 这给学生提供了锻炼口才的机会。

words.translation: 在头顶上的；架空的

examples.en: The fireworks cracked overhead.
examples.zh: 鞭炮在头顶上空噼啪地爆响。

examples.en: A number of birds are circling overhead.
examples.zh: 很多鸟在头顶上空盘旋。

words.definition: the things that a person or animal does; dealing, going, habit, act, work
words.translation: 行为， 举止；特性；运转情况 A；行为；习性；运行状况（等于behavior）

examples.en: It is important to reward good behaviour.
examples.zh: 表现好要给予奖励，这是很重要的。

words.definition: money put, saved, or given towards something is used to pay for it; at, unto, for, on, to
words.translation: 用于，有助于；朝，向；对于；有助于

examples.en: The money collected will be put towards repairing the church roof.
examples.zh: 募集到的钱款将用于修缮教堂屋顶。

words.definition: a special metal container that keeps the liquid inside it under pressure. The liquid is released as a  spray  when you press the button; tin, debe
words.translation: 罐头，听头；容器；[食品]罐头，一罐；金属容器

words.definition: to make someone feel pleased by doing what they want; turn up trumps; meet, fulfill, fill, please, reason
words.translation: 满足,使满意；令人满意；令人满足；满足；说服，使相信；使满意，使高兴

examples.en: Nothing I did would ever satisfy my father.
examples.zh: 我做什么都不能让父亲满意。

words.translation: 勤劳的， 辛勤工作的

words.definition: feel like, propose, wanna, think, desire
words.translation: 打算；想要；意指

examples.en: Oddly enough, that is precisely what I intend.
examples.zh: 说也奇怪， 那正是我的打算。

examples.en: They intend to be an army of light against the onslaught of darkness.
examples.zh: 他们打算成为一支光明之师对抗黑暗军团的猛烈进攻。
